  Goblin Lyre) / `DEFENDING_PLAYER` (the player the source is attacking — its attack target
  if a player, else the attacked planeswalker's controller; nothing when not attacking) /
  `ATTACHED_CONTROLLER` (controller of the permanent the source Aura/Equipment is attached to —
  "its controller", not CR 109.5 "you"; nothing when unattached; Righteous Authority);
  `excludeSource=true` models "each *other* …" wordings
- `CardsInGraveyard(CardPredicate filter, CountScope scope)` — matching non-token cards in
  the graveyard(s) in scope (`null` filter = every card)
- `GraveyardsAtLeast(int threshold)` — number of players whose graveyard contains at least
  `threshold` non-token cards; counts each player's graveyard once. Master's Councillors uses
  `Scaled(GraveyardsAtLeast(7), 2)`.
- `CardsInHand(CountScope scope)` � cards in the hand(s) of the players in scope
- `MatchingCardsInHand(CountScope scope, CardPredicate predicate)` � cards matching `predicate`
  in the hand(s) in scope (filtered sibling of `CardsInHand`). Sacellum Godspeaker = "Add {G} for
  each creature card with power 5+ revealed" (`CONTROLLER`, `CardAllOf(CREATURE, CardPowerAtLeast(5))`)
- `CardsInLibrary(CountScope scope)` � cards in the library/libraries of the players in scope
  (`gameData.playerDecks`; Invincible Hymn = `CONTROLLER`)
- `MatchingCardsInLibrary(CountScope scope, CardPredicate predicate)` � cards matching `predicate`
  in the library/libraries in scope; use for filtered library counts such as Ureni's Counsel's
  Dragon-based cast-cost reduction.
- `UntappedLandsAtTurnStart()` � the number of untapped lands the *targeted* player controlled at
  the beginning of the current turn, read from the `gameData.untappedLandsAtTurnStart` snapshot
  (taken as each player's upkeep begins, post-untap, in `StepTriggerService.handleUpkeepTriggers`).
  Locked at turn start, so tapping lands in response to the upkeep trigger doesn't lower it (Power
  Surge, CR ruling). Target player id comes from the stack entry's target channel
- `ControllerLifeTotal()` � the controller's current life total (Serra Avatar / Ajani
  Goldmane's Avatar token, whose P/T are each equal to their controller's life total)
- `UnspentMana(ManaColor color)` – the amount of that color in the controller's mana pool,
  including colored mana in restricted buckets. Omnath, Locus of Mana uses it for its static
  self-boost
- `TargetPlayerLifeTotal()` � the *targeted* player's current life total, read from the stack
  entry's target channel (0 without a legal target player). Player-facing sibling of
  `ControllerLifeTotal`; for combat-damage triggers the damaged player is baked in as the target.
  Wrap in `HalvedRoundedUp` for "loses half their life, rounded up" (Quietus Spike)
- `HalfControllerLifeRoundedUp()` � half the controller's current life total, rounded up
  (`(life + 1) / 2`); "its owner loses half their life, rounded up" (Personal Incarnation)
- `HighestOpponentLifeTotal()` � the highest life total among the controller's opponents; 0 with no
  opponent (or while the controller is still unknown). "half the highest life total among your
  opponents, rounded up" (Malignus) = `HalvedRoundedUp(HighestOpponentLifeTotal())`
- `GreatestOpponentHandSize()` - the largest hand size among the controller's opponents; 0 with no
  opponent or while the controller is still unknown. Adamaro, First to Desire uses it for its
  characteristic-defining power and toughness.
- `OpponentsWithMoreCardsInHandThanController()` - the number of opponents with strictly more cards
  in hand than the source controller; used for dynamic "once for each opponent who has more cards
  in hand than you" effects such as Wojek Investigator.
- `OpponentsWithFewerCreaturesThanController()` - the number of opponents who control strictly fewer
  creatures than the source controller; used for Voice of Many's enter-the-battlefield draw.
- `OpponentsWithAtLeastTwoMoreLandsThanController()` - the number of opponents who control at least
  two more lands than the source controller; used for Surveyor's Scope.
- `OpponentsWithMoreLandsThanController()` - the number of opponents who control strictly more lands
  than the source controller; used for Oreskos Explorer.
- `OpponentsWithMoreCreaturesThanController()` - the number of opponents who control strictly more
  creatures than the source controller; used for Heidegger, Shinra Executive.
- `OpponentsWithCreaturePowerAtLeast(int minPower)` - the number of opponents who control at least
  one creature with effective power at least `minPower`; used for Summon: Yojimbo.
- `OpponentsWithLifeAtMost(int threshold)` - the number of opponents whose life total is at or
  below the supplied threshold; used for Anya, Merciless Angel.
- `OpponentsAttackedThisTurn()` - the number of distinct opponents the controller declared
  attackers against this turn; attacks against planeswalkers and creatures entering attacking do
  not count. Used by Militant Angel.
- `CreaturesControllerControlledThatDealtCombatDamageToPlayerThisTurn()` - the number of creatures the ability's controller controlled when they dealt combat damage to a player this turn, including creatures that have since left the battlefield (Excess)
- `OpponentsDealtCombatDamageThisTurn()` - the number of distinct opponents who were dealt combat
  damage this turn, read from `GameData.combatDamageToPlayersThisTurn`. Used by Tymna the Weaver.
- `PlayersDealtCombatDamageThisTurn()` - the number of players, whoever they are, who were dealt combat
  damage this turn, read from `GameData.combatDamageDealtToPlayersThisTurn`. Used by Vivien's Stampede.
- `OpponentsDealtCombatDamageBySourceNameOrSubtypeThisTurn(String sourceName, CardSubtype sourceSubtype)` - the number of distinct opponents dealt combat damage this turn by a source whose combat-time name or creature subtype matches either supplied value.
- `OpponentsWhoLostLifeThisTurn()` - the number of distinct opponents whose life-loss total this
  turn is greater than zero; used for dynamic "once for each opponent who lost life this turn"
  effects such as Teysa, Opulent Oligarch.
- `PlayersWhoLostLifeThisTurn()` - the number of distinct players whose life-loss total this turn
  is greater than zero; used for dynamic "once for each player who lost life this turn" effects
  such as Reaper's Scythe.
- `OpponentsWithAtLeastCardsDrawnThisTurn(int minimum)` - the number of opponents who drew at
  least the specified number of cards this turn.
- `OpponentsWithAtLeastLandsEnteredBattlefieldThisTurn(int minimum)` - the number of opponents
  under whose control at least the specified number of lands entered the battlefield this turn.
- `HighestLifeTotalAmongPlayers()` � the highest life total among ALL players, controller included;
  controller-independent. "each player's life total becomes the highest life total among all
  players" (Arbiter of Knollridge) = `SetLifeTotalEffect(new HighestLifeTotalAmongPlayers(),
  Subjects.eachPlayer())`
- `LowestLifeTotalAmongPlayers()` - the lowest life total among ALL players, controller included;
  controller-independent. "each player's life total becomes the lowest life total among all
  players" (Repay in Kind) = `SetLifeTotalEffect(new LowestLifeTotalAmongPlayers(),
  Subjects.eachPlayer())`
- `CountersOnSource(CounterType counterType)` � counters of that type on the source
  permanent; `CounterType.ANY` counts every concrete counter on it. Reads the stack entry's live
  source, falling back to the last-known `sourcePermanentSnapshot` when the source left the
  battlefield as a cost (Golden Urn)
- `CountersOnTriggeringPermanent(CounterType counterType)` / `()` - counters of that type the
  stack entry's triggering permanent had as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 603.10a); the no-arg form (null type)
  counts every counter on it, and it is 0 when the entry has no triggering permanent. "For each
  counter on it" in a dies / leaves-the-battlefield trigger (Chasm Skulker, The Ooze, Shadow Urchin)
- `CardTypesAmongTriggeringCards()` - "for each card type among those cards": the card types among the
  stack entry's triggering cards, the cards a "one or more cards" event was about (discarded, put into a
  graveyard from a library, left a graveyard), each type once; 0 when the entry has none. Polluted Cistern's
  `LoseLifeEffect(new CardTypesAmongTriggeringCards(), Subjects.eachOpponent())`
- `LifeLostWhenTriggeringPermanentEntered()` - "the life you lost when it entered": the life the resolving ability's controller lost to `LoseAllButOneLifeEffect` when the stack entry's triggering permanent entered (read from it as it last existed on the battlefield, CR 603.10a); 0 when another player lost it or nothing was recorded (Soulgorger Orgg's leaves-the-battlefield `GainLifeEffect`)
- `TriggeringPermanentPower()` - "its / that creature's power": the power of the stack entry's triggering permanent as the ability resolves, or as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h: the value recorded as the ability triggered, `triggeringPermanentPowerAtTrigger`, e.g. a dying creature's, else the departure's), at least 0; 0 when the entry names none. Grand Ossuary's "a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power"; Archon of Redemption's `GainLifeEffect`, Hamletback Goliath's `PutCountersOnSelfEffect`, Quickbeast Amulet's `IntensifySourceCardEffect` and Cream of the Crop's `LookAtTopCardsEffect.putOneOnTopRestOnBottom(DynamicAmount)` on an entering creature
- `TriggeringPermanentToughness()` - "its / that creature's toughness": the toughness of the stack entry's triggering permanent as the ability resolves, or as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h: the value recorded as the ability triggered, e.g. a dying creature's, else the departure's), at least 0. Angelic Chorus's, Trostani's and Orchard Warden's `GainLifeEffect` on an entering creature, Proper Burial's on a dying one
- `CountersOnLinkedPermanent(CounterType counterType, UUID linkedPermanentId)` � counters
  of that type on a specific permanent identified by ID (0 if it has left the battlefield);
  for token CDAs referencing another permanent, e.g. Gutter Grime's Ooze tokens
- `CountersOnGrantingPermanent(CounterType counterType)` � counters of that type on the
  permanent that granted the activated ability being resolved (the Aura/Equipment, not the
  activating creature). `grantingPermanentId` is null on the card definition and bound at
  activation time from `ActivatedAbility.getGrantSourcePermanentId()` in
  `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService.snapshotEffects` (Archery Training's "{T}: … deals X
  damage … where X is the number of arrow counters on Archery Training"). Evaluates to 0
  while unbound
- `GreatestPowerAmongControlled(PermanentPredicate filter)` � greatest effective power among
  matching creatures the controller controls (0 if none); the no-argument form matches all
  creatures
- `GreatestPowerAmongControlled()` � greatest effective power among creatures the
  controller controls (0 if none)
- `GreatestCreatureCountAmongPlayers()` - greatest number of creatures controlled by any player.
- `GreatestPermanentCountAmongOpponents(PermanentPredicate)` - greatest number of matching permanents controlled by any one opponent of the amount's controller; use `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` for Cavern-Hoard Dragon's cost reduction.
- `GreatestToughnessAmongControlled()` � greatest effective toughness among creatures the
  controller controls (0 if none)
- `GreatestToughnessAmongControlled(PermanentPredicate filter)` - greatest effective toughness
  among matching creatures the controller controls (0 if none); the no-argument form matches all
  creatures
- `GreatestManaValueAmongControlled(PermanentPredicate filter[, boolean excludeSource])` - greatest
  mana value among permanents the controller controls matching the filter (0 if none); when
  `excludeSource` is true, the source permanent is excluded. "Draw cards equal to the greatest
  mana value among artifacts you control" = `DrawCardEffect(new
  GreatestManaValueAmongControlled(new PermanentIsArtifactPredicate()))` (One with the Machine)
- `GreatestManaValueAmongOwnedCommanders()` - greatest mana value among the controller's
  designated commanders on the battlefield or in the command zone (0 if none).
- `AttachmentsOnSource(boolean countAuras, boolean countEquipment)` � Auras/Equipment
  attached to the source
- `CreaturesBlockingSource()` � creatures currently blocking the source
- `OtherAttackersSharingCreatureTypeWithTarget()` � attacking creatures (other than the stack
  entry's target) that share a creature type with the target, counted once each (Changeling-aware
  via `GameQueryService.shareCreatureType`). Reads the target from the stack entry's target channel;
  pair with `BoostTargetCreatureEffect` on an `Triggers.creatureYouControlAttacks()` trigger whose target is the
  triggering attacker (recorded non-targeting by `CombatAttackService`). Shared Animosity =
  `BoostTargetCreatureEffect(new OtherAttackersSharingCreatureTypeWithTarget(), new Fixed(0))`
- `OpponentPoisonCounters()` � total poison counters on opponents
- `DefendingPlayerPoisonCounters()` � poison counters on the player attacked by the source permanent
  (or the controller of the attacked planeswalker); reads the live attack target at resolution
- `TargetPlayerPoisonCounters()` � poison counters on the stack entry's target player
- `ColorManaSymbolsAmongControlledPermanents(ManaColor color)` � devotion to `color` (the single-arg ctor, `devotion = true`): mana symbols of that color in the mana costs of all permanents the controller controls, plus devotion modifiers such as Altar of the Pantheon's (hybrid/Phyrexian count once each; generic/{X} never). `ColorManaSymbolsAmongControlledPermanents(ManaColor color, false)` is the chroma count: symbols only, no devotion modifiers. Springjack Shepherd = `CreateTokenEffect(new ColorManaSymbolsAmongControlledPermanents(ManaColor.WHITE, false), "Goat", 0, 1, �)`
- `ColorManaSymbolsInGraveyard(ManaColor color, CountScope scope)` � chroma-across-graveyard: total
  `color` mana symbols in the mana costs of the non-token cards in the graveyard(s) in scope
  (hybrid/Phyrexian of that color count once each; generic/{X} never; via `ManaCost.countColorSymbols`).
  Umbra Stalker = `SetPowerToughnessToAmountEffect(a, a)` with
  `a = new ColorManaSymbolsInGraveyard(ManaColor.BLACK, CountScope.CONTROLLER)`
- `ColorManaSymbolsInRevealedCards(ManaColor color)` � chroma-across-revealed-cards: total `color` mana
  symbols in the mana costs of the cards the controller revealed earlier in the same resolution via
  `RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect` (hybrid/Phyrexian of that color count once each; generic/{X}
  never; via `ManaCost.countColorSymbols`). Phosphorescent Feast =
  `RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect(new CardTruePredicate())` +
  `GainLifeEffect(new Scaled(new ColorManaSymbolsInRevealedCards(ManaColor.GREEN), 2))`
- `CreatureDeathsThisTurn(CountScope scope)` � creatures that died under a player's control,
  summed over the players in scope (tracked by `GameData.creatureDeathCountThisTurn`)
- `CreaturesPutIntoOwnGraveyardThisTurn()` � creatures put into the effect controller's graveyard
  from the battlefield this turn (Asmira Holy Avenger, Fresh Meat, Urborg Justice)
- `NontokenCreaturesPutIntoOwnGraveyardThisTurn()` - nontoken creatures put into the effect
  controller's graveyard from the battlefield this turn (Caller of the Claw)
- `CreatureCardsInGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn()` - currently present, non-token creature cards
  in the controller's graveyard that entered from the battlefield this turn (Revivify)
- `CreaturesAttackedThisTurn(CountScope scope)` - cumulative number of creatures declared as
  attackers this turn, summed over the players in scope (`GameData.creaturesAttackedCountThisTurn`;
  Search Party Captain uses `CONTROLLER`)
- `TimesSourceRegeneratedThisTurn()` � how many times the source permanent regenerated this turn
  (`Permanent.timesRegeneratedThisTurn`, incremented by every regeneration in `GraveyardService`,
  reset at turn cleanup). Spiny Starfish = `CreateTokenEffect(new TimesSourceRegeneratedThisTurn(), �)`
- `DamageDealtToTargetPlayerThisTurn()` � total damage dealt to the *targeted* player this turn
  from any source (combat/spell/ability, including damage dealt as poison), read from
  `GameData.damageDealtToPlayersThisTurn` (populated via `GameData.recordDamageToPlayer`). Reads the
  target from the stack entry's target channel, so pair with a player-targeting effect; Final
  Punishment = `LoseLifeEffect(new DamageDealtToTargetPlayerThisTurn(), Subjects.targetPlayer())`
- `DamageDealtToTargetPermanentThisTurn()` — total damage actually dealt to the targeted permanent
  this turn, excluding prevented damage and surviving regeneration. Reads from
  `GameData.damageDealtToPermanentsThisTurn`; pair with `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect` for
  Whipkeeper's "damage already dealt to it this turn".
- `DamageDealtToSourceThisTurn()` — total damage actually dealt to the source permanent this turn,
  excluding prevented damage and surviving regeneration. Used by Tangled Colony (`WOE`) to create
  one nonblocking Rat token per damage dealt before it died.
- `DamageDealtToSourceByControllerThisTurn()` — damage actually dealt to the source permanent this
  turn by sources controlled by the player evaluating the amount; used by Grothama, All-Devouring
  (`BLC`) for its leave-the-battlefield draw trigger.
- `DamageDealtToSourcePermanentBySourceNameThisTurn(String)` — total actual damage dealt this turn
  to the source permanent by other source objects whose names match the supplied name. Source
  attribution is retained independently of marked damage, so regeneration does not erase it.
- `CardsDiscardedByTargetPlayerThisTurn()` � number of cards the *targeted* player discarded this
  turn (any discard, any source), read from `GameData.cardsDiscardedThisTurn` (incremented in
  `GameData.discarded`, the central discard hook). Reads the target from
  the stack entry's target channel, so pair with a player-targeting effect. `DrawCardEffect` advertises
  a player target when its amount is this record; Dream Salvage = `DrawCardEffect(new
  CardsDiscardedByTargetPlayerThisTurn())` + `target(PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT))`
- `CardsDiscardedOrCycledThisTurn()` � number of cards the *controller* has discarded this turn
  (cycling is a discard, CR 702.29e), read from `GameData.cardsDiscardedThisTurn` for `ctx.controllerId`.
  Hollow One = `ReduceOwnCastCostEffect(new Scaled(new CardsDiscardedOrCycledThisTurn(), 2))`
- `CardsPutIntoGraveyardByTargetPlayerThisTurn()` � number of non-token cards put into the *targeted*
  player's graveyard from anywhere this turn, read from `GameData.cardsPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurn`
  (populated at the single zone�graveyard choke point in `GraveyardService.addCardToGraveyard`; tokens
  excluded, and cards that later left the graveyard still count � the set is cleared only at turn start).
  Reads the target from the stack entry's target channel, so pair with a player-targeting/curse effect;
  Fraying Sanity = `MillEffect(new CardsPutIntoGraveyardByTargetPlayerThisTurn(), Subjects.targetPlayer())`
  as a Curse's `Triggers.endStep(ActivePlayer.ANY)` ability (enchanted player baked as `targetId`)
- `DamageDealtToOpponentsThisTurn()` � total damage dealt to the controller's opponents this turn,
  summed over every opponent, from `GameData.damageDealtToPlayersThisTurn`. Controller-relative (no
  target needed); Notorious Throng = `CreateTokenEffect(new DamageDealtToOpponentsThisTurn(), �)`
- `DamageDealtToControllerThisTurn()` � total damage dealt to the effect's controller this turn from
  any source (combat/spell/ability, including damage dealt as poison), from
  `GameData.damageDealtToPlayersThisTurn`. Controller-relative counterpart of
  `DamageDealtToTargetPlayerThisTurn` (no target needed); Simulacrum = `GainLifeEffect(new
  DamageDealtToControllerThisTurn())` + `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(new DamageDealtToControllerThisTurn())`
- `LifeLostThisTurn(CountScope scope)` � total life lost this turn (direct loss and damage, since
  damage causes loss of life; net life change is irrelevant � life gained does not reduce it), summed
  over the players in scope, from `GameData.lifeLostThisTurn` (cleared each turn). Tainted Sigil =
  `GainLifeEffect(new LifeLostThisTurn(CountScope.ANY_PLAYER))` ("gain life equal to the total life lost by all players this turn")
- `LifeGainedThisTurn(CountScope scope)` � total life gained this turn, summed over the players in
  scope, from `GameData.lifeGainedThisTurn` (cleared each turn). Voracious Wurm =
  `EnterWithCountersEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, new LifeGainedThisTurn(CountScope.CONTROLLER))`
  ("enters with X +1/+1 counters, where X is the amount of life you've gained this turn")
- `ImprintedCardManaValue()` � the mana value of the card imprinted on the source permanent (0 if
  nothing imprinted). Pair with `ExileTopCardOfLibraryCost(1, true)` for "Exile the top card of your
  library: Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is the exiled card's mana value"
  (Phyrexian Devourer)
- `SpellsCastThisTurn(CountScope scope)` — number of spells cast this turn, summed over the players
- `SpellsCastSinceBeginningOfLastTurn(CardPredicate filter, CountScope scope)` — number of matching spells cast during the immediately preceding and current turns, summed over the players in scope; used by Concert Kaboomist (YMKM 14)
- `ColorsAmongControlledPermanentsAndSpellsCastThisTurn()` — number of distinct effective colors among the controller's permanents and spells cast this turn; the resolving spell is included.
  in scope, from `GameData.spellsCastThisTurn`. Aetherflux Reservoir uses
  `GainLifeEffect(new SpellsCastThisTurn(CountScope.CONTROLLER))`; the amount is evaluated when its
  triggered ability resolves.
- `SpellsCastBeforeTriggeringSpellThisTurn(CardPredicate filter[, boolean anyPlayer])` — the matching spells cast this turn before the triggering spell, its caster's, or with `anyPlayer` (`byAnyPlayer()`, the storm count, CR 702.40a) every player's, counted as the ability resolves up to the triggering spell's place among them (`StackEntry.triggeringSpellCastIndex` / `triggeringSpellTurnCastIndex`, kept as the ability triggers, so a spell cast in response doesn't count; a countered spell was still cast and counts). Thousand-Year Storm: `new CopyTriggeringSpellEffect().withCopies(new SpellsCastBeforeTriggeringSpellThisTurn(instantOrSorcery))`; storm: `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect.storm()`
- `PermanentsPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn()` — the permanents put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn, every player's, tokens included (gravestorm, CR 702.69a)
- `DistinctManaValuesAmongOtherSpellsAndLandsPlayedThisTurn()` — the different mana values among the controller's other spells cast (their X included) and lands played this turn, "other" the stack entry's triggering spell (coststorm: Friarball)
- `SpellsCastFromOutsideHandThisTurn(CountScope scope)` — number of spells cast this turn from any
  zone other than the caster's hand, summed over the players in scope. The count is recorded from
  each cast's source zone, so repeated casts of the same physical card from hand remain distinct.
- `LastDiscardedCardManaValue()` — the mana value of the most recently discarded card (0 when no
  discard happened). `DiscardEffectHandler` clears it before every discard and the central discard
  hook records it, so a **later effect on the same spell** reads the card just discarded:
  Blast of Genius = `DrawCardEffect(3)` + `DiscardEffect(1, CONTROLLER)` +
  `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new LastDiscardedCardManaValue())`. Empty hand ⇒ 0 ⇒ no damage
- `LastMilledCardColorSymbols(ManaColor)` — the number of symbols of that color in the mana cost of
  the most recently milled card (0 when no card reached the graveyard). Generic and colorless
  symbols do not count; hybrid and Phyrexian symbols count for each color they contain. Charmed
  Pendant pairs one of these amounts with each colored `AwardManaEffect` after `MillControllerCost(1)`
- `ImprintedCreaturePower()` / `ImprintedCreatureToughness()` � the imprinted creature
  card's P/T (0 if nothing imprinted)
- `TotalManaValueOfCardsExiledWithSource()` — the summed mana value of every card in exile tracked with the source permanent; used by Jadeheart Attendant's craft ETB
- `ManaValueOfLastCardExiledWithSource` — **Gone**: `AmountThisWay.exiledManaValue()` after the exile step (The Aesir Escape Valhalla chapter I)
- `TotalManaValueOfCardsOwnedInExile` — `()` — dynamic amount equal to the total mana value of the resolving controller's nontoken cards in exile; used by Ashiok, Wicked Manipulator's ultimate
- `ColorsAmongCardsExiledWithSource()` — the number of distinct colors among cards exiled with the source permanent; used by Sunbird Effigy to set both characteristic-defining power and toughness.
- `TotalPowerOfCardsExiledWithSource()` / `TotalToughnessOfCardsExiledWithSource()` � the summed
  power / toughness of every card in exile tracked with the source permanent
  (`GameData.getCardsExiledByPermanent`); cards with no printed P/T contribute 0. Sutured Ghoul's
  CDA (`SetPowerToughnessToAmountEffect`) over the cards exiled by its as-enters exile
- `GreatestManaValueAmongCardsExiledWithSource()` � the greatest mana value among cards currently
  tracked as exiled with the source permanent, or 0 when the source tracks no cards. The Kenriths'
  Royal Funeral uses it for both its draw and life-loss amounts
- `LandsMatchingImprintedName()` � lands on any battlefield whose name matches the source's
  imprinted card (0 if nothing imprinted); Strata Scythe
- `BasicLandTypesAmongControlledLands([CountScope])` — the number of distinct basic land types
  (Plains/Island/Swamp/Mountain/Forest) among lands in the selected player scope. The no-argument
  form uses the effect controller; `TARGET_PLAYER` reads the player in the stack entry's target
  channel. Respects land-type overrides via `GameQueryService.effectiveBasicLandTypes` except in
  static evaluation, where only intrinsic printed types are read to avoid `computeStaticBonus`
  recursion.
- `CreatureTypesAmongControlledCreatures()` — the number of distinct effective creature types
  among the controller's creatures; Changeling creatures contribute every creature type.
- `DistinctKeywordAbilitiesAmongControlledCreatures(Set<Keyword> abilities)` — the number of
  distinct supplied keyword abilities found among the controller's creatures; each ability counts
  once regardless of how many creatures have it, using effective abilities at evaluation.
  Odric, Blood-Cursed.
  Wrap in `Scaled(amount, 2)` for "{2} for each basic land type" (Draco cost reduction + upkeep tax)
- `DistinctManaValuesAmongControlledPermanents()` — the number of distinct mana values among the
  controller's nonland permanents. Lands are excluded, duplicate mana values count once, and
  face-down permanents count as mana value 0. Lunar Insight.
- `DistinctManaValuesAmongCardsInGraveyard(CountScope scope, boolean nonlandOnly[, CardPredicate filter])` counts distinct mana values among nontoken cards in the scoped graveyards; an optional card predicate restricts which cards contribute. The no-argument and scope-only forms include lands; Sudden Insight uses `(CountScope.CONTROLLER, true)` to exclude lands.
- `DistinctColorPairsAmongControlledPermanents()` — the number of distinct effective color pairs
  among exactly two-color permanents controlled by the controller. Duplicate pairs count once;
  permanents with fewer or more than two colors do not count. Niv-Mizzet, Guildpact.
- `CardTypesAmongCardsInGraveyard([CountScope])` � distinct card types among non-token cards in the
  scoped graveyard(s); default scope `CONTROLLER`. Multi-type cards contribute each type. Emrakul,
  the Promised End cost reduction
- `SourcePower()` / `SourceToughness()` (`SourcePower(true)` retains negative power for modifiers; `SourcePower(false, true)` reads base power before counters and boosts) � the source permanent's effective power/toughness
  at evaluation time, never negative; uses the live source or the last-known snapshot when
  it left the battlefield (CR 608.2h � Spikeshot Elder, Steadfast Armasaur)
- `TargetToughness()` � the resolved target permanent's effective toughness at resolution,
  never negative; 0 when there is no legal target (matching the fizzle behaviour of the
  handlers it replaces). The target is read from the stack entry's `targetId` (Condemn)
- `TargetPower()` � the resolved target permanent's effective power at resolution, never
  negative; 0 when there is no legal target. The power analogue of `TargetToughness`; target
  read from the stack entry's `targetId` (Chastise: gain life = target's power, then destroy it)
- `TargetManaValue()` � the resolved target permanent's mana value at resolution; 0 when there
  is no legal target. Target read from the stack entry's `targetId`. Used for "becomes a creature
  with power and toughness each equal to its mana value" animations (Xenic Poltergeist)
- `TargetSpellManaValue()` � mana value of the targeted spell still on the stack
  (`card.getManaValue() + stackEntry.getXValue()`); 0 if it has left. Used with
  `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(..., Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.targetSpell()))` (Refuse)
- `ManaSpentToCast()` � total mana spent to cast the spell, snapshotted into the entry's
- `TargetSpellPower()` — power of the targeted creature spell (characteristic-defining P/T evaluated):
  read from the spell while on the stack, else the last-known copy remembered by an earlier counter in the same resolution; 0 if neither. Used with
  `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(..., Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.targetSpell()))` (Essence Backlash), placed after the
  companion `CounterSpellEffect` (printed order).
- `ManaSpentToCast()` — total mana spent to cast the spell, snapshotted into the entry's
- `TreasureManaSpentToCast()` — exact amount of Treasure-produced mana spent to cast the spell;
- `TreasureManaSpentToActivate()` — exact amount of Treasure-produced mana spent to activate the resolving ability;
  read from the cast-time Treasure-mana snapshot in `GameData` (Spoils of the Hunt, AFR)
- `DesertManaSpentToCast()` — exact amount of Desert-produced mana spent to cast the spell;
  read from the cast-time Desert-mana snapshot in `GameData` (Cataclysmic Prospecting, OTC)
  xValue at cast time (`SpellCastingService` keys the snapshot via
  `EffectResolution.hasManaSpentToCastAmount` � damage amounts and `LookAtTopCardsEffect`
  look/choose counts; distinct from `XValue` so converge/X payments aren't overwritten;
  Molten Note, Memory Deluge). On a spell-cast trigger it is "the amount of mana spent to cast that spell": what
  the triggering spell recorded as it became cast (`StackEntry.manaSpentToCastThisSpell()`, 0 for an uncast copy),
  read from the entry's snapshot of it (Aetherflux Conduit, Manaform Hellkite, Tellah)
- `FixedIfCondition(Condition condition, int amount, int otherwise)` — `amount` when the condition
  is met at evaluation time, else `otherwise`. The generic bridge from the `Condition` hierarchy
  into the amount one; prefer it over a new bespoke `FixedIf…` amount whenever an existing
  `Condition` already expresses the check. Gather the Pack feeds it as the `chooseCount` of a
  `LookAtTopCardsEffect` (`FixedIfCondition(GraveyardCardThreshold(2, instant/sorcery), 2, 1)` —
  spell mastery keeps two creature cards instead of one)
- `FixedIfControlMoreCreaturesThanEachOtherPlayer(int amount, int otherwise)` � `amount` when
  the controller controls strictly more creatures than every other player, else `otherwise`.
  Feeds the `chooseCount` of a `LookAtTopCardsEffect` for "put two � if you control more
  creatures than each other player, otherwise put one" (Advice from the Fae, `(2, 1)`)
- `FixedIfTargetMatches(PermanentPredicate filter, int amount, int otherwise)` � `amount` when
- `FixedIfTargetPlayerControlsMoreLands(int amount, int otherwise)` — `amount` when the targeted
  player controls strictly more lands than the controller at evaluation, else `otherwise`
  (missing target → `otherwise`). Tithe = `SearchLibraryEffect(new FixedIfTargetPlayerControlsMoreLands(2, 1),
  CardSubtypePredicate(PLAINS), HAND)` (up to 2 / up to 1; count checked on resolution)
- `FixedIfTargetMatches(PermanentPredicate filter, int amount, int otherwise)` — `amount` when
  the resolved target permanent matches `filter` at evaluation, else `otherwise` (player targets
  and missing targets � `otherwise`). Elvish Healer = `PreventDamageEffect.nextToTarget(new
  FixedIfTargetMatches(AllOf(creature, green), 2, 1))`
- `CreatureSubtypeDeathsThisTurn(CardSubtype subtype, CountScope scope)` — how many creatures of that subtype died this turn in the requested scope (the CHK Zubera cycle: Ashen-Skin, Floating-Dream, Silent-Chant)
- `CreatureSubtypeDeathPowerThisTurn(CardSubtype subtype, CountScope scope)` — the total power of the creatures of that subtype that died this turn in the requested scope, each with its last-known power (Genesis of the Daleks)

All amounts are evaluated in one place, the engine's `AmountEvaluationService` (exhaustive
switch, parallel to `ConditionEvaluationService`; contexts built via
`AmountContext.forStackEntry` / `forStaticEffect`). `AmountContext` carries the values that
differ per evaluation site: `controllerId`, `sourcePermanent` (source-relative amounts),
`targetPermanentId` (target-relative amounts such as `TargetToughness`, read from the entry's
`targetId` the same way `ConditionContext.targetId` is), plus two snapshotted integer channels
� `xValue` (**cast-time** data, read by `XValue`/`ManaSpentToCast`) and `eventValue`
(**trigger-event / prior-resolution** data, read by `EventValue`). `forStackEntry` pulls all of
these off the `StackEntry`; the source-less/static/estimation factories leave them null/0.

**Who snapshots `eventValue`, and when:** the entry's `eventValue` is populated either by the
**trigger record** stamped on the entry as the ability triggers (parallel to how `SpellTriggers`
snapshots spell-mana-spent into `xValue`) or by an **earlier effect on the same entry** that
produced the number (the excess-damage case). Both guard the write with
`AmountEvaluationService.referencesEventValue(amount)` (the event-value analogue of
`referencesXValue`) so an entry only carries a value when some effect actually reads it �
e.g. `LifeTriggers` records the life gained as the entry's event value, which a
`LoseLifeEffect` amount reads, and `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffectHandler`
stores the excess damage only when a following `ExileTopCardMayPlayThisTurnEffect` or
`GainLifeEffect` reads it.
Prefer `EventValue` for numbers known only at trigger/resolution time; `XValue` stays cast-time.

Effects that only differ in HOW A NUMBER
IS COMPUTED must be a single record parameterized with `DynamicAmount` � see
`BoostSelfEffect(DynamicAmount, DynamicAmount[, Duration])` (replaced the entire `BoostSelfPer*` family; defaults to end of turn and supports end-of-combat floating boosts),
`SetPowerToughnessToAmountEffect(DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness)` (the CDA sibling �
sets P/T on a 0/0 base via the selfOnly `SetPowerToughnessToAmountSelfEffectHandler`; replaced the
entire `PowerToughnessEqualTo*` family and the ooze-token `BoostSelfBySlimeCountersOnLinkedPermanentEffect`),
`AttachedBoostEffect(DynamicAmount, DynamicAmount, PermanentSubject)` (the attached-scope sibling �
replaced `BoostCreaturePerCardsInAllGraveyardsEffect`, `BoostCreaturePerCardsInControllerGraveyardEffect`,
`BoostCreaturePerControlledCardTypeEffect`, `BoostCreaturePerControlledSubtypeEffect`, and
`BoostCreaturePerMatchingLandNameEffect`; amounts evaluate against the Aura/Equipment's
controller, so `CountScope.CONTROLLER` = "you"/"you control" per CR 109.5),
`BoostTargetCreatureEffect(DynamicAmount, DynamicAmount)` (replaced the
`BoostTargetCreaturePerControlledPermanentEffect`, `BoostTargetCreaturePerCardsInControllerGraveyardEffect`,
and `BoostTargetCreatureXEffect` variants � counting contexts resolve against the effect's
controller, not the pumped target), `GainLifeEffect(DynamicAmount, PlayerSubject)` (replaced the
`GainLife*` family, `GainLifeEqualToTargetToughnessEffect` and `TargetPlayerGainsLifeEffect`; `Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.target())` routes the
life to the target permanent's controller � Condemn's `GainLifeEffect(TargetToughness(), Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.target()))`),
`LoseLifeEffect(DynamicAmount, PlayerSubject, boolean controllerGainsLifeLost)` (optionally with a
`PermanentPredicate` exemption and a `Condition` gating the controller's life gain; replaced the whole
life-loss family � `TargetPlayerLosesLifeEffect` [+ `TargetPlayerLosesLifeEqualToLifeGainedEffect` �
Sanguine Bond `EventValue()`, `TargetPlayerLosesLifePerControlledPermanentEffect` � Bishop of the
Bloodstained `PermanentCount(filter, CONTROLLER)`, the wording counts *your* Vampires not the target's],
`EachPlayerLosesLifeEffect`, `EachOpponentLosesLifeEffect`, `EachOpponentLosesLifeAndControllerGainsLifeLostEffect`,
and `EachOpponentLosesXLifeAndControllerGainsLifeLostEffect` � the last two via the `controllerGainsLifeLost`
drain flag; `recipient=TARGET_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` routes the loss to the controller of the *targeted
permanent* � Soul Reap's "its controller loses 3 life", list it before the accompanying
`DestroyTargetPermanentEffect` so the creature is still present, fires "loses life" triggers via
`applyLifeLoss`; `recipient=OWNER` routes the loss to the source card's owner and evaluates
player-relative dynamic amounts against that owner; `recipient=DEFENDING_PLAYER` routes the loss to the player being attacked (or the
attacked planeswalker's controller), read from the combat trigger's `attackedTargetId` � chooses no
target, fires "loses life" triggers, used by Vedalken Ghoul's `Triggers.becomesBlocked()`),
`DrainLifeFromDyingCreatureOwnerEffect(int)` reads the dying card (the stack entry's triggering card) during an ally-creature-death
trigger, makes that card's owner lose the amount, then makes the triggered ability's controller gain
the same amount; use it for "a creature you control but don't own dies" drains.

(absorbed `ExileTopCardsEqualToStackEntryExcessDamageMayPlayUntilNextTurnEffect` � Archaic's Agony
`EventValue()`),
`DrawCardEffect(DynamicAmount[, PlayerSubject])`
(replaced `DrawXCardsEffect`, `DrawXCardsForTargetPlayerEffect`,
`DrawCardsEqualToChargeCountersOnSourceEffect`, `DrawCardsEqualToControlledCreatureCountEffect`,
`DrawCardsPerCreatureCardInGraveyardEffect`), and `CreateTokenEffect(�, DynamicAmount amount, �)`
(replaced `CreateXCreatureTokenEffect`, `CreateTokenPerAttachmentOnSourceEffect`,
`CreateTokenPerEquipmentOnSourceEffect`, `CreateTokenPerOpponentPoisonCounterEffect`,
`CreateTokensEqualToChargeCountersOnSourceEffect`, `CreateTokensEqualToControlledCreatureCountEffect`,
`CreateTokensPerCreatureCardInGraveyardEffect`, `CreateTokensPerOwnCreatureDeathsThisTurnEffect`,
`CreateTokensPerControlledCreatureSubtypeEffect`, `CreateTokensPerControlledLandSubtypeEffect`),
and the damage bases `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect` / `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect` /
`DealDamageToPlayersEffect` (TARGET_PLAYER / EACH_OPPONENT / EACH_OTHER_OPPONENT) /
`DealDamageToEachTargetEffect` (replaced `DealXDamageToAnyTargetEffect`,
`DealXDamageToTargetCreatureEffect`, `DealXDamageToEachTargetEffect`,
`DealDamageEqualToSourcePowerToAnyTargetEffect`,
`DealDamageEqualToSourceToughnessToTargetCreatureEffect`,
`DealDamageToAnyTargetEqualToChargeCountersOnSourceEffect`,
`DealDamageToTargetCreatureEqualToControlledSubtypeCountEffect`,
`DealDamageToTargetCreatureEqualToManaSpentToCastEffect`,
`DealDamageToTargetPlayerEqualToCardTypeCountInGraveyardEffect`,
`DealDamageToEachOpponentEqualToPlusOnePlusOneCountersOnSourceEffect`),
and the mill base `MillEffect(DynamicAmount, PlayerSubject)` (one record for the whole family �
replaced `MillControllerEffect`, `MillTargetPlayerEffect`, `EachOpponentMillsEffect`,
`MillByHandSizeEffect`; `recipient` ??? {CONTROLLER, TARGET_PLAYER, EACH_OPPONENT, TARGET_SPELL_CONTROLLER}
routes who mills � `TARGET_SPELL_CONTROLLER` mills the controller of the spell at `entry.getTargetId()`,
for "counter target spell ... that spell's controller mills N" cards like Broken Ambitions (wrap the
mill in `ClashEffect` and list it *before* the counter so the targeted spell is still on the stack),
`CardsInHand(TARGET_PLAYER)` covers Dreamborn Muse's hand-size count), the discard base
`DiscardEffect(DynamicAmount, PlayerSubject, boolean random)` (one record for the whole family �
replaced `DiscardCardEffect`, `TargetPlayerDiscardsEffect`, `EachPlayerDiscardsEffect`,
`EachOpponentDiscardsEffect`, `TargetPlayerRandomDiscardEffect`, `EachPlayerRandomDiscardEffect`;
`recipient` routes who discards, `random` picks chosen vs random), and the mana base.
For the optional type parameter, a matching chosen discard makes the next discard optional while
still allowing the player to choose it (Thirst for Knowledge).

`EachOpponentDiscardsOrControllerGainsLifeEffect(int lifeGain)` resolves the fixed one-card discard
for each opponent in APNAP order and records opponents with empty hands through the shared discard
follow-up. A reflexive life-gain effect then uses that count. Cruel Grimnarch.

`EachOpponentDiscardsThenControllerDrawsEffect()` resolves the fixed one-card discard for each
opponent in APNAP order and draws one card for the controller for each card actually discarded.
Syphon Mind.
`EachOpponentDrawsThenControllerDrawsEffect()` resolves one draw for each opponent in APNAP order,
counts opponents whose draw actually occurred, and then draws that many cards for the controller.
Cut a Deal (MSC 127).
`EachOpponentDiscardsOrControllerDrawsEffect()` uses the same APNAP discard follow-up, then a
reflexive `DrawCardEffect(EventValue)` draws once for each opponent who could not discard.
Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal.

`AwardManaEffect(ManaColor, DynamicAmount)` (replaced `AddManaPerControlledPermanentEffect`
[� `PermanentCount(filter, CONTROLLER)`], `AddColorlessManaPerChargeCounterOnSourceEffect`
[� `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)`], and `AwardManaEqualToSourcePowerEffect` [� `SourcePower()`]).
Mana abilities resolve outside the stack, so their amount is evaluated from the source
permanent via `AmountContext.forManaAbility(Permanent, UUID controllerId)` (no `xValue`);
stack-resolved mana (Koth's `-2`, Molten-Core Maestro's Opus) uses `forStackEntry`.
`AddManaPerAttackingCreatureEffect` is intentionally NOT collapsed � its attacker count is
locked at trigger time (Grand Warlord Radha ruling), which a resolution-time `PermanentCount`
would get wrong.
New amounts: add the record to `model/amount/`, add it to the `permits` list on
`DynamicAmount`, and add its case to `AmountEvaluationService.evaluate`. Never add a new
per-derivation effect record.

`AwardManaUntilEndOfCombatEffect(ManaColor, DynamicAmount)` is the triggered-mana counterpart
for effects such as Firebending: it uses a separate mana-pool duration tracker and is cleared
when the game advances out of `END_OF_COMBAT`. Its optional third `firebending` argument defaults
to `true`; pass `false` for other triggered mana production lasting until combat ends.

NO data flow between steps (no "if you do" contingency); a step that no-ops does not stop later steps. `targetSpec()` = the first step's non-NONE spec; the entry's single target is shared by every targeting step (multi-target groups inside a sequence are unsupported). **Use ONLY** when a single-effect wrapper must gate several steps as one unit (`MayEffect(SequenceEffect.of(a, b))`, `ConditionalEffect(cond, SequenceEffect.of(a, b))`, `FlipCoinWinEffect(SequenceEffect.of(a, b))`) **Do NOT** wrap a plain spell/ability effect list, nor a triggered ability's effects (`addTrigger(trigger, a, b)` is already one ability, one stack entry) � prefer flat `addSpellEffect(...)` calls (the Act of Treason / Drain Life pattern) |

| `EnteringPermanentDealsDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffect` | — | **Gone** (fold run 2): write `new DealDamageToTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalkerEffect(amount, relation, false, true)` (the triggering creature deals it, live or last known; Aether Charge) or the plain source form (Lavabelly Sliver's granted ability) |

`DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(DynamicAmount, Condition, boolean)` adds a conditional
no-redirection rider to the existing conditional unpreventable-damage form. Use the boolean only
when the same condition forbids both prevention and dealing the damage to another recipient.

## Destruction / sacrifice

`ExileTargetPermanentUnlessControllerPaysEffect(DynamicAmount manaAmount)` is a targeted spell punisher that exiles the target creature unless its controller pays the evaluated generic mana amount. The target controller is prompted at resolution; accepting and paying keeps the creature, while declining or being unable to pay exiles it. X=0 keeps the creature without a prompt. Its target spec is harmful creature, and it is resolved by `ExileTargetPermanentUnlessControllerPaysEffectHandler` with the choice handled by `ExileTargetPermanentUnlessControllerPaysHandler`.
- `MaySacrificePermanentForCounterSourceEffect` — `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description[, DynamicAmount counterAmount])`: resolution-time optional sacrifice of one matching permanent; if accepted and paid, put the evaluated number of +1/+1 counters on the source. The default amount is one; `SacrificedPermanentPower` captures sacrificed power before the permanent leaves. Declining or having no matching permanent does nothing. Uses `MaySacrificeForCounterSupport` and `PermanentChoiceContext.MaySacrificeForCounterOnSource`; High-Society Hunter and Rhovanion Rampager.

`DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(PermanentPredicate targetFilter)` narrows the declared permanent target while retaining the default regeneration behavior.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect` | `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated)` or `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated, CreateTokenEffect tokenForController)`; optional token count/source-controller restriction; `forTargetGroup(int)` binds an activated-ability target-group index | destroy target permanent; `(PermanentSubject[, boolean cannotBeRegenerated])` / `(PermanentSubject, PermanentPredicate targetFilter)` destroy what the subject names instead (`source()`, `attached()`, `attachedAtTrigger()`, `triggering()`, `allOf(source(), target())`; several permanents as one batch; a non-target subject declares no target, so protection/shroud/hexproof do not stop it, and is not single-target removal for the AI). When `tokenForController` is non-null, creates that token for the target's controller regardless of whether destruction succeeds (e.g. Beast Within, Pongify); the optional count creates multiple tokens and the source-controller restriction limits the rider to targets controlled by the effect's controller. The target-group form reuses the same removal handler when another target, such as a chosen player, precedes the permanent target in an activated ability (Keeper of the Dead) |

Implements `OptionalTargetEffect`, so the trigger target picker offers the controller's decline choice and resolves with no target when none is legal. Used by Callidus Assassin's copied ETB ability |

Inserted by `StepDepartureSupport.sacrificeThenContinue` / `destroyThenContinue` / `departThenContinue` after a "sacrifice it, then …" or "destroy it, then …" step whose departure ended on a CR 616.1 question; runs that handler's `ContinuesAfterDeparture.continueAfterDeparture` once the departure is done (results on the resolution scratchpad) |
| `DepartPermanentsEffect` | `(List<DepartureIntent> intents)` | **internal, never on a card**. Inserted by `StepDepartureSupport.departAsStepAt` / `departAsNextStep` / `departAfterChoice` when a handler or choice completion has changed the game before its removal (counters put, coins flipped, a random pick, piles chosen); departs the chosen permanents as one event as a step of its own, so it can end on a CR 616.1 question before anything leaves (skips permanents that left or can't be sacrificed) |
| `PlayersLoseLifeEffect` | `(Map<UUID, Integer> losses)` | **internal, never on a card**. The life-loss step inserted after an earlier change of the same resolution (an exile, a sacrifice, a mill, a random reveal, discards) with players and amounts already fixed; its handler is `AsksDeathReplacementsFirst` and uses `LifeSupport.applyLifeLosses`, so Lich's Duel Mastery sacrifices are asked before any life is lost. Prefer `LoseLifeEffect` when a `PlayerSubject` fits. |
| `ResolveRiderForPlayerEffect` | `(CardEffect rider, UUID controllerId, UUID targetId, int eventValue, Map<UUID, UUID> removedPermanentControllers, List<UUID> targetCardIds)` | **internal, never on a card**. A "then" handler's rider made the next step of the resolving entry, resolved on a derived entry for the recipient and last-known value the handler determined. `DestroyTargetPermanentThenEffect` inserts it (only as the resolution step itself) for a rider whose handler is `AsksDeathReplacementsFirst` (a `LoseLifeEffect`, also behind a resolution-time `ConditionalEffect`), so Lich's Duel Mastery's sacrifice for "its controller loses 2 life" is asked after the destruction and before any life is lost. |
| `SacrificeSelfIfEvokedEffect` | `()` | evoke sacrifice (CR 702.75e): place in `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)`. `EtbEffectResolver` resolves it to a `SacrificeSelfEffect` when the permanent was cast for its evoke (alternate) cost, else drops the trigger. Pair with `AlternateHandCast(ManaCastingCost)` + `GameService.playCardWithEvoke` (Dawnfluke) |
| `CreateTokenCopyOfSacrificedPermanentEffect` | `()` / `(int amount)` | sacrifice-trigger effect that uses the stack entry's triggering permanent (as it last existed on the battlefield, CR 603.10a) (the sacrificed permanent's last-known card characteristics) to create a token copy; the handler creates the copy as one ordered token creation event (`TokenCopySupport.createTokenCopiesWithTokenRider`) and grants haste until end of turn and schedules the controller's next end-step pay-or-sacrifice action for every token it creates, added ones included. | `SacrificeUnlessReturnOwnPermanentTypeToHandEffect` | `(CardType permanentType)` | sacrifice this permanent unless you return a permanent of the specified type you control to its owner's hand (ETB bounce-or-sacrifice, e.g. Glint Hawk) |
| `SacrificeUnlessReturnPermanentTypeToHandEffect` | `(CardType permanentType)` | sacrifice this permanent unless you return a permanent of the specified type to its owner's hand; any player's matching permanent may be chosen (ETB bounce-or-sacrifice, e.g. Drake Familiar) |
| `SacrificeSelfUnlessSacrificeCreaturesWithTotalPowerEffect` | `(int requiredPower)` | sacrifice this permanent unless you sacrifice any number of creatures with total power `requiredPower` or greater (Phyrexian Dreadnought, 12). Excludes the source; auto-sacrifices the source when the other creatures' total effective power falls short, otherwise a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.SacrificeCreaturesWithTotalPowerOrSacrificeSource` prompt � an empty pick sacrifices the source, a pick below the threshold is rejected and the prompt stands |
| `ChampionCreatureEffect` | `(CardSubtype... championedSubtypes)` � no-arg ctor = any creature; multiple subtypes match inclusively ("Goblin or Shaman", Lightning Crafter) | champion a creature, or a permanent with one of the specified subtypes: on ETB sacrifice unless you exile another matching permanent you control; when this leaves the battlefield a triggered ability returns the exiled card. The ETB may still exile after its source has left. Uses `PermanentChoiceContext.ChampionCreature` + `exileReturnOnPermanentLeave`. Used by Changeling Hero. For a "when a creature is championed with this" follow-up trigger, write `addTrigger(Triggers.championsCreature(), effect)` � it fires from `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService.handleChampionCreature` right after the exile (player-targeting effects route through `PermanentChoiceContext.ChampionedTriggerTarget`; Mistbind Clique) |
| `DestroyNonlandPermanentsWithManaValueEqualToChargeCountersEffect` | `()` | destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on source (reads snapshotted count from xValue). Used by Ratchet Bomb |
| `DestroyNonlandPermanentsWithManaValueXDealtCombatDamageEffect` | `()` | destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to X whose controller was dealt combat damage by the source permanent this turn. Reads X from xValue, checks combatDamageToPlayersThisTurn. Used by Steel Hellkite |
| `TransformSelfEffect` + `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, creaturesYouControl()).thatCanHost(source())` + `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(source(), thisWay(CHOOSE))` | _compose_ | "transform this enchantment, then attach it to a creature you control" (Sidequest: Play Blitzball): not skippable, a lone creature chosen unasked |
| `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, controlledBy(you(), filter))` + `TransformSelfEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE))` | _compose_ | "transform an Incubator token you control" (Sunder the Gateway): the one candidate chosen unasked; `TransformSelfEffect(picked(PermanentIsDoubleFacedPredicate))` in a `MayEffect` is "if it's a double-faced card, you may transform it" after a put (Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.) |
| `SacrificeAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` or `(int damageToController)` | sacrifice the source at end of combat. With `damageToController > 0` ("sacrifice it and it deals N damage to you", Time Elemental = 5) the same delayed ability also carries `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(N, CONTROLLER)`. Resolution creates an end-of-combat delayed triggered ability (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStep`, `Triggers.endOfCombat()`) carrying `SacrificeSelfEffect`; the damage is dealt with last-known information, so it happens even if the creature already left the battlefield. Put on Triggers.attacks() / Triggers.blocks() |
| `DestroySelfAtEndOfCombatEffect` | — | **Gone**: `DestroyTargetPermanentAtEndOfCombatEffect(Subjects.source())` (Cinder Wall) |
| `PutSelfOnTopOfLibraryAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to be **put on top of its owner's library** at end of combat. "When this creature attacks or blocks, put it on top of its owner's library at end of combat." Put on Triggers.attacks() / Triggers.blocks(); schedules a delayed triggered ability for the end of combat (`DelayedPermanentActions.schedule`, CR 603.7a) that does `PUT_ON_TOP_OF_LIBRARY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT` as it resolves, and does nothing to a permanent that already left the battlefield. See Saprazzan Outrigger |
| `PutCounterOnCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount)` or `(…, boolean alsoTap)` | Put on Triggers.endOfCombat(): as the trigger resolves, puts counters on every creature still blocking or blocked by the source; Greater Werewolf uses this inside an intervening-if `SourceAttackedOrBlockedThisCombat` condition, Dread Wight with `PARALYZATION` and `alsoTap=true`. Counter placement respects `cantHaveCounters` Targets nothing. |
| `PutCounterOnCombatOpponentEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount[, CardEffect grantedStaticEffect, CardEffect grantedUpkeepEffect])` | puts counters on the **combat opponent** immediately on resolution. The card declares no target for it, so it acts on "that creature", the creature on the other side of the block, recorded as the entry's non-targeting `targetId` as the ability triggers. Placement respects counter prevention. Optional effects are granted persistently only when counters are placed; Mindbender Spores supplies its fungus-counter untap lock and upkeep-removal ability this way. Counter names have no intrinsic rules |
| `DestroyTargetPermanentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()`, `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated)`, `(PermanentSubject)`, `(boolean, PermanentSubject)`, `ofTriggeringPermanent()` | schedule the permanents the subject names for destruction at end of combat: `target()` (default; harmful CREATURE target, "destroy it at end of combat" riders, Goblin Sappers with `MakeCreatureUnblockableEffect`), `triggering()` ("destroy that creature at end of combat": the basilisks, Sosuke, Son of Seshiro) or `source()` ("when this creature blocks, destroy it at end of combat": Cinder Wall, Arrogant Bloodlord). Schedules a delayed triggered ability for the end of combat (`DelayedPermanentActions.schedule`, CR 603.7a) that does `DESTROY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT` as it resolves (regeneration/indestructible apply) and does nothing to a permanent that already left. `RemovalEffect` DESTROY except for `source()`. Unlike `DestroyCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` the target is chosen |
| `DealDamageToTargetCreatureAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(DynamicAmount damage)`; convenience `(int)` | schedule the **source** to deal `damage` damage to the **targeted** creature at end of combat � the delayed sibling of `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect`. The target is chosen on activation, the damage happens once combat ends. Resolution evaluates the amount and schedules a delayed triggered ability for the end of combat (CR 603.7a) carrying the source card, so last-known information still applies if the source left the battlefield; it goes on the stack and deals the damage as it resolves. `DamageDealingEffect` (creatures only); `targetSpec()` = harmful CREATURE. See Dwarven Sea Clan |
| `DestroyCombatOpponentsOfTargetAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` / `(boolean onlyCreaturesBlockedByTarget)` / `(boolean, boolean onlyWhileInCombat)` | One-shot end-of-combat destruction keyed to a chosen creature. The default mode destroys creatures that blocked or were blocked by it (Venomous Breath); the directional mode destroys only creatures blocked by it (Glyph of Doom). `onlyWhileInCombat` (Kjeldoran Frostbeast, source-trigger form) destroys nothing once the source has left combat, e.g. regenerated; it is off for the spell form, which reads turn history (Gaze of the Gorgon). Resolution creates a delayed triggered ability for this turn's next end of combat step (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStepThisTurn(Triggers.endOfCombat(), …)`) carrying the effect again, remembering the creature and its combat opponents so far; as that ability resolves it also reads the directional or bidirectional combat history, so blocks declared after the spell resolved are included. Regeneration and indestructible apply. `RemovalEffect` DESTROY; `targetSpec()` = harmful CREATURE `ofSourceWhileInCombat()`: the source's own non-targeting end-of-combat ability ("destroy all creatures blocking or blocked by this creature", Kjeldoran Frostbeast). |
| `GrantTrampleToCreaturesBlockedByTargetEffect` | `()` | "Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn" (Ride Down). The target is a currently blocking creature (`targetSpec()` = benign CREATURE narrowed by `PermanentIsBlockingPredicate`). Resolution snapshots its `blockingTargetIds`, grants trample to each surviving creature, and leaves the ordinary `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect()` to resolve next on the same target group |
| `TapCombatOpponentsOfTargetAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` / `(boolean schedule)` | One-shot delayed tap/untap-lock effect for Triton Tactics. The card form (`schedule=true`) has a benign creature `targetSpec()` and is bound to the spell's `target(TargetFilters.creature(), 0, 2)` group. Resolution creates one delayed triggered ability for this turn's next end of combat step (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStepThisTurn(Triggers.endOfCombat(), …)`, "this turn's next end of combat") carrying `(schedule=false)` and remembering the chosen creatures, and that trigger taps the deduplicated attackers they blocked (from `GameData.combatOpponentIdsBlockedByThisTurn`) with a one-untap-step lock. |
| `PutMinusOneCounterOnSourceAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to get a **-1/-1 counter at end of combat** (delayed, so it stays full size for the combat damage step — unlike the immediate `PutCountersOnSourceEffect(-1,-1,1)`). "Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, put a -1/-1 counter on it at end of combat." Put on Triggers.attacks() and/or Triggers.blocks(); creates an end-of-combat delayed triggered ability (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStep(Triggers.endOfCombat(), …)`) carrying `PutCountersOnSelfEffect(MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE)`, which uses the stack as the next end of combat step begins. See Wicker Warcrawler |
| `SacrificeTargetThenRevealUntilTypeToBattlefieldEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes)` | sacrifice the targeted permanent, then its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until a card matching one of the specified types is found; that card is put onto the battlefield under that player's control, and all other revealed cards are shuffled into their library. Polymorph-style effect (used by Shape Anew for artifact�artifact); an empty set is Reweave's mode: only if it was sacrificed, reveal a permanent card sharing a card type with its last-known types |
| `ExileEachTargetPermanentThenRevealUntilSharedCardTypeEffect` | `()` | exile each selected artifact, creature, enchantment, planeswalker, and/or land, then for each exiled permanent reveal its controller's library until a permanent card sharing a card type with it is found; put the found cards onto the battlefield and shuffle the other revealed cards back. Chaotic Transformation |
| `SacrificeTargetPermanentsThenRevealTopCardEffect` | `()` | sacrifice every selected target permanent, then each affected controller reveals the top card of their library and puts it onto the battlefield if it is a permanent card; nonpermanent cards remain on top. Used by Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire with `target(TargetFilters.permanent(), 0, 99)` and `AT_MOST_ONE_PER_CONTROLLER` |
| `RevealCreatureCardsToBattlefieldAndShuffleRestEffect` | — | **Gone**: the reveal-until step, the put step and a shuffle (Mass Polymorph, Synthetic Destiny). |
| `EachPlayerShufflesOwnedCreaturesIntoLibraryThenRevealsCreatureEffect` | `()` | shuffle each player's owned creature permanents into their owner's library; players who shuffled a nontoken creature reveal one creature card, all found creatures enter simultaneously, and the other revealed cards are put on the bottom in random order. Collision of Realms |
| `SeparateIntoPilesEffect` | `permanents(controlledBy(players, filter), label)` / `cards(graveyardCards, chooser, label)` | the pile step (CR 700.3): the controller separates the objects into two piles (either may be empty), a player chooses one; a CHOOSE step, `thisWay(CHOOSE)` / `cardsThisWay(CHOOSE)` the chosen pile, the other pile `except(set, thisWay(CHOOSE))`. Permanents: each named player's own are separated and that player chooses (Stand or Fall over `eachOpponent()`); a `targetPlayer()` set declares the target. Then the verb: `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE, creature), true)` (Do or Die), `SacrificeSelfEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE), targetPlayer())` (Liliana of the Veil), `CantAttackThisTurnEffect` / `CantBlockThisTurnEffect(except(controlledBy(...), thisWay(CHOOSE)))` (Fight or Flight, Stand or Fall), `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.cards(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE))` + `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(except(...))` after `ChoosePlayerEffect.opponent()` (Death or Glory) |
| `WhimsOfTheFatesEffect` | `()` | each player separates all permanents they control into three piles, then one pile is chosen uniformly at random for that player and sacrificed. The engine prompts each player for Pile 1 and Pile 2 in controller-first turn order; the unselected permanents form Pile 3, and all randomly selected permanents are sacrificed together |
| `MakeAnExampleEffect` | `()` | each opponent separates their creatures into two piles; the spell controller chooses one pile for each opponent to sacrifice. Uses `PendingPileSeparation` plus a per-opponent continuation state; the opponent makes the split and the controller makes the pile choice (Make an Example, `NCC` 37) |

### Sacrifice costs (for activated abilities)

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ExileSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackWithSource)` | exile this permanent as cost (e.g. Brittle Effigy); the tracking form associates the exiled card with the activating permanent |
| `UnattachEquipmentFromSourceCost` | `()` | activated-ability cost: choose any Equipment attached to the source permanent, unattach it, and snapshot its mana value as the ability's X value (Captain America, First Avenger) |
| `ExileSelfCost` | `()` | exile this permanent as cost (e.g. Brittle Effigy). Handled in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` via `removePermanentToExile` |
| `WaterbendCost` | `(int amount)` / `optional(int amount)` | Waterbend cost for abilities and casting cost (`addCastingCost`)s. Each untapped artifact or creature tapped while paying contributes one generic mana toward `amount`; available mana is used first and only the required number of qualifying permanents is tapped. `optional(int amount)` marks a spell cost that may be declined |
| `SacrificeSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackPower)` | sacrifice this permanent as cost. `trackPower=true` snapshots effective power into the stack entry's xValue at payment (last-known info). Pair with `CounterUnlessPaysEffect(0, true, false)` for "unless pays {X}, where X is this creature's power" (Mausoleum Wanderer) |
| `SacrificeSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackPower)`; `recordingPermanentSnapshot()` | sacrifice this permanent as cost. `trackPower=true` snapshots effective power into the stack entry's xValue at payment (last-known info). `recordingPermanentSnapshot()` preserves the source's last-known counters and attached Equipment IDs for later resolution. Pair with `CounterUnlessPaysEffect(0, true, false)` for "unless pays {X}, where X is this creature's power" (Mausoleum Wanderer) |
| `RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` or `(CounterType counterType, boolean fromGrantingEquipment)` | additional cost: remove all counters of the given type from the source. The number removed is snapshotted into the ability's xValue (in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService`, via `Permanent.getCounterCount`/`setCounterCount`) before the counters are cleared, so a companion effect (e.g. `LookAtTopCardsEffect` with an `XValue()` look count) scales with the count removed. Used by Jar of Eyeballs (`CounterType.EYEBALL`). `fromGrantingEquipment = true` pays from the Equipment that granted the ability instead of the activating permanent — Hankyu's "{T}, Remove all aim counters from Hankyu: This creature deals damage to any target equal to the number of aim counters removed this way" (`RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect(AIM, true)` + `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new XValue())`). Contrast `RemoveAllCountersEffect`, which is a resolution effect snapshotting into the event value |
| `RemoveAllCountersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, PermanentSubject subject)`; convenience `(CounterType)` = `Subjects.source()`; `Subjects.triggering()` in a delayed ability is "the creature" it is about (Giant Oyster) | resolution effect (not a cost): remove all counters of the given type from the subject (`source()` = this permanent, non-targeting; `target()` = benign `TargetPredicates.creature()`, the card's own target filter narrows further — Hapatra's Mark) and snapshot the removed count as the entry's *event value*, so a later effect on the same entry reads "that much" via `EventValue` � e.g. Ashling the Pilgrim's `ConditionalEffect(NthAbilityResolutionThisTurn(3), RemoveAllCountersEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE))` + `ConditionalEffect(..., MassDamageEffect(new EventValue(), true))`. Contrast `RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect`, which is paid at activation and snapshots into xValue. `source()` acts on the entry's source (Ammit Eternal on `Triggers.dealsCombatDamageToPlayer()`), `target()` on a target creature |
| `RemoveCountersToCreateTetraviteTokensEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | Tetravus upkeep trigger 1 ("you may remove any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature. If you do, create that many � tokens"). Its handler prompts a 0..N number choice (`ChoiceContext.TetravusCounterRemoval`; 0 = decline, so no `MayEffect` wrapper); the completion in `ChoiceHandlerService` removes that many +1/+1 counters and creates that many tokens from `tokenTemplate`, adding each created id to `GameData.sourceCreatedTokens` (source permanent id � token id set) as "created with" the source. Does nothing if the source has no +1/+1 counters |
| `RemoveAllCountersOfTypeFromAllPermanentsEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` | remove every counter of that type from every permanent on every battlefield. Corrosion LTB ("remove all rust counters from all permanents") |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromMatchingPermanentsEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, PermanentPredicate predicate)` | remove every counter of that type from every permanent matching `predicate` across all battlefields. Mine Layer LTB uses `PermanentIsLandPredicate` for "remove all mine counters from all lands" |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromAllPermanentsEffect` | `()` | resolution effect that removes every concrete counter from every permanent on every battlefield (Aether Snap) |
| `EachOpponentLosesAllCountersEffect` | `()` | removes all tracked player counters (poison, energy, spark, and experience) from each opponent of the effect controller without locking future counters (Final Act) |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromAllPermanentsThenEnterWithCountersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` | as-enters replacement: removes every concrete counter from every permanent and makes the entering permanent receive one counter of `counterType` for each counter removed (Thief of Blood) |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromChosenPermanentsThenEnterWithCountersEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, CounterType counterType, int multiplier)` | as-enters replacement: the controller chooses any number of matching permanents, removes every concrete counter from them, and makes the entering permanent receive `multiplier` counters of `counterType` for each counter removed (Sin, Unending Cataclysm) |
| `ExileTetraviteTokensToPutCountersOnSelfEffect` | `()` | Tetravus upkeep trigger 2 ("you may exile any number of tokens created with this creature. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature"). Its handler gathers the source's still-alive tracked tokens from `GameData.sourceCreatedTokens` (any controller) and opens a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ExileTetraviteTokensPutCountersOnSource` multi-permanent choice; the completion in `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService` exiles the chosen tokens and puts that many +1/+1 counters on the source. Does nothing if the source has no surviving tokens |
| `SacrificeCreatureCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower, boolean trackSacrificedToughness)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower, boolean trackSacrificedToughness, boolean excludeSelf)` | sacrifice a creature as cost. When `trackSacrificedManaValue=true`, the sacrificed creature's mana value is stored in the StackEntry's xValue (e.g. Birthing Pod). When `trackSacrificedPower=true`, the sacrificed creature's effective power (including static bonuses) is stored in xValue (e.g. Ichor Explosion). When `trackSacrificedToughness=true`, the sacrificed creature's effective toughness is stored in xValue (e.g. Disciple of Griselbrand). When `excludeSelf=true`, the source permanent cannot be chosen as the sacrifice target � use for "Sacrifice another creature" costs (e.g. Grimgrin, Corpse-Born) |
| `SacrificePermanentOrPayManaCost` | `(String manaCost, PermanentPredicate filter, String description)` | additional cast cost: sacrifice a matching permanent **or** pay `manaCost`. Exactly one option — `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` selects sacrifice; null pays the mana on top of the spell's mana cost. Used by Eaten Alive for creatures and Annihilating Glare for artifacts or creatures. Handled by `AdditionalSpellCostService` / `SpellCastingService` |
| `PayLifeOrPayManaCost` | `(int lifeAmount, String manaCost)` | additional cast cost: pay the fixed life amount **or** pay `manaCost`. `PlayCardRequest.payLifeForAdditionalCost=true` selects life; false or absent selects mana. Handled by `AdditionalSpellCostService` / `SpellCastingService` |
| `DiscardCardOrPayManaCost` | `(String manaCost)` | additional cast cost: discard a card **or** pay `manaCost` (Lightning Axe: `"{5}"`). Exactly one option � `PlayCardRequest.discardHandCardIndex` selects discard; null pays the mana on top of the spell's mana cost. Satisfiable with another hand card or enough mana for the combined cost. Handled by `AdditionalSpellCostService` / `SpellCastingService` |
| `SacrificePermanentCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description, boolean excludeSource)` | sacrifice a permanent matching filter as cost. Works for spell costs, activated abilities (via `MultiplePermanentSacrificeCostHandler`), and predicate-backed forced costs. Uses `PredicateEvaluationService.matchesPermanentPredicate()` for validation. Use `PermanentAllOfPredicate(List.of(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(subtype)))` with `excludeSource=false` for "Sacrifice a [subtype]" creature costs that can sacrifice the source. The 4-arg form adds `trackSacrificedPower` � snapshots the sacrificed permanent's effective power into the ability's xValue at payment (the predicate-based sibling of `SacrificeCreatureCost(false, true)`), read back via `XValue`. Freyalise Supplicant: half that power via `Divided(new XValue(), 2)`. The 5-arg form adds `trackSacrificedManaValue` � snapshots the sacrificed permanent's mana value into xValue instead (Soldevi Adnate: `AwardManaEffect(BLACK, new XValue())`; mana abilities read xValue via `AmountContext.forManaAbility(source, controller, xValue)`) |
| `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | sacrifice N permanents matching filter as cost (e.g. "Sacrifice three artifacts: ..." with `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`). Multi-step UI: if exactly N match, auto-sacrifices all; otherwise prompts one-at-a-time. Validated and paid in `AbilityActivationService`. Also valid as a spell's additional cast cost (`addCastingCost`) ("As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice two creatures" � Phyrexian Tribute, `(2, PermanentIsCreaturePredicate)`); the chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds` and are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService` + `SpellCastingService` before any mana is spent. Harness: `castSorceryWithSacrifices(player, index, targetId, ids)` |
| `SacrificeDistinctNamePermanentsCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | activation-only cost that chooses N matching permanents with distinct names, retaining the chosen permanents until the final pick before sacrificing them (Transmutation Font) |
| `TapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | **Spell** additional cast cost (`addCastingCost`): "As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap any number of untapped permanents you control matching filter" (Burn at the Stake, `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`). Any count including **zero** is legal, so it never blocks castability. The number tapped becomes the spell's X value, so a companion effect scales with it (Burn at the Stake pairs it with `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new Scaled(new XValue(), 3))`). Chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds` (shared with `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost` / `ReturnAnyNumberOfPermanentsToHandCost` — no spell carries more than one) and are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService.validateTapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` + `SpellCastingService.payTapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` before any mana is spent. Harness: `castSorceryTappingPermanents(player, index, targetId, ids)`. Contrast `TapMultiplePermanentsCost` (activated-ability only) |
| `TapCreaturesForManaCost` | `()` | **Spell cost (`addCastingCost`) or activated-ability cost**: tap any number of untapped creatures you control; each tapped creature reduces the spell or ability's generic mana cost by `{1}`. As a spell cost, selected creatures ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds`, are validated before mana payment, and are tapped after the reduced spell cost is paid. ## Counter spells

"Counter that spell" of a cast trigger is `Triggers.playerCastsSpell()` with a filter and `CounterSpellEffect()`: the stack door puts it on the stack aimed at the triggering spell, which isn't a target: Chalice of the Void's `StackEntryManaValueEqualsSourceCountersPredicate(CHARGE)` (the counters as the spell is cast) and Void Mirror's `StackEntryNotPredicate(StackEntryColoredManaSpentPredicate)` are the stack-entry filters, and Cephalid Shrine's `CounterUnlessPaysEffect(CardsInGraveyard(CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate, ANY_PLAYER))` reads the spell's name as it resolves.


`RevealTopCardAndCounterTriggeringSpellIfMatchesEffect(RevealedCardMatch match, boolean spellControllerMayCastFree)` is a `Triggers.opponentCastsSpell()` resolved effect, wrapped in `MayEffect` for the optional reveal. It reveals the source controller's top library card, leaves it on top, and counters the spell that caused the trigger when the two match: `RevealedCardMatch.SAME_MANA_VALUE` compares mana values, X included (Counterbalance: `(SAME_MANA_VALUE, false)`); `SHARES_CARD_TYPE` checks for a shared card type (Swindler's Scheme on `.castFrom(Zone.HAND)`: `(SHARES_CARD_TYPE, true)`). With `spellControllerMayCastFree`, a match also offers the triggering spell's controller a free cast of the revealed nonland card from that library; declined, the card stays on top. The ability doesn't target the spell (the spell is its entry's triggering card), so it still resolves after the spell was countered in response (CR 608.2b); only the counter is skipped then, and the match reads the spell's last known information.
