## Bounce / return to hand

| `ReturnTargetPermanentsWithinTotalManaValueEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, int maxTotalManaValue)` or `withinTotalManaValue(filter, maxTotalManaValue)` | return any number of target permanents matching `filter` to their owners' hands when their combined mana value is at most the configured limit; selection and resolution both enforce the aggregate limit |
| `DestroyTargetPermanentsWithinTotalManaValueEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, DynamicAmount totalManaValueLimit)` or `withinTotalManaValue(filter, totalManaValueLimit)` | destroy any number of target permanents matching `filter` when their combined mana value is at most the evaluated limit; selection and resolution both enforce the aggregate limit. Used by Rampaging Yao Guai (PIP 82) |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentsThenEffect` | `countingCardsReturnedToYourHand(CardEffect thenEffect)` | Paradoxical Outcome only: bounce the targets, then the rider with the number of cards (a melded permanent's components each) returned to the controller's own hand. Anything else is `ReturnToHandEffect.target()` then a step reading RETURN: "If you do" / "if a permanent was returned this way" `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.returned(), X)`, "for each permanent returned this way" `AmountThisWay(StepKind.RETURN)`, "its mana value" `TargetManaValue` |

| `DelayedEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` | schedules the wrapped non-targeting ability to trigger at the beginning of the end-of-combat step. The delayed trigger preserves the source card and controller even if the source permanent leaves the battlefield. The scheduling ability's non-targeting permanent ("that creature", the creature on the other side of a block) is the delayed ability's non-targeting target, with what was attached to it just before it left the battlefield if it has (CR 608.2h). Use Triggers.attacks() / Triggers.blocks() for delayed instructions such as Fickle Efreet's end-of-combat coin flip, or Corrosive Ooze's `new DelayedEndOfCombatEffect(new DestroyAttachmentsOnTargetCreatureEffect(false, true))` |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ReturnToHandEffect` | static factories, or `(PermanentSubject subject)` | bounce the permanents the `PermanentSubject` names to their owners' hands (`SubjectResolutionService`; a target or `triggering()` one at a time with the controller rider, `source()` as itself, every other subject as one simultaneous leave batch); `withSubject` / `withFilter` copy it. Factories: `target()` (bounce the chosen target); `targetWithCastTimeXValue(DynamicAmount)` (targeted bounce whose X-scaled target cap is evaluated from game state as the spell is cast — Aether Burst); `targetAndControllerLosesLife(int)` (Vapor Snag — controller, snapshotted before the bounce, loses N); `targetAndControllerDraws(int)` (Call to Heel — controller, snapshotted before the bounce, draws N); `self()` (bounce the source; declares source-self targeting so the triggered ability's entry keeps the source id); `allPermanentsMatching(PermanentPredicate filter)` (every permanent matching `filter` across all battlefields, null = every permanent — Evacuation uses `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`); `permanentsTargetPlayerControls(filter)` (River's Rebuke — `controlledBy(targetPlayer(), filter)`; makes the spec player-targeting); `permanentsTargetPlayerOwns(filter)` (Hurkyl's Recall — `ownedBy(targetPlayer(), filter)`, the card's owner whoever controls it; makes the spec player-targeting); `aurasAttachedToTarget()` (Scarab of the Unseen — `attachmentsOf(target(), Aura)`); `enchanted()` (bounce the permanent the source Aura is attached to — Sun Clasp; non-targeting; subject `attached()`, whose last-known lookup still finds the host of a self-sacrificing Aura — Phantom Wings); `enchantedAndAuras()` (`allOf(attachmentsOf(attached(), Aura), attached())`: the source Aura's enchanted permanent and all Auras attached to it, the Auras first — Mark of Eviction); `grantingEquipment()` (`granter()`, bound at activation by `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` — Trusty Boomerang); `triggering()`; `targetAndSelf()`; `targetCreaturesOfChosenType()`; `targetNonlandPermanentOrSuspendedCard()`; `selfSpell()` (no subject) |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentToHandAndReduceControllerSpeedEffect` | `()` | returns the target permanent to its owner's hand, then reduces its controller's speed by one only when that speed is greater than every other player's speed, never below 1. The handler snapshots the controller before the bounce. Used by Spikeshell Harrier. |
| `ReturnCreaturesBlockingOrBlockedByTargetEffect` | `()` | returns every creature blocking or blocked by the targeted creature to its owner's hand, excluding the target itself. |
| `ReturnAllPermanentsOfChosenColorToHandEffect` | — | **Gone**: `SequenceEffect.of(ChooseColorAtResolutionEffect(), ReturnToHandEffect.allPermanentsMatching(PermanentHasChosenSpellColorPredicate()), ClearChosenColorEffect())` (Wash Out, Dromar) |
| `ReturnAllCreaturesExceptChosenTypeToHandEffect` | — | **Gone**: `ChooseCreatureTypeAtResolutionEffect() + ReturnToHandEffect.allPermanentsMatching(creature without PermanentHasTypeChosenThisResolutionPredicate)` |
| `ReturnAllPermanentsOfColorToHandEffect` | — | **Gone**: `ReturnToHandEffect(Subjects.controlledBy(Subjects.eachOpponent(), filter with PermanentColorInPredicate))` (Llawan) |
| `ReturnToHandEffect.targetCreatureAndAttached` | `(PermanentPredicate attachedFilter)` | bounce target creature and every attached permanent matching `attachedFilter` to their owners' hands as one simultaneous event (leave abilities look back, CR 603.10a). Hubris (Aura), Word of Undoing `AllOf(Aura subtype, ColorIn(WHITE), OwnedBySourceController)`. `RemovalEffect` BOUNCE |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentToHandOrLibraryTopByPredicateEffect` | — | **Gone**: `ConditionalReplacementEffect(TargetPermanentMatches(filter), ReturnToHandEffect.target(), PutTargetOnTopOfLibraryEffect())` (Consign to Dream) |
| `ReturnPermanentControlledByPlayerToHandEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String noun[, boolean controllerChooses])` / `controller(filter, noun)` / `byPlayer(PlayerSubject player, filter, noun)` (that player chooses and returns: "choose a player. They return a creature they control", Multiple Choice) / `choosingOneOf(PermanentSubject candidates, String noun)` | a player returns a permanent they control matching `filter` to its owner's hand. The acting player is the entry's `targetId` if set, else the resolving controller. On `Triggers.dealsDamageToPlayer()`, the damaged player is the entry's non-targeting `targetId`, recorded as the ability triggers; `controllerChooses=true` makes the trigger controller choose the permanent (Sigil of Sleep). On a filtered cast trigger (`Triggers.playerCastsSpell().anySpell()`) the caster is recorded as the entry's non-targeting `targetId` (Mana Breach, `PermanentIsLandPredicate`); wrap in `MayEffect` on a controller ability for "you may return a land you control" (Kefnet the Mindful); `Triggers.attacks()` for "return another creature you control" (Havengul Skaab, `AllOf(IsCreature, Not(IsSourceCard))`). Resolver collects that player's matching permanents and prompts via the shared `BounceCreature` choice context (`noun` fills the prompt; none matching ? nothing). A RETURN step that ends on the choice: "If you do" is `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.returned(), X)` after it (wrap both in `MayEffect` for "you may return"), "if another Desert was returned this way" `HappenedThisWay.toA(StepKind.RETURN, filter)` (Arid Archway); `controller(filter, noun)` for "you return"; `choosingOneOf(Subjects.triggeringAll(), noun)` for "return one of them" (Kaito, Dancing Shadow), `choosingOneOf(Subjects.ownedBy(Subjects.you(), filter), noun)` for "a permanent you own" (Phenomenon Investigators) |

| `ReturnTopCreatureCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(PlayerSubject graveyardOwner, boolean assignNoCombatDamageIfReturned)` | put the top creature card of a graveyard onto the battlefield **under the effect controller's control**. `graveyardOwner` = `you()` (your own) or `defendingPlayer()` (Bone Dancer); it may not declare a target. "Top creature card" = the creature card closest to the top (the most recently put there); noncreature cards sitting above it are skipped, not blockers. Non-targeting, no-op with no creature card in the graveyard. `assignNoCombatDamageIfReturned` adds the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId` to a floating prevention effect **only when a card was actually returned** — the "if you do" half of Bone Dancer, which a `SequenceEffect` with `AssignNoCombatDamageEffect` would get wrong on an empty graveyard. Mistmoon Griffin uses `(you(), false)` as the second step of `SequenceEffect.of(ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect(), it)` on `Triggers.dies(THIS)` — one trigger, and the Griffin must leave the graveyard first or it would be its own top creature card; Bone Dancer uses `MayEffect(new …(defendingPlayer(), true))` on `Triggers.attacksUnblocked()` |
| `ReturnMatchingPermanentsUnlessOwnerPaysEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String manaCost)` | `BoardWipeEffect` (`sweepsBoard()` always true); punisher mass bounce — every permanent matching `filter` across ALL battlefields returns to its owner's hand unless that permanent's OWNER pays `manaCost`. The payer is the owner, NOT the controller — "return it to its owner's hand unless that player pays" names the owner and then refers back to them, so the player who may pay is always the one whose hand would receive the permanent (they differ only once it has changed hands). The handler resolves the owner with the engine's battlefield convention `stolenCreatures.getOrDefault(id, controllerId)`, matching `PermanentRemovalService.removePermanentToHand`. Each matching permanent is an independent decision made by its own owner, offered one at a time through the may-ability system in APNAP order BY OWNER (CR 101.4); declining, or accepting without the mana, bounces it and moves on. Cut the Tethers = `(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SPIRIT), "{3}")` |

## Graveyard return

- `DefendingPlayerChoosesCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect.withoutRiders(CardPredicate)` — defending-player graveyard choice with no additional subtype or counter rider; the one-argument form remains the Drana variant

- `ReturnTargetPermanentFromOpponentGraveyardToHandThenDefendingPlayerChoosesPermanentFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate)` — combat-damage trigger: return the targeted permanent card from the damaged player's graveyard to its owner's hand; only if it returns, that player chooses a permanent card from the controller's graveyard to put onto the battlefield under the controller's control

- `PutTargetPlayerGraveyardOnBottomOfLibraryEffect` — **Gone**: `PutCardsIntoLibraryEffect.onBottomInRandomOrder(cardsInGraveyards(targetPlayer(), null))`.

- `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(CardPredicate, int, CounterType, int)` — fixed-cap targeted reanimation with a counter rider applied to each permanent that enters.
- `ReturnTargetCreatureAndSameNameCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` — targets a creature card in the controller's graveyard, then returns it and every other card with the same name to the battlefield tapped. Reuses the targeted graveyard-return batch handler for simultaneous entry.
- `ReturnTargetCreatureAndSameNameCardsFromGraveyardToHandEffect()` — targets a creature card in the controller's graveyard, then returns it and every other same-name card from that graveyard to the controller's hand. Only the creature card is targeted. Used by Echoing Return.

Second Sunrise uses `EachPlayerReturnsCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(Integer.MAX_VALUE, filter, true)` with a `CardAnyOfPredicate` for artifact, creature, enchantment, and land cards, so each player returns only those qualifying cards put into their graveyard from the battlefield this turn.

### Unified effect: `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`

| `ExperienceCountersEffect` | `(int amount)` | adds experience counters to the resolving controller |
| `CoolnessEffect` | `(int amount)` | adds percentage points to the resolving controller's persistent coolness total. Used by Rainbow Dash |
| `ResetCoolnessEffect` | `()` | resets the resolving controller's persistent coolness total to 0%. Used by Rainbow Dash |

All graveyard-to-hand and graveyard-to-battlefield return effects are handled by a single unified record.

**Builder pattern:**
```
ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder()
    .destination(GraveyardChoiceDestination)   // HAND, BATTLEFIELD, or TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY (required)
    .filter(CardPredicate)                     // which cards qualify (default: null = any)
    .sourceChosenSubtype(boolean)               // true = match cards of the source permanent's chosen subtype (default: false)
    .source(GraveyardSearchScope)              // default: CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD � omit unless ALL_GRAVEYARDS or OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD
    .targetGraveyard(boolean)                  // true = player chooses whose graveyard to search at cast time (default: false)
    .returnAll(boolean)                        // true = return all matching cards, false = choose one (default: false)
    .eventCardIdsOnly(boolean)                 // true = only the cards a preceding event on this stack entry recorded, else the entry's triggering cards ("one of them")
    .thisTurnOnly(boolean)                     // true = only CREATURE cards put there from battlefield this turn (default: false)
    .fromBattlefieldThisTurn(boolean)          // true = ALL cards (any type) put there from battlefield this turn (default: false; Twilight Shepherd, Faith's Reward)
    .fromAnywhereThisTurn(boolean)             // true = only cards put there from any zone this turn (default: false)
    .discardedOrCycledThisTurn(boolean)        // true = only cards the controller cycled or discarded this turn (default: false; Shadow of the Grave)
    .discardedByOpponentThisTurn(boolean)      // true = only cards discarded because of an opponent's spell or ability (default: false; Pure Intentions)
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have come from the battlefield this turn
                                               //   card put into that graveyard from the battlefield this turn
                                               //   (default: false; Grim Return). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads creatureCardsPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurn(boolean)    // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have been put
                                               //   into a graveyard from anywhere this turn (default: false;
                                               //   Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads cardsPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurn
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn(boolean)      // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have been put
                                               //   into a graveyard from a library this turn (default: false;
                                               //   Captain N'ghathrod). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads cardsPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn
    .targetDiscardedOrPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have
                                               //   been discarded or put into a graveyard from a library this turn
                                               //   (default: false; Ghost of Ramirez DePietro). Pairs with
                                               //   targetGraveyard(true)
    .targetNotPutIntoGraveyardThisCombat(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must not have been put
                                                  //   into a graveyard during the current combat phase
                                                  //   (default: false; Storrev, Devkarin Lich)
    .attachmentTarget(PermanentPredicate)      // non-null = aura attaches to matching permanent on ETB (default: null)
    .chooseAuraAttachment(boolean)              // true = a returned Aura's controller chooses any legal
                                               //   permanent or player for it to enchant as it enters
    .gainLifeEqualToManaValue(boolean)         // true = controller gains life equal to returned card's mana value (default: false)
    .loseLifeEqualToManaValue(boolean)         // true = controller loses life equal to returned card's mana value (default: false);
                                               //   pre-targeted path only (Reanimate); life loss via LifeSupport, so triggers fire
    .attachToSource(boolean)                   // true = attach the returned card to the source permanent (default: false).
                                               //   search-and-choose path: optional "you may attach" prompt after ETB (Auriok Survivors)
                                               //   pre-targeted BATTLEFIELD path: mandatory, prompt-free � the Aura enters already
                                               //   attached; fizzles if the source is gone or the Aura can't enchant it (Hakim, Loreweaver)
    .grantHaste(boolean)                       // true = grant haste to the returned permanent (default: false)
    .grantKeywords(Set<Keyword>)                // non-empty = grant these keywords indefinitely to the returned permanent
    .battlefieldEffectGrants(List<CardEffect>)  // static effects continuously granted to each returned battlefield permanent;
                                               // a loses-all-abilities grant is applied before entry as well
    .perpetuallySetBasePowerToSourcePower(boolean) // true = perpetually set each returned battlefield card's base power
                                               // to the resolving source permanent's effective power (Forgefire Automaton)
    .battlefieldEffectGrantDuration(Duration) // duration of those grants; defaults to PERMANENT
    .sacrificeAtEndStep(boolean)               // true = sacrifice the returned permanent at the next end step
    .exileAtEndStep(boolean)                   // true = exile at the next end step (default: false). Unearth's extra
    .exileAtYourNextEndStep(boolean)            // true = exile at the returned permanent controller's next end step
                                               //   "exile it instead if it would leave the battlefield" clause is the
                                               //   separate .exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true) � pair the two for Unearth /
                                               //   Postmortem Lunge; Shallow Grave uses exileAtEndStep alone
    .topmost(boolean)                          // true = return the topmost matching card of the controller's ordered
                                               //   graveyard with no prompt at all (default: false); Shallow Grave
    .requiresManaValueEqualsX(boolean)         // true = restrict to cards with MV = X (default: false); X is the spell's or ability's own X (CR 107.3), never a trigger event's value: for "equal to the damage dealt / that spell's mana value" put CardManaValueEqualsEventValuePredicate in the filter
    .manaValueXOffset(int)                     // offset added to X for an exact/at-most MV restriction (default: 0)
    .requiresManaValueAtMostX(boolean)         // true = restrict to cards with MV ? X (default: false); e.g. Profane Command
    .dynamicMaxManaValue(DynamicAmount)        // mana value limit; a triggered ability's "X or less, where X is the damage dealt" is new EventValue() and "lesser mana value" than the sacrificed creature new Sum(new TriggeringCardManaValue(), new Fixed(-1)), read from the trigger record as the target is chosen and from the entry as it resolves; a death trigger's is evaluated as its target is chosen, with the dying object as it last existed as the amount's source (soulshift X, "lesser mana value"), and kept on the stack entry
    .maxManaValueEqualsLifeGainedThisTurn(boolean) // true = restrict to cards with MV <= life gained this turn (default: false); e.g. Moseo
    .maxManaValueEqualsLifeLostThisTurn(boolean) // true = restrict to cards with MV <= life lost this turn (default: false); e.g. Betor
    .grantColor(CardColor)                     // non-null = permanently grant this color "in addition to" (default: null)
    .grantSubtype(CardSubtype)                 // non-null = permanently grant this subtype "in addition to" (default: null)
    .enterWithCounters(Set<CounterType>)       // one counter of each listed type is placed on the returned permanent as it enters
    .enterTapped(boolean)                      // true = enters the battlefield tapped (default: false)
    .underOwnersControl(boolean)               // true = put each card onto battlefield under its owner's control (default: false)
    .returnAtRandom(boolean)                   // true = return a random matching card instead of player choice (default: false)
    .battlefieldIfCreatureElseHand(boolean)    // true = route each returned card by type — creature cards to the battlefield,
                                               //   everything else to hand (default: false); returnAtRandom path only, overrides
                                               //   destination (Deadbridge Chant)
    .battlefieldIfCreatureElseExile(boolean)   // true = route each randomly selected card by type — creature cards to the
                                               //   battlefield, everything else to exile (default: false); returnAtRandom path only
    .shuffleGraveyardBeforeRandomSelection(boolean) // true = randomly reorder the controller's graveyard before the random selection
                                               //   (default: false); returnAtRandom path only (Search for Survivors)
    .choosePermanentType(boolean)              // true = prompt controller to choose a permanent type at resolution, then return all matching (default: false); implies returnAll
    .exileSourceFromGraveyard(boolean)         // true = exile the source card from graveyard before selecting random cards (default: false); e.g. Moldgraf Monstrosity
    .grantSourceHasteIfSubtype(CardSubtype)    // non-null = source permanent gains haste until end of turn if the returned card has this subtype (default: null); HAND search-and-choose only; e.g. Warren Pilferers (Goblin)
    .greatestPower(boolean)                    // true = restrict the (mandatory) controller's-graveyard search-and-choose to the matching card(s) with greatest power; single card auto-forced, ties chosen and cannot be declined (default: false); e.g. Desecrator Hag
    .exileIfLeavesBattlefield(boolean)         // true = set exile-if-leaves replacement on the returned permanent (default: false); Dreams of the Dead, Unearth
    .exileIfDying(boolean)                      // true = set "if this creature would die, exile it instead" on the returned permanent (default: false); Can't Stay Away
    .grantCumulativeUpkeepCost(String)         // non-null = grant that Cumulative upkeep cost as a persistent Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU) ability (default: null); Dreams of the Dead "{2}"
    .plusOneCountersIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(CardSubtype) // condition keyed to the exiled additional-cost card snapshot
    .counterIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(CounterType) // counter type placed when that subtype condition matches
    .counterCountIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(int) // number of those counters to place
    .plusOneCountersIfCardType(CardType)       // non-null = only add the plusOneCounterCount counters when the returned permanent currently has this card type
    .linkToSource(boolean)                     // true = bond the reanimated permanent to the source permanent's chosenPermanentId (default: false); pre-targeted BATTLEFIELD path only; pair with RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect triggers; Coffin Queen
    .grantOnDeathEffect(CardEffect)            // non-null = add this persistent Triggers.dies(THIS) ability to each returned battlefield permanent; owner-dependent TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect(null) is bound to the returned card's graveyard owner
    .build()
```

Only `destination` is required. All booleans default to `false`, all object references default to `null`, and `source` defaults to `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD`. Only set fields that differ from defaults.

Use `manaValueXOffset` when the mana-value restriction is derived from X, such as a target with mana value X plus one after a sacrificed creature's mana value is tracked, or a target with mana value less than X (`requiresManaValueAtMostX(true)` with offset `-1`).

On the pre-targeted `BATTLEFIELD` path, a card reanimated out of a **different player's** graveyard is registered in `GameData.stolenCreatures` automatically (with the matching PERMANENT control effect), so it dies to its owner's graveyard rather than the reanimator's — no card-side flag needed.

**CardPredicate filter system** (in `model/filter/`):

| Predicate | Constructor | Matches |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `CardTypePredicate` | `(CardType cardType)` | cards of a given type (CREATURE, ARTIFACT, etc.) |
| `CardSubtypePredicate` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | cards of a given subtype (ZOMBIE, GOBLIN, etc.) |
| `CardKeywordPredicate` | `(Keyword keyword)` | cards with a given keyword (INFECT, FLYING, etc.) |
| `CardIsSelfPredicate` | `()` | only the source card itself (Squee-style self-return) |
| `CardIsTriggeringCardPredicate` | `()` | the card the triggered ability's event was about ("it", "that card"); `CardNotPredicate` of it is "other" than the dying creature (Illicit Masquerade, Puca's Covenant), bound as the target is chosen |
| `CardIsAuraPredicate` | `()` | aura cards |
| `CardIsAuraEnchantCreaturePredicate` | `()` | Aura cards with enchant creature (read from the Aura's spell target filter) |
| `CardIsPermanentPredicate` | `()` | permanent cards (creature, artifact, enchantment, planeswalker, land, kindred � not instant/sorcery) |
| `CardMaxManaValuePredicate` | `(int maxManaValue)` | cards with mana value ? maxManaValue |
| `CardMinManaValuePredicate` | `(int minManaValue[, boolean includeXValue])` | cards with mana value ?A minManaValue; `includeXValue=true` includes the announced X value when evaluated for a spell being cast |
| `CardSupertypePredicate` | `(CardSupertype supertype)` | cards with a given supertype (BASIC, LEGENDARY) |
| `CardColorPredicate` | `(CardColor color)` | cards that ARE the colour � the colour is present among `getColors()` (multicolour-aware per CR 105.2c; a Black-Green card matches both `CardColorPredicate(BLACK)` and `CardColorPredicate(GREEN)`, order-independent). Used by "whenever a {colour} spell is cast" triggers and colour-filtered searches (Green Sun's Zenith) |
| `CardNotPredicate` | `(CardPredicate predicate)` | NOT � inverts a predicate |
| `CardAllOfPredicate` | `(List<CardPredicate> predicates)` | AND � all predicates must match |
| `CardAnyOfPredicate` | `(List<CardPredicate> predicates)` | OR � any predicate matches |

Pass `null` as filter to allow any card.

`AnimateReturnedPermanentIfNotCreatureEffect(AnimatePermanentsEffect animation)` is an unbound
graveyard-return rider. It locates the permanent created by the preceding targeted battlefield
return, and applies the supplied permanent animation only when the returned card was not a
creature card. The nested animation must use `Subjects.target()` with `PERMANENT` duration.

**GraveyardSearchScope enum** (in `model/`):

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD` | search only the controller's graveyard (default) |
| `ALL_GRAVEYARDS` | search any player's graveyard |
| `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` | search only opponent's graveyard |

**GraveyardChoiceDestination enum** (in `model/`):

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `HAND` | return chosen card(s) to hand |
| `BATTLEFIELD` | put chosen card(s) onto battlefield |
| `TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY` | put card on top of its owner's library (e.g. Noxious Revival) |
| `BOTTOM_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY` | put card on the bottom of its owner's library (e.g. Mistveil Plains) |

**Migration from old effects:**

| Old effect | New equivalent |
|------------|----------------|
| `ReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).targetGraveyard(true).build()` |
| `ReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect(CardType.CREATURE)` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build()` |
| `ReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandOfOpponentsChoiceEffect(CardPredicate)` | targeted controller-graveyard return to hand; the controller chooses which opponent makes the target choice, then the chosen opponent selects the matching card through the trigger-time graveyard targeting flow (Mausoleum Turnkey) |
| `ReturnCardOfSubtypeFromGraveyardToHandEffect(subtype)` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardSubtypePredicate(subtype)).build()` |
| `ReturnCardWithKeywordFromGraveyardToHandEffect(type, kw)` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardAllOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(type), new CardKeywordPredicate(kw)))).build()` |
| `ReturnSelfFromGraveyardToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).build()` |
| `ReturnCreatureFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build()` |
| `ReturnTargetCreatureFromGraveyardToBattlefieldOrHandByManaValueEffect(DynamicAmount)` | target a creature card in the controller's graveyard; at resolution, return it to the battlefield when its mana value is at most the evaluated amount, otherwise to its owner's hand |
| `ReturnArtifactOrCreatureFromAnyGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardAnyOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(ARTIFACT), new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)))).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).build()` |
| `TargetOpponentChoosesCardFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate)` | target opponent chooses a matching card in their graveyard; put it onto the battlefield under the controller's control |
| `TargetOpponentChoosesCardFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate, List<CardEffect>)` | target opponent chooses a matching card in their graveyard; put it onto the battlefield under the controller's control and keep the listed effects on that permanent |
| `DefendingPlayerChoosesCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(CardPredicate)` | `Triggers.attacks()`: defending player chooses a matching card from the controller's graveyard; put it onto the controller's battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and an additional Vampire subtype |
| `ReturnAuraFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).attachmentTarget(attachmentTarget).build()` |
| `ReturnTargetCreatureAndAurasOrEquipmentEffect()` | Resolves two controller-graveyard target groups in order: returns the target creature first, then returns up to two targeted Auras or Equipment attached to it. An Aura that cannot enchant the creature remains in the graveyard; an Equipment that cannot attach enters unattached. Used by Unfinished Business (FIC 259). |
| `ReturnCreatureCardsPutIntoYourGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurnToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).thisTurnOnly(true).build()` |
| `ReturnCreatureCardsPutIntoYourGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurnToHandEffect()` | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).fromAnywhereThisTurn(true).build()` |

**Rise to Glory:** Use `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD)
.filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).targetGraveyard(true).chooseAuraAttachment(true).build()` for
the targeted Aura mode. The returned Aura's controller chooses any legal permanent or player as
the Aura enters; if there is no legal object, the Aura remains in the graveyard.

**Common usage examples:**

| Card | Usage |
|------|-------|
| Recollect | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).targetGraveyard(true).build()` � any card, targets graveyard |
| Crawl from the Cellar | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).build()` (mandatory GY) + `target(Zombie you control, 0, 1).addSpellEffect(PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(+1/+1))` + `FlashbackCast` � use `.upTo(true)` only when the GY target itself is "up to one" (Yawgmoth) |
| Gravedigger | `MayEffect(ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build())` � creature to hand |
| Corpse Cur | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardAllOfPredicate(List.of(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), new CardKeywordPredicate(INFECT)))).build()` � creature with infect |
| Lord of the Undead | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardSubtypePredicate(ZOMBIE)).build()` � Zombie subtype |
| Doomed Necromancer | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).build()` � creature to battlefield |
| Beacon of Unrest | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardAnyOfPredicate(...)).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).build()` � artifact or creature from any graveyard |
| Nomad Mythmaker | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).attachmentTarget(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate()).build()` � aura to battlefield attached to creature |
| Hakim, Loreweaver | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).targetGraveyard(true).attachToSource(true).build()` � targeted Aura from your graveyard, enters attached to the source (no host choice) |
| Auriok Survivors | `MayEffect(ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardSubtypePredicate(EQUIPMENT)).attachToSource(true).build())` � equipment to battlefield attached to source |
| Squee, Goblin Nabob | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).build()` � self-return |
| No Rest for the Wicked | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).thisTurnOnly(true).build()` � all creatures that died this turn |
| Twilight Shepherd | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).returnAll(true).fromBattlefieldThisTurn(true).build()` � ETB: all cards (any type) put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn |
| Faith's Reward | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsPermanentPredicate()).returnAll(true).fromBattlefieldThisTurn(true).build()` � all permanent cards put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn go back to the battlefield. The `returnAll` + this-turn path honours `destination(BATTLEFIELD)` (plus `enterTapped`/`grantColor`/`grantSubtype` and the battlefield riders); it is prompt-free |
| Garna, the Bloodflame | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).returnAll(true).fromAnywhereThisTurn(true).build()` � all creature cards put into graveyard from anywhere this turn |
| Shadow of the Grave | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).returnAll(true).discardedOrCycledThisTurn(true).build()` � return all cards in your graveyard that you cycled or discarded this turn (cycling is a discard; tracked in the central discard hook `GameData.discarded` via `GameData.cardsDiscardedOrCycledThisTurn`) |
| Reanimate | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).loseLifeEqualToManaValue(true).build()` — targeted reanimation from any graveyard + controller loses life equal to that card's mana value |
| Razor Hippogriff | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(ARTIFACT)).gainLifeEqualToManaValue(true).build()` � artifact to hand + gain life equal to mana value |
| Noxious Revival | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).targetGraveyard(true).build()` � any card from any graveyard on top of owner's library |
| Postmortem Lunge | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).requiresManaValueEqualsX(true).build()` � X-cost creature with MV=X from your graveyard to battlefield with haste; exile at next end step |
| Profane Command (reanimate mode) | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).requiresManaValueAtMostX(true).build()` � creature with MV ? X from your graveyard to battlefield; pair inside a choose-two modal with `{X}` |
| Shallow Grave | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).topmost(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).build()` � "return the top creature card of your graveyard to the battlefield, it gains haste, exile it at the beginning of the next end step". Non-targeting and prompt-free: `topmost` walks the ordered graveyard from the top and returns the first matching card via the pre-targeted path (`GraveyardReturnSupport.resolveTopmostFromControllersGraveyard`), so all battlefield riders apply. No `exileIfLeavesBattlefield` � a creature that dies before the end step just goes to the graveyard |
| Moseo, Vein's New Dean | `new ConditionalEffect(new GainedLifeThisTurn(), ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).maxManaValueEqualsLifeGainedThisTurn(true).build())` in `Triggers.endStep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` � end-step "if you gained life this turn, return up to one target creature card with MV X or less, X = life gained this turn". End-step graveyard targeting reuses the `SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` flow |
| Betor, Ancestor's Voice | `Triggers.endStep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` uses `PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, LifeGainedThisTurn(CONTROLLER))` on up to one other creature you control, plus `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).upTo(true).maxManaValueEqualsLifeLostThisTurn(true).build()` |
| Rise from the Grave | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).grantColor(CardColor.BLACK).grantSubtype(CardSubtype.ZOMBIE).build()` � creature from any graveyard to battlefield as a black Zombie in addition to other colors/types |
| Reassembling Skeleton | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).enterTapped(true).build()` � self-return to battlefield tapped (graveyard activated ability) |
| Warcry Phoenix | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).enterTapped(true).enterAttacking(true).build()` � self-return to battlefield tapped and attacking (graveyard attack trigger) |
| Fatestitcher (Unearth) | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).build()` � Unearth self-return with haste, exiled at next end step or if it would leave the battlefield (graveyard activated ability with `SORCERY_SPEED` timing). Built by `Card.addUnearth(cost)`. `grantHaste`/`exileAtEndStep`/`exileIfLeavesBattlefield` are honored on the `returnAll` self-return path as well as the targeted path; the two exile flags are independent (Shallow Grave sets only `exileAtEndStep`) |

### `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect`

The `TOUGHNESS` value is used by Foul Renewal to feed the returned creature card's printed toughness into its target creature's temporary -X/-X effect.

Graveyard-return glue effect (`TargetSpec.NONE`), parameterized by `ReturnedGraveyardCardValue`: `NONLAND_MANA_VALUE` (Vengeful Rebirth) or `POWER` (Morgue Burst). Sets the entry's event value to that characteristic of the card on `entry.targetId` (a graveyard target, Yawgmoth's-Vile-Offering two-target shape: graveyard card on `targetId`/targetZone GRAVEYARD, any target on a `target(...)` group) **only when that nonland card was actually returned to the controller's hand** � the handler confirms the card is now in hand rather than reading its type in place, so a graveyard target that became illegal (exiled/removed in response, CR 608.2b) records 0 and deals no damage. A returned land also records 0.

Add it **UNBOUND**, right after the `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`. `EffectResolutionService` remaps `entry.targetId` to a bound effect's target group for the duration of that effect (so `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect`-style bound effects read the group via `targetId`); leaving this effect unbound keeps `targetId` pointing at the graveyard card while it runs. Pair with a **bound** `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(new EventValue(), false, false, 0)` on the any-target group � binding is what makes the position accept player targets (`Card.doesPositionAllowPlayerTargets`) and lets the AI classify it as harmful damage. `0` event value = no damage (`dealDamageToPlayer` no-ops on `<= 0`).

### `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardMatchEffect`

**Gone**: `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.toACard(StepKind.RETURN, filter), …)` after the return to hand (Cemetery Recruitment, Jared Carthalion).

### Other graveyard effects

| `AllowCastSourceAsAdventureFromGraveyardUntilNextTurnEffect` | `()` | A source card's controller may cast that card from their graveyard as an Adventure until the end of their next turn. The permission is a floating effect on the card (a `GameData.GraveyardAdventureCastPermission`, `Duration.UNTIL_END_OF_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`) that ends as the card leaves the graveyard; casting uses the Adventure face and the ordinary Adventure exile-after-resolution path. Used by Mosswood Dreadknight |
| `AllowCastSourceCardFromGraveyardThisTurnEffect` | `()` | A source card's controller may cast that card from their graveyard for its normal cost this turn. The permission is a floating effect on the card (a `GameData.GraveyardCardPlayGrant`, until end of turn) that also ends as the card leaves the graveyard. Used by Skyclave Shade |

That flavour is used from an **activated ability**: the targets ride in on the activation's `targetIds` with `Zone.GRAVEYARD` (harness `activateAbilityWithGraveyardTargets`) and are validated in `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiTargetGraveyardAbility` (cap, distinctness, filter, single graveyard) |

The `(CardPredicate filter, DynamicAmount dynamicMaxTargets)` form replaces the fixed cap with a number evaluated in `SpellCastingService` once the spell's player target is chosen (X is locked in as the spell is cast) and makes the effect declare a benign `player()` `TargetSpec`; the fixed-cap check in `TargetLegalityService` is skipped for it, the multi-graveyard choice enforces the computed cap. Because the exile snapshot is taken first, creatures sacrificed by step two stay in their graveyards. ## Draw / discard / hand manipulation

| `RevealCardsChooseOneToCastEffect` | `(DynamicAmount count)` | target player chooses X cards from hand; the controller privately sees those cards and may cast one revealed nonland spell without paying its mana cost. Uses the shared `RevealCardsDiscardChoice` interaction with a private reveal and `PendingMayAbility` free-cast routing; lands remain in hand and are not eligible. Used by Extract Brain (OTC 225) |

| `PayXManaRevealCardsChooseOneToDiscardEffect` | `()` | on resolution, the controller chooses and pays generic X, then the damaged player reveals X cards of their choice from hand and the controller chooses one for that player to discard. Choosing X=0 declines. Used by Hollow Specter (LGN) |

| `RegisterRandomDiscardAtNextUpkeepEffect` | — | **Gone**: `RegisterDelayedStepTriggerEffect.atNext(Triggers.upkeep(YOU), DiscardEffect(N, you(), true))` (Casey Jones, Vigilante) |

`RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect(CardPredicate filter[, CardPredicate countedFilter])` makes the controller choose any
number of matching cards from their hand to reveal publicly. The selected count is stored on the
resolving stack entry for a following `EventValue`-based effect; Brine Seer chains it into
`CounterUnlessPaysEffect(new EventValue())`. The optional `countedFilter` restricts which revealed
cards are counted (and stored as event card IDs) while `filter` still decides which cards may be
revealed: "show any cards, and if you show two black cards" = `RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect(new CardTruePredicate(), new CardColorPredicate(CardColor.BLACK))`
+ `ConditionalEffect(new EventValueAtLeast(2), ...)` (Xyru Specter).

`EachPlayerRevealsAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandThenCreatesTokensEffect(CardPredicate filter,
CreateTokenEffect token)` lets each player reveal any number of matching cards from their hand in
APNAP order, then creates one copy of the token for each card that player revealed. Kamahl's Summons
uses a creature-card filter and a 2/2 green Bear token.

`RevealUpToFiveNonlandCardsFromHandThenCreateTreasureTokensEffect()` makes the controller
choose up to five nonland cards from hand and publicly reveals the selected cards. It then creates
one Treasure for every revealed card whose mana value is shared by at least one other revealed card.
The choice reuses `PendingInteraction.RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandChoice` with a dedicated
duplicate-mana-value resolution context.

`ChooseCardEffect` (hand) + `RevealCardsFromHandEffect` + the put step makes the controller
reveal one chosen card from hand. If it shares a name with any permanent on any battlefield, the
card is put onto the battlefield; otherwise it remains in hand. Retraced Image uses the mandatory
`ChooseCardEffect.announced` choice.

`TargetPlayerPutsCardsFromHandOnTopOfLibraryEffect.yours(1, TOP)` is the non-targeting controller-scoped form of
the hand-to-library-top choice. It requires the controller to choose one card when their hand is
nonempty, and an empty hand resolves without a prompt. `GrantNoMaximumHandSizeEffect(Duration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)` grants a temporary
controller-scoped hand-size exemption that is removed when that player's next turn begins.

`EachPlayerPutsCardFromHandOnTopOfLibraryEffect()` applies the same mandatory single-card choice to
every player in APNAP order, skipping players with empty hands. It reuses the top-only
`PutCardsFromHandOnLibraryCardChoice` interaction and carries its progress in `GameData` so the
resolution can resume between players. Sadistic Augermage (RAV) uses it.

"When you sacrifice this, target player discards N cards" is `Triggers.sacrificed(THIS)` + `new DiscardEffect(N, Subjects.targetPlayer())`. | `MillEffect` | `(DynamicAmount count, PlayerSubject player)`, `(int, player)` | the `player` subject mills cards (`SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md`): `you()`, `targetPlayer()` (the only one that declares a target, benign), `eachOpponent()`, `eachPlayer()`, `triggeringPlayer()` ("that player"), `chosenPlayer()`, `defendingPlayer()`, `controllerOf(target() / triggering() / targetSpell())`. A target, triggering or chosen player has the amount evaluated per milling player with that player as its target; several players named by any other subject mill the same amount at once, as one event (CR 101.4). Use `XValue()` for "mills X", `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)` for Grindclock, `CardsInHand(TARGET_PLAYER)` for "mills cards equal to their hand size" (Dreamborn Muse). "Each player mills N" = `MillEffect(N, Subjects.eachPlayer())`. For flashback "twice X" (Increasing Confusion), wrap two mills in `ConditionalReplacementEffect(new CastFromZone(Zone.GRAVEYARD), Mill(XValue(), targetPlayer()), Mill(Scaled(XValue(),2), targetPlayer()))` |

## Exile

`ExileGraveyardCardsEffect` also supports `GraveyardExileScope.DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER`, a non-targeting scope that exiles the last-known controller's graveyard when used by a delayed death trigger such as Burn Away.

If the source is no longer in the graveyard, neither the top card nor a play choice is created. Used by Flameskull |
| `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(int count, GraveyardExileScope scope[, CardPredicate filter])` or `(GraveyardExileScope scope)` | unified graveyard-exile effect; `scope` selects which graveyard(s) and derives the `targetSpec()` graveyard scope. Scopes: `OWN` (the controller exiles `count` of the cards in their own graveyard that match `filter`, their choice; a lone match is exiled without a prompt; the chosen cards are the EXILE step's result, so a following `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.exiled(), …)` reads them: `fromOwnGraveyard(count, filter)` / `fromOwnGraveyardWithSource(count, filter)`; "you may exile a … card from your graveyard. If you do" is a `MayEffect` around the sequence, Master Skald, Ichorid), `TRIGGERING_PLAYER` ("that player exiles `count` cards from their graveyard": the entry's non-targeting player, the enchanted player of an enchanted-player upkeep � Curse of Oblivion), `TARGET_CARDS_ANY_GRAVEYARD` (scope `ALL_GRAVEYARDS`; exile one target card from any graveyard, optional `CardTypePredicate` filter � Cemetery Reaper/Thraben Heretic/Conversion Chamber/Ascendant Dustspeaker/Glorious Decay/Purify the Grave; fizzles if target removed; validated by `GraveyardTargetValidators`), `TARGET_CARDS_OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` (scope `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD`; exile exactly `count` target cards via `targetCardIds`, validated by `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiTargetGraveyardAbility()` � Deadeye Tracker count=2), `TARGET_PLAYER_ENTIRE` (player-targeting spec; exile a target player's whole graveyard � Nihil Spellbomb), `TARGET_PLAYER_ALL_MATCHING` (player-targeting spec; exile every card matching the filter from the TARGET player's graveyard, null filter = whole graveyard, and record the number exiled on the entry's `eventValue` for a following `EventValue` reader – Crypt Incursion + `GainLifeEffect(Scaled(EventValue(), 3))`), `ALL_PLAYERS` (exile every player's graveyard � Sentinel Totem), `ALL_OPPONENTS` (exile every opponent's graveyard � Phyrexian Scriptures chapter III). `exactTargetCount` + `trackWithSource` support exact multi-card imprint choices such as Spellweaver Helix. |--------|-------------|--------|

Use when the wording is "create [tokens]. When you do, [thenEffect]" and the follow-up target must be chosen after token creation. The follow-up's target restrictions come from its own `targetSpec()`. When the follow-up is about "that token" ("attach it to target creature", "... attached to that token") write `CreateTokenThenEffect.aboutThatToken(...)`: one reflexive ability for each token created (a replacement effect may make more), each with its token as the permanent its effect acts for (the entry's source permanent) and its own target |

color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` or multi-color with innate + until-end-of-turn keywords: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn)` or multi-color with +1/+1 counters on creation: `(String tokenName, int power, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, boolean tappedAndAttacking, boolean exileAtEndOfCombat)` or enters-tapped: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes, boolean tapped)` or factory: `CreateTokenEffect.ofArtifactToken(int amount, String tokenName, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, List<ActivatedAbility> abilities)` or static factories for common tokens: `CreateTokenEffect.whiteSpirit(int amount)` (1/1 white Spirit with flying), `CreateTokenEffect.blackZombie(int amount)` (2/2 black Zombie), `CreateTokenEffect.whiteSoldier(int amount)` (1/1 white Soldier), `CreateTokenEffect.ofTreasureToken(int amount)` (Treasure artifact) or canonical (all params): `(CardType primaryType, DynamicAmount amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes, boolean tappedAndAttacking, boolean tapped, List<Ability> tokenEffects, List<ActivatedAbility> tokenAbilities, boolean exileAtEndOfCombat, boolean exileAtEndStep, boolean legendary, int initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn)` (also with `int amount` = `Fixed` sugar) | create N tokens. The count is a `DynamicAmount` evaluated at resolution (source-relative amounts read the live source permanent, falling back to `sourcePermanentSnapshot` when it left the battlefield as a cost); every "create a token for each �" wording is this effect + an amount � never a new effect class. Power/toughness are also `DynamicAmount`s (every int ctor is `Fixed` sugar): "create an X/X token where X is �" = the `(String tokenName, DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness, CardColor, List<CardSubtype>, Set<Keyword>, Set<CardType>)` ctor, e.g. Phyrexian Rebirth's `EventValue()`/`EventValue()` colorless Horror as a `DestroyAllPermanentsEffect` rider. The single-color convenience constructor also accepts a `DynamicAmount` in the amount position. Examples: "for each charge counter on ~" = `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)` (Shrine of Loyal Legions), "create X tokens" = `XValue()` (White Sun's Zenith), "for each Aura and Equipment attached to ~" = `AttachmentsOnSource(true, true)` (Valduk) / Equipment only = `(false, true)` (Kemba, Kha Regent), "for each poison counter your opponents have" = `OpponentPoisonCounters()` (Phyrexian Swarmlord), "for each creature you control" = `PermanentCount(IsCreature, CONTROLLER)` (Chancellor of the Forge), "for each creature card in your graveyard" = `CardsInGraveyard(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CONTROLLER)` (Spider Spawning; Kessig Cagebreakers adds `tappedAndAttacking=true` via the canonical ctor), "for each Forest you control" = `PermanentCount(HasSubtype(FOREST), CONTROLLER)` (Howl of the Night Pack), "for each creature put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn" = `CreatureDeathsThisTurn(CONTROLLER)` (Fresh Meat), "half the number of Zombies you control, rounded down" = `Divided(PermanentCount(AllOf(IsCreature, HasSubtype(ZOMBIE)), CONTROLLER), 2)` (Endless Ranks of the Dead). `primaryType` determines the token's card type (CREATURE for creature tokens, ARTIFACT for artifact tokens like Treasure/Clue/Food); all convenience constructors default to CREATURE. `tokenAbilities` adds activated abilities to the token (e.g. Treasure's tap-sacrifice-for-mana). For non-creature tokens, power/toughness are ignored and `handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield` is not called. `ofArtifactToken` factory creates colorless artifact tokens with abilities. `color` is primary display color. `colors` (Set&lt;CardColor&gt;, nullable) is full color identity for multi-color tokens. Multi-color constructors default keywords/additionalTypes to empty sets. When `initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters` &gt; 0, each created token enters with that many +1/+1 counters (e.g. Additive Evolution's 0/0 Fractal with three counters). When `tappedAndAttacking=true`, tokens enter the battlefield tapped and attacking (CR 508.8) � used for "whenever ~ attacks, create tokens tapped and attacking" abilities (e.g. Hero of Bladehold). When `tapped=true`, tokens enter the battlefield tapped but not attacking � used for cards like Army of the Damned. When `exileAtEndOfCombat=true`, tokens are exiled at end of combat step � used for temporary attack tokens (e.g. Geist of Saint Traft). When `tokenEffects` is non-empty, each ability (e.g. `new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.dies(ObjectRelation.THIS), …)`) is added to the token card, giving the token its own triggered abilities (e.g. Mitotic Slime's cascading death triggers). When `legendary=true`, the token has the LEGENDARY supertype (subject to legend rule) � used for named legendary tokens (e.g. Verix Bladewing creating Karox Bladewing). `grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn` (defaults to empty in every convenience constructor) is added to each created token's `Permanent.grantedKeywords` after it enters, i.e. keywords the token gains until end of turn � distinct from innate `keywords`. Used for "create a ... token. It gains haste until end of turn" (e.g. Artistic Process's Elemental gains haste) `withSimultaneousTokens(List<CreateTokenEffect>)` adds other fixed-count token profiles to the same creation instruction and entry batch; replacement choices such as Esix see the combined token count. Used by Bestial Menace. `withAttackingUntapped()` (with `tappedAndAttacking=true`) makes the token enter attacking but NOT tapped ("create a ... token that's attacking", e.g. Sigiled Sword of Valeron, Inquisitorial Rosette). `.forController(PlayerSubject)` sets who creates and controls the tokens (default `you()`; "its controller creates" = `controllerOf(target())` after a removal step), who is also offered the token-creation replacements. |

## Poison counters

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `MeliraPoisonReplacementEffect` | `()` | STATIC replacement marker: the first poison-counter event affecting its controller becomes one poison counter, and later poison-counter events that turn are ignored. Checked by the shared poison application path. Melira, the Living Cure |
| Poison-counter application path | — | `LifeSupport`, combat poison damage, damage-source poison, and delayed poison all use the shared replacement path, including `MeliraPoisonReplacementEffect` and `PlayerCantGetPoisonCountersEffect` |
| `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect` | `()` / `(boolean enterTapped)` / `underControllerExcludingSource()` / `fromControllerGraveyard()` | creates a delayed triggered ability about the target (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, this turn): when it dies, that card returns to the battlefield (tapped when `enterTapped`). The default forms return under the card owner's control (Graceful Reprieve, Supernatural Stamina); `underControllerExcludingSource()` returns under the registering ability's controller and narrows the target to a creature other than the source (Adarkar Valkyrie); `fromControllerGraveyard()` triggers only for a card the ability's controller owns ("put into your graveyard", Saffi Eriksdotter) |
| `GivePoisonCountersEffect` | `(int\|DynamicAmount amount, PlayerSubject player)` | give N poison counters to the players `player` names: `you()` (Phyrexian Vatmother; also a mana-ability rider, Noxious Bayou), `targetPlayer()` (benign player target; Hand of the Praetors' filtered cast trigger; with `Max(Fixed(0), Sum(Fixed(9), Scaled(TargetPlayerPoisonCounters(), -1)))` Vraska, Betrayal's Sting's "fewer than nine" difference), `eachPlayer()` (Ichor Rats), `eachOpponent()`, `controllerOf(target())` (a permanent baked onto a trigger: Noxious Assault), `controllerOf(triggering())` (Relic Putrescence's tapped artifact, Reaper of Sheoldred's damage source). Amount evaluated once. All placement routes through `LifeSupport.applyPoisonCounters` (Melira, `PlayerCantGetPoisonCountersEffect`, counter replacements); the ten-counter loss is the state-based action |
| `DefendingPlayerPoisonCounters` | `()` | dynamic amount for the poison counters on the player attacked by the source permanent; used by attack-triggered effects such as Kozilek, Compleated |
| `ReturnCreatureCardFromTargetOwnerGraveyardEffect` | `()` / `(UUID graveyardOwnerId)` | Reincarnation's delayed trigger effect: the controller of Reincarnation chooses a creature card from the targeted creature's owner's graveyard when the delayed trigger resolves; the chosen card enters under its owner's control. The no-arg form is bound to the target's owner when the delayed trigger is registered. |
| `ReturnTriggeringCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `()` / `(boolean enterTapped, boolean returnUnderController)` / `(boolean enterTapped, boolean returnUnderController, CounterType counterType, int counterAmount)` | triggered-ability effect: returns the stack entry's triggering card from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield, optionally tapped, under the ability controller's control, and/or with counters. Fizzles if no longer in the expected graveyard entry (CR 400.7) or if the card can't enter from a graveyard (Grafdigger's Cage). Pushed by death and delayed-return pipelines; also on a card directly (Lorcan, Warlock Collector; Angelic Renewal `(false, true)` as the "if you do" payload after a `SacrificeSelfEffect`) |
| `ReturnSacrificedPermanentToBattlefieldEffect` | — | **Gone**: a sacrifice step + `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(Subjects.cardsThisWay(StepKind.SACRIFICE)).withCounters(type, n)` (Heart-Shaped Herb) |
| `ResolveEffectOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` / `ifDealtDamageThisWay(effect)` / `ifCondition(Condition, effect)` | creates a delayed triggered ability about the target (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, this turn): when it dies, `effect` resolves under the registering player's control. Its source is the registering ability's (CR 603.7e), so self-referential effects (`TransformToBackFaceEffect`, `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(Subjects.source())`) find it; the dying permanent is the triggering permanent as it last existed, its last controller `triggeringPermanentControllerId` ("that creature's controller": `Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.triggering())`, `GraveyardExileScope.DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER`). A target of `effect` is chosen as it triggers (CR 603.3d). `ifDealtDamageThisWay` registers only if the source dealt the target damage (Skeletonize); `ifCondition` is an intervening "if" (CR 603.4, Fight for the Throne) |

## Creature pump / boost

- `BoostSelfOrPutCounterIfExactlyThreeColorsEffect()` — gives the source +1/+1 until end of turn, or puts a +1/+1 counter on it instead when exactly three colors of mana were spent to activate the ability (Paragon of Modernity)

- `BoostTargetPermanentEffect` — `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(int, int, PermanentPredicate)`; target permanent gets +X/+Y until end of turn. The optional filter narrows the permanent target, including creature-or-Vehicle targets, and dynamic amounts evaluate against the source/controller.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect` | `(Integer power, Integer toughness, PermanentSubject subject)`; `(int power, int toughness)` � `Subjects.target()`; `toughnessOnly(int toughness)` � `(null, toughness, TARGET)` | set base P/T (modifiers still apply on top, CR 613 layer 7b). `scope == TARGET`: one-shot, sets target creature's base P/T **until end of turn** (Diminish, Quandrix Charm). `scope == SELF`: one-shot on the source, **until end of turn**, for a non-targeting self ability (Marsh Flitter). Any other scope (`Subjects.attachedCreature()`, �): continuous STATIC (Deep Freeze, Darksteel Mutation). Every setter is a CR 613 sublayer-7b entry ordered by timestamp � one-shot resolutions create a floating 7b effect (per-target for the mass setter, locking the affected set per CR 611.2c); a departed copy reads the setters still on its id as its last-known base P/T; the latest-timestamp setter wins and beats any 7a CDA in layer order. A `null` component means "leave that base value alone" � `toughnessOnly(1)` ("has base toughness 1", Chariot of the Sun) writes only the 7b toughness and keeps printed power; a partial setter carries per-component nulls on its floating 7b entry, so only the one-shot `Subjects.target()`/`Subjects.source()` pipeline supports nulls (continuous static scopes must pass both). One-shot over `source()` with `Duration.PERMANENT` is "has base P/T X/Y" with no duration (Surge Engine); a set narrowed by a filter (`allCreatures()` + `PermanentIsUnblockedAttackingPredicate`, Inkfathom Witch) locks the set (CR 611.2c); a subject naming permanents one by one (`except(triggeringAttackers(), source())`, Creepy Puppeteer) sets each found as it resolves. |
| `SetBasePowerToughnessToAmountEffect` | `(DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness, PermanentSubject subject)` | continuous STATIC dynamic base P/T setter for creature scopes such as `Subjects.attachedCreature()`; evaluates both amounts from the source and its controller and applies the resulting base values while the scope matches. A floating self grant can use `Subjects.source()` with a null component for a live partial setting. Aettir and Priwen uses `ControllerLifeTotal()` for both amounts. |

Two differences from `AttachedBoostEffect`, both demanded by the wordings that need this record: the toughness floor, and the fact that `amount` evaluates with the **enchanted creature** as the amount source and *its* controller as the amount controller � so `IfSourceAttacking` reads the enchanted creature's combat state, `CountScope.DEFENDING_PLAYER` reads the player it is attacking, and `CountScope.CONTROLLER` reads "its controller" (NOT the Aura's controller, unlike CR 109.5 "you control" wordings). The floor is measured against the creature's toughness *so far in the pass* (own effective toughness + bonuses already in the accumulator), which both counts other pumps and keeps the self-referential value from recursing into static bonus assembly. In a multi-group spell, bind it to its target group via `target(...).addSpellEffect(...)` (Savage Stomp, River Heralds' Boon). LORE counters on Sagas trigger chapter abilities (CR 715.2b); +1/+1 fires "whenever a +1/+1 counter is put on this" triggers (`Triggers.plusOneCounterPutOnThis()`); -1/-1 respects prevention |
| `PutCounterOnChosenOwnPermanentEffect` | `(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate)` | non-targeting resolution-time choice of one matching permanent the controller controls; puts counters on it and stores that chosen permanent on the stack entry so a following non-targeting effect can refer to the same permanent |
| `AnimateChosenOwnPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, AnimatePermanentsEffect animation)` | during resolution, the controller chooses one matching permanent they control (non-targeting), records it on the stack entry, and applies the supplied animation; Turbocharged Escape uses it to permanently animate a Vehicle as an artifact creature |
| `PutCounterOnChosenOwnPermanentEffect` | `(CounterType, DynamicAmount amount, PermanentPredicate)` or `(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate)` | non-targeting resolution-time choice of one matching permanent the controller controls; evaluates the amount at resolution, puts counters on it, and stores that chosen permanent on the stack entry so a following non-targeting effect can refer to the same permanent |
| `DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, DynamicAmount total, DivisionMode mode)`; factories `evenlyAmongTargets(CounterType, int)` / `chosenAmongTargetCreatures(CounterType, DynamicAmount)` | the counter analogue of `DealDividedDamageEffect`. **EVEN** distributes `total` counters evenly across this effect's chosen target group (`floor(total / targetCount)` on each) � the forced the targeting rules split for "distribute two counters among one or two target creatures" (Splendid Agony's two -1/-1 counters, Contagion's two -2/-1 counters); bind to a `target(creatureFilter, 1, 2)` group, the handler reads `StackEntry.targetsForEffect(this)`. NOT for a genuine three-plus choose-your-division distribute � use **CHOSEN** for that: the controller announces the division as the spell is cast (the targeting rules) and per-target counts ride on `StackEntry.damageAssignments` exactly like divided damage (no `target()` call; harness `castInstant(player, idx, Map)`), with `total` evaluated at cast time � Spoils of War (`PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE`, `CardsInGraveyard(artifact-or-creature, OPPONENTS)`). Cast-time validation (sum == X, creature-only targets, each count ?1) lives in `SpellCastingService`; X=0 casts with no targets and resolves doing nothing. Counter-type generic: harmful spec for `MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE`, benign otherwise (both modes declare `CREATURE`; the null-`targetId` tolerance CHOSEN needs comes from `EffectResolution.distributesAmountsAmongTargets`, not from a no-op category). Placement routes through `PermanentCounterSupport.placeCounterOnPermanent` (so -1/-1 prevention/reduction and +1/+1 triggers apply); a target that is no longer a creature at resolution is skipped (the targeting rules)
| `PutPhylacteryCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect` | `()` | put a phylactery counter on an artifact you control as an "as enters" replacement effect. Does NOT target (shroud/hexproof don't prevent it). Counter is placed directly when creature enters, not via stack. Artifact choice is validated at resolution: must be an artifact controlled by the caster. If no valid artifact is chosen, ability does nothing. Used by Phylactery Lich |
| `StateTriggerEffect` | `(StateTriggerPredicate, List<CardEffect>, String)` or `(PermanentPredicate sourcePredicate, List<CardEffect>, String)` | A state trigger's game state is its trigger: `Triggers.state(predicate)`, `Triggers.sourceState(PermanentPredicate)`, `Triggers.battlefieldHasAtMost(n, PermanentPredicate)` / `battlefieldHasAtLeast`, with `.withSource(…)`, `.withBattlefieldAtMost(…)` and `.referencing(…)`; its effects are the ability's. Don't author `StateTriggerEffect` (`StateTriggerService` builds it from the ability, read as the layers leave it). A granted state trigger is a granted ability: `new GrantEffectEffect(new GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.sourceState(predicate), effects…), Subjects.target()), Subjects.target())` (Olivia, Crimson Bride's returned creature), which `StateTriggerService` reads from the permanent's granted effects. State-triggered ability (CR 603.8): when the condition is met after SBAs, its effects go on the stack as a triggered ability, which won't retrigger while it is on the stack. `Triggers.state(predicate)` is a free-form lambda over the whole game state (Phylactery Lich, Gorilla Pack, Call to Arms). `Triggers.sourceState(PermanentPredicate)` states a condition about the source permanent only and is evaluated through `PredicateEvaluationService`, so it is CR 613 layer-aware � use it whenever static grants must count ("When this creature has flying, sacrifice it" = `PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(FLYING)`, Floodgate; `Permanent.hasKeyword` alone would miss an aura's grant) |

Used by Gilder Bairn (`{2}{G/U}, {Q}` activated ability, `.withRequiresUntap()`) `onSource(counterType)` doubles that kind on this permanent, non-targeting (The Millennium Calendar). |

## Keywords / abilities

- `GrantProtectionFromTargetPlayerToControllerAndPlaneswalkersUntilNextTurnEffect()` — targeted player protection for the ability controller and their planeswalkers until the controller's next turn; the player's protection is a floating effect on the controller whose payload is this record with the protected-from player's id (`playerId`), while each planeswalker the controller has as the ability resolves gets its own `Permanent` grant (kept if control changes, not given to planeswalkers that enter later); both are cleared when the controller's next turn begins. Used by Eon Frolicker.
- `BoostAndGrantKeywordToTriggeringAndSharingCreaturesUntilEndOfTurnEffect(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost, Set<Keyword> keywords)` — non-targeting triggered-ability resolution effect: the triggering creature and other creatures controlled by the ability controller that share a creature type with it get the boost and keywords until end of turn. Used by Haunted One.
- `GrantProtectionFromTargetPermanentColorsUntilEndOfTurnEffect()` — target permanent's effective colors are snapshotted on resolution; each creature controlled by the ability controller gains protection from those colors until end of turn. Used by Samite Elder.
- `GrantProtectionFromEverythingUntilNextTurnEffect()` — controller gains protection from every source until their next turn. Player targeting checks use the protection marker, while damage reuses the existing all-player-damage-prevention-until-next-turn state. The Stasis Coffin.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `GrantKeywordEffect` | `(Keyword keyword, PermanentSubject subject)` or `(Keyword keyword, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject)` or `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter)` or with explicit duration: `(Keyword keyword, PermanentSubject subject, Duration duration)` / `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject, Duration duration)` / static factory `GrantKeywordEffect.toTargetIf(Keyword keyword, PermanentPredicate grantCondition)` / canonical `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter, Duration duration, PermanentPredicate grantCondition)` | grant one or more keywords. Scope: `Subjects.source()`, `Subjects.target()`, `Subjects.attachedCreature()`, `Subjects.otherTappedCreaturesYouControl()`, `Subjects.creaturesYouControl()`, `Subjects.allCreatures()`, `Subjects.allPermanents()` (static: every permanent on every battlefield matching `filter`, no creature requirement; the source itself is included if it matches, so exclude it via the filter when needed � Spectral Guardian's "noncreature artifacts have shroud"), `Subjects.landsYouControl()` / `Subjects.allLands()` (static: lands you control / every land on the battlefield matching `filter`, no creature requirement � Shimmer's "each land of the chosen type has phasing" = `(PHASING, Subjects.allLands(), new PermanentHasSourceChosenSubtypePredicate())`), `Subjects.creaturesTargetPlayerControls()` (one-shot, all creatures the targeted player controls � player-targeting spec, e.g. Shields of Velis Vel), `Subjects.creaturesEnchantedPlayerControls()`, `Subjects.createdThisResolution()` (one-shot, the tokens created by an earlier effect on the **same** stack entry � read from `StackEntry.createdPermanentIds`, which the token-creation handlers populate; e.g. Gilt-Leaf Ambush's `ClashEffect` onWin grants deathtouch to the two Elf Warriors it just created). `Subjects.bandmatesOf(Subjects.source())` (one-shot, the *other* attacking creatures sharing the source's attacking band per CR 702.22c � read from `Permanent.bandId`; empty when the source isn't attacking in a band; Urza's Engine's "attacking creatures banded with this creature gain trample"). `filter` selects the eligible permanents for multi-permanent scopes and (for `Subjects.target()`) feeds the spec predicate � a targeting restriction. `grantCondition` (OPTIONAL, distinct from `filter`) is checked against the selected permanent at resolution: if it doesn't match, only the keyword grant is skipped, the target stays legal � use `toTargetIf(...)` for "target creature does X; if it's a [type], it also gains [keyword]" (Vampire's Zeal with `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(VAMPIRE)`, Blessing of Belzenlok with `PermanentHasSupertypePredicate(LEGENDARY)`). Use `Set<Keyword>` overload for multiple keywords at once. `Duration` governs the **one-shot** (normalfx) grant's expiry: the grant is a layer-6 floating effect on each permanent with that duration — `UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` (default), `UNTIL_END_OF_COMBAT`, `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`, `UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UPKEEP`, `PERMANENT` (no stated duration, so it lasts until the end of the game per CR 611.2a — Nature's Blessing; not ended by turn cleanup), or `WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD` ("for as long as you control [source]" - Aegis Angel; keyed to `entry.getSourcePermanentId()`, ended by `DurationClock` as the source leaves or changes control). In `addStaticEffect` the grant is continuous (anthem), duration and `grantCondition` are ignored |
