| `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility, PermanentSubject subject[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | `addStaticEffect` continuous grant of a **triggered** ability to the permanents the scope selects. The grant record itself is accumulated as a granted effect by `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffectHandler` / `GrantTriggeredAbilitySelfEffectHandler` (the self pass is what covers the source permanent, since the layer pass never targets a source with itself), and the trigger pipeline lists the granted abilities next to the permanent's own (`GrantedTriggeredAbilitySupport`), so a granted ability triggers like a printed one: Avarice Amulet's "equipped creature has 'At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card'" (the creature's controller draws), Thorncaster Sliver's "Sliver creatures you control have 'Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to any target'" (the attacker is the source; its target is chosen as the ability goes on the stack). Wrapped in `ConditionalEffect` it is recomputed by the layer system, so the granted trigger turns on and off with the condition — unlike the one-shot `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect`. A "when this dies" ability an Aura or Equipment grants still triggers from the attachments the dying permanent had as it died (Infernal Scarring: "Enchanted creature has 'When this creature dies, draw a card'"). Conditional self-application goes through `StaticEffectSupport.applySelfOnlyConditionalStaticEffect`. Used by Tandem Lookout (`ConditionalEffect(SourceIsPaired, GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.dealsDamageToPlayer(), DrawCardEffect(1)), Subjects.sourceAndPaired()))`) |
| `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect` | `()` / `(boolean requireSourceOnBattlefield)` / `forOpponent()` | death-trigger effect that queues the dying creature's card for return at the next end step. `forOpponent()` targets an opponent as the delayed return controller. Global `Triggers.dies(THIS)` grants are snapshotted before battlefield removal so they survive the death-trigger collection path. |
| `ReturnDelayedCurseAttachedToPlayerEffect` | — | **Gone**: `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(Subjects.triggeringCards()).underControlOf(Subjects.you()).attachedTo(Subjects.you())` |
| `ReturnDelayedGraveyardCardUnderControlEffect` | `(UUID returnControllerId, boolean sacrificeOnSourceControlLoss, CounterType counterType, int counterAmount, CardColor grantColor, CardSubtype grantSubtype)` | internal: the delayed end-step ability `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect` makes; it returns the card named as its entry's triggering card to the battlefield under `returnControllerId`'s control (new-object, blocked-zone and source-left checks). Not authored on cards. |
| `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingArtifactUnderControlEffect` | — | **Gone** (no card wrote it): an emblem's "whenever [a permanent] is put into your graveyard from the battlefield" ability is a `TriggeredAbility` of the emblem on `Triggers.putIntoGraveyardFrom(Zone.BATTLEFIELD, filter, ObjectRelation.YOU_OWN)`: Daretti, Scrap Savant's `new CreateEmblemEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.putIntoGraveyardFrom(Zone.BATTLEFIELD, Triggers.ARTIFACT, ObjectRelation.YOU_OWN), new RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect(false, null, 0, null, null, false, true)), "…")`, read by the trigger pipeline as an emblem's ability (the filter judged on the permanent as it last existed, CR 603.10a; a token triggers it too, CR 111.7), "that card" the entry's triggering card |
| `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility[, boolean delayedTrigger])` | until end of turn, the target creature(s) gain `grantedAbility`. With `delayedTrigger=true`, instead registers a spell-sourced delayed ability watching each targeted object until cleanup; the watched object retains its identity when it loses abilities, and a death trigger records its controller at death while the spell caster controls the delayed ability. The grant is a floating layer-6 grant on the permanent (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`, CR 613.1f), ended by the clock at cleanup. Cleared on `resetModifiers()`. **Multi-target:** the handler fans over `entry.getTargetIds()` (falling back to `targetId`), so pair it with `target(filter, 0, 99)` for "any number of target creatures". Used by Verdant Rebirth (single-target Triggers.dies(THIS) bounce) and Rabid Attack (with `BoostTargetCreatureEffect(1, 0)` on the same target list: "+1/+0 and gain 'when this dies, draw a card'"). **Triggers.attacks() granted triggers** trigger off the attacker like its own; a granted `MustBlockSourceEffect(null)` has its source snapshotted to the attacker there. Used by Tower Above ("gains 'When this creature attacks, target creature blocks it this turn if able'"). **Triggers.dealsCombatDamageToPlayer() granted triggers** likewise trigger off the damage-dealing creature; the controller draws via a plain `DrawCardEffect(1)`. Used by Open into Wonder ("gains 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card'", bound to a `targetX` group). **Triggers.becomesBlocked() granted triggers** trigger off the blocked attacker (`WatchedAbilities.temporary(attacker, Triggers.becomesBlocked())` next to its own abilities that aren't `EACH_BLOCKER`), both on normal blocker declaration and in `CombatBlockService.fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers`; the granted effect is self-scoped to the attacker. Used by Barreling Attack ("When that creature becomes blocked this turn, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature blocking it" = `BoostSelfEffect(CreaturesBlockingSource(), CreaturesBlockingSource())`). Also `(Ability, PermanentSubject)` grants to `Subjects.source()` (Cruel Deceiver) or to a set found once as the effect resolves, CR 611.2c (`Subjects.creaturesYouControl()` Driven // Despair, narrowed with `Subjects.narrowed(set, filter)`; The Cheetah Planet's Cats); a static ability is `StaticAbility.of(effect)` (Whipgrass Entangler, Akroma's Will). |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromExileToOwnerHandEffect` | — | **Gone**: `PutCardsIntoHandEffect(Subjects.triggeringCards())` (Kaya the Inexorable, Ashnod's Intervention) |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect` | `()` | when resolved as a death trigger, returns the dying creature's card from its owner's graveyard to its owner's hand. Uses the stack entry's card ID (the trigger source) to identify which card to return. Unlike ReturnEnchantedCreatureToOwnerHandOnDeathEffect (for auras), this returns the source card itself. Used by Verdant Rebirth |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(boolean tapped[, boolean losesAllAbilities[, Set<CardType> overriddenCardTypes[, CounterType enterWithCounter[, boolean perpetuallyLosesThisAbility]]]])` | when resolved as a death trigger, returns the dying source card from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield under its owner's control, tapped when `tapped` is true. An optional non-empty `overriddenCardTypes` replaces the returned permanent's card types indefinitely; `perpetuallyLosesThisAbility` removes this exact printed death trigger for that card identity after resolution without removing other abilities. Battlefield analogue of `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect`; immediate rather than queued (unlike `RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyardEffect`) and optionally adds one counter. Respects Grafdigger's Cage-style enter-from-graveyard bans and fizzles if the card left the graveyard. Used by Abnormal Endurance, Enduring Innocence, and Runeblade Raiser |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldFaceDownEffect` | — | **Gone**: `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(Subjects.triggeringCards()).underControlOf(Subjects.you()).faceDown()` (`Subjects.sourceCard()` in an ability that works from the graveyard) (Ashcloud Phoenix, Deathmist Raptor) |
| `GrantFlashbackToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, String flashbackCost[, boolean allGraveyards])` or `(Set<CardType> cardTypes[, boolean allGraveyards])` | grants flashback to matching cards in the source controller's graveyard, or in all graveyards when `allGraveyards` is true. A null flashback cost uses each card's mana cost; static grants are active while their source's conditions are met, while spell-effect grants track card IDs until end of turn. Cards that already have native flashback are skipped for one-shot grants. Used by Past in Flames, Lier, Iroh, Grand Lotus, and Otaria |
| `GrantFlashbackToTargetGraveyardCardEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes[, String flashbackCost])`, `(Set<CardType> cardTypes, GrantedCardAbilityEffect.Ability)` (harmonize, jump-start, or embalm at the card's mana cost: Songcrafter Mage, Filigree Racer, Cursecloth Wrappings) or `(Set<CardType> cardTypes, boolean withoutPayingManaCost)` | targets a single card of a matching type in the controller's graveyard and grants it flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost defaults to the card's mana cost, unless a fixed `flashbackCost` is supplied; `withoutPayingManaCost` remains the free-cast form. Own-graveyard-only (kept `@ValidatesTarget` validator enforces the controller's graveyard). Uses multi-graveyard targeting at ETB trigger time (`BattlefieldEntryService.handleGrantFlashbackETBTargeting`) or spell targeting (`targetId` in graveyard). Resolved by `KeywordGrantResolutionService`. Fizzles if target leaves graveyard. The grant is a `GrantedCardAbilityEffect` floating effect on the card (until end of turn); it ends as the card leaves the graveyard. Used by Snapcaster Mage, Flashback (SOS), and The Fugitive Doctor (WHO 130) |
| `GrantAbilityToNextSpellThisTurnEffect` | `storm(CardPredicate)`, `cascade(CardPredicate)`, or `(CardPredicate filter, CardEffect effect, String keyword)` | one-shot: the next matching spell the controller casts this turn has that triggered ability of its own (a `nextThisTurn` delayed ability with `.grantedToTheSpell()`), used up by that spell, else ended with the turn; each resolution gives one instance. Storm, Force of Nature; Crackling Spellslinger; Sloppity Bilepiper |
| `GrantGraveyardAbilityToCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, ActivatedAbility ability)` or `(CardPredicate filter, PerCard)` | STATIC: each matching card in the controller's graveyard (the planar controller's for a plane) has the ability, or one whose cost is read from the card (`EMBALM_FOR_MANA_COST`, `UNEARTH_FOR_MANA_COST`, `ENCORE_FOR_MANA_COST`: none without a mana cost; `ENCORE_FOR_MANA_VALUE`). The filter is judged by the card's current types, subtypes and colors. Sedris, Mishra Tamer of Mak Fawa, Dregscape Sliver, Sliver Gravemother, Graywater's Fixer, Wire Surgeons, Naktamun, Grixis |
| `GrantUnearthToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, String unearthCost)` | grants fixed-cost unearth to every matching card in the controller's graveyard until end of turn. The handler makes a `GrantedCardAbilityEffect` floating effect on each matching card (the set is fixed as it resolves, CR 611.2c); `GameQueryService` exposes `Card.unearthAbility(unearthCost)` as an effective graveyard ability. Used by Ghost Ark |
| `GrantTargetCreatureCardGraveyardCastAndCopyActivatedAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | targets a creature card in any graveyard and grants permission to cast that specific card this turn. Records a `GameData.GraveyardCardCastPermission` (source permanent + casting player) as an until-end-of-turn floating effect on the card in the graveyard (`GameData.addCardEffect`). `SpellCastingService` consumes the permission when the allowed player casts the card from any graveyard by card ID, puts the permanent spell on the stack, then queues a delayed trigger above it. Used by Havengul Lich |
| `GrantSourceActivatedAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(List<ActivatedAbility> abilities, String copiedFromCardName)` | delayed triggered ability effect that grants the stack entry's source permanent the provided activated abilities until end of turn as `Duration.UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` floating ability grants (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`). Fizzles if the source permanent is gone. Used by Havengul Lich after the selected graveyard creature card is cast |
| `BushidoEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` — int sugar ctor wraps `Fixed` | a Bushido ability. The combat triggers that represent Bushido use this rather than a bare `BoostSelfEffect` so other cards can distinguish Bushido from unrelated block triggers (Takeno, Samurai General reads every other Samurai's amount). `asBoost()` returns the `BoostSelfEffect(amount, amount)` the trigger resolves. Fixed N for printed bushido; `PermanentCount(IsAttacking, ANY_PLAYER)` for bushido X (Fumiko). Written as two triggers: `Triggers.blocks()` with `TriggerOptions.ONE_OR_MORE` (once each combat, CR 509.3a) and `Triggers.becomesBlocked()` |
| `GrantEffectToSourceOfChosenColorUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility)` | after a preceding resolution-time color choice, grants the source a temporary triggered ability whose event subject must have that chosen color. The handler captures the color into a fixed `PermanentColorInPredicate`, so separate activations retain separate choices; the grant is a floating layer-6 grant on the permanent (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`, CR 613.1f), ended by the clock at cleanup. |
| `RegisterDelayedBlockOrBecomesBlockedTriggerEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` | registers two delayed abilities about the source permanent for this combat (a combat phase, CR 500.8): "whenever it blocks a creature" and "whenever it becomes blocked by a creature" (`TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER`), `effect` acting on that creature; controlled by its creator even after a control change (CR 603.7e). Goblin Flotilla |

## Combat restrictions / evasion

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CantBeBlockedEffect` | `()` | can't be blocked (static) |
| `CantAttackOrBlockAloneEffect` | `(boolean restrictsBlocking)` | this creature can't attack alone (CR 508.1c, static); when `restrictsBlocking` is true it also can't block alone (CR 509.1a). The no-arg constructor defaults to `true` (Mogg Flunkies); pass `false` for "can't attack alone" only (Bonded Construct) |
| `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessGreaterPowerAlsoDoesEffect` | `()` | Okk: can't attack unless another declared attacker has strictly greater power; can't block unless another declared blocker has strictly greater power (static). Combat-set-dependent, so not a `Condition` � validated in `CombatAttackService.validateGreaterPowerAlsoAttacks` / `CombatBlockService.validateGreaterPowerAlsoBlocks` against the current combat's declared set, at declaration time only |
| `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessCountAlsoDoesEffect` | `(int otherCount)` | Orcish Conscripts (`2`): can't attack unless at least N other creatures are declared as attackers; can't block unless at least N other creatures are declared as blockers (static). Combat-set-dependent, so not a `Condition` � validated in `CombatAttackService.validateCountAlsoAttacks` / `CombatBlockService.validateCountAlsoBlocks` against the current combat's declared set, at declaration time only |
| `CantAttackUnlessMatchingCreatureAlsoAttacksEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, String requirementDescription)` | attack-only combat-set restriction: can't attack unless another declared attacker matches `predicate` (Scarred Puma). Validated in `CombatAttackService.validateMatchingCreatureAlsoAttacks` against the current combat's declared attackers |
| `CreaturesWithPowerGreaterThanAmountCantAttackEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | global static: any creature (either player's) whose effective power is strictly greater than `amount` can't attack (Ensnaring Bridge `new CardsInHand(CountScope.CONTROLLER)`). `amount` is evaluated from the source's controller via `AmountContext.forStaticEffect`; checked in `CombatAttackService.isCantAttackDueToGlobalRestriction` |
| `CantAttackNextTurnCombatOpponentEffect` | `()` | combat trigger (Wall of Dust): the combat opponent (the creature this permanent blocks) can't attack during its controller's next turn. Placed on `Triggers.blocks()`; the card declares no target for it, so it acts on "that creature", the creature on the other side of the block, recorded as the entry's non-targeting `targetId` as the ability triggers. The handler puts a floating `CantAttackNextTurnCombatOpponentEffect` on that creature (`Duration.DURING_AFFECTED_PLAYERS_NEXT_TURN`): the clock begins it as that creature's controller's next turn begins and ends it with that turn |
| `OtherCreaturesCantAttackThisTurnEffect` | `()` | SPELL one-shot rider (Intimidation Bolt "Other creatures can't attack this turn"). Adds a floating effect until end of turn carrying the accompanying spell's creature target (`entry.getTargetId()`) as `exemptCreatureId`; `AttackLegalityService.canAttack` lets a creature attack only if its ID equals EVERY exemption � so only the targeted survivor may attack, a dead target locks everyone, and creatures entering later are barred too. Untargeted itself (reads the damage effect's target), so `targetSpec()` stays `NONE`; pair with `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(N)` |
| `CreaturesCantAttackThisTurnEffect` | `()` | SPELL one-shot global restriction: no creature can attack for the rest of the turn, including creatures entering after resolution. Adds a floating effect until end of turn on every player; `AttackLegalityService` checks it during attacker declaration |
| `PeaceTalksEffect` | `()` | SPELL (Peace Talks). Resolves into itself as a floating effect on every player lasting `Duration.THIS_TURN_AND_NEXT_TURN` (ends at the next turn's cleanup, CR 514.2); `GameQueryService.isPeaceTalksActive` reads it. Creatures can't attack (`AttackLegalityService`); players and permanents can't be targets of spells or activated abilities (`TargetLegalityService` / `ValidTargetService`) — triggered abilities unaffected. Untargeted (`targetSpec()` `NONE`) |
| `CantBlockEffect` | `()` | this creature can't block (static) |
| `CantBlockThisCombatEffect` | `()` / `self()` | targeted creature, or the source creature with `self()`, can't block any creature for the current combat; handler sets the combat-scoped marker cleared by `Permanent.clearCombatState()` |
| `CantBlockUnlessEffect` | `(Condition condition, String requirementDescription)` | static: this creature can't block unless `condition` is met (Marauding Boneslasher: `new ControlsOtherPermanentCount(1, new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(ZOMBIE))`, "you control another Zombie"). The block-only counterpart of `CantAttackUnlessEffect` and the block half of `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessEffect`. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockUnless()`; evaluated in `GameQueryService.canBlock` (via `isCantBlockUnlessConditionUnmet`) relative to the source's controller. Does NOT restrict attacking |
| `TargetPlayerChoosesCreaturesToAttackNextTurnEffect` | `()` | player-targeting spec: the targeted player chooses **any number** of creatures they control (`MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ChooseCreaturesToAttackNextTurn`, max = all their creatures). The chosen set — possibly empty — is made a floating `OnlyChosenCreaturesCanAttackEffect` on that player (`Duration.DURING_AFFECTED_PLAYERS_NEXT_TURN`) by `GameData.restrictAttackersNextTurn`, which also makes the delayed triggered ability (`Triggers.endStep(CHOSEN_PLAYER)`, waiting past the current turn) that destroys each chosen creature that didn't attack at the beginning of that turn's end step. During that turn `AttackLegalityService` bars every creature outside the set (`isOutsideChosenAttackers`) and counts one must-attack requirement for every creature inside it, so an empty choice locks combat down entirely. With no creatures to choose the empty set is registered without a prompt. Pair with a `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`. Used by Oracle en-Vec |
| `CantBlockCreaturesWithPowerGreaterOrEqualToOwnToughnessEffect` | `()` | static self-referential restriction (Ironclaw Curse): this creature can't block an attacker whose effective power ?A its own effective toughness. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeastOwnToughness()`; comparison resolved in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial`, recognized on the blocker's own STATIC effects or via an attached aura |
| `CantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeastEffect` | `(int minAttackerPower)` | static hard fixed-threshold restriction (Ironclaw Orcs, `(2)`): this creature can't block an attacker whose effective power ?A `minAttackerPower`. No cost, not self-referential. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeast()`; resolved in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial` against the attacker's effective power |
| `CreaturesWithToughnessGreaterThanPowerCantBlockThisTurnEffect` | `()` | activated-ability global restriction: until end of turn, each creature whose current effective toughness is greater than its current effective power can't block any attacker. Stored as a floating `BlockingRestrictionEffect` and evaluated during blocker declaration, so later power/toughness changes and creatures entering later are handled correctly. Used by Immobilizer Eldrazi (`OGW 97`) |
| `CantBlockSourceEffect` | `(UUID sourcePermanentId)` | target creature can't block source permanent |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, String description)` | global static: while the source is on the battlefield, any creature matching `blockerPredicate` can't block any creature matching `attackerPredicate`, board-wide (Boldwyr Intimidator "Cowards can't block Warriors"). Both predicates are evaluated with the imposing permanent's `FilterContext` (source controller + source card), so either side may be controller-relative: `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` as the attacker predicate gives "creatures with flying can't block creatures you control" (Bower Passage). Evaluated in `BlockLegalityService.findBlockDenial` |
| `MakeTargetCreatureCantBeBlockedByMostLifePlayerEffect` | `()` | targeted ability: at resolution, choose a player tied for most life and apply a until-end-of-turn global blocker restriction against that player's creatures for the target creature (The Black Gate) |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesUnlessPaysLifeEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, int lifePerBlocker, String description)` | global static life-tax counterpart of the hard deny above (Heat Wave): matching blockers can't block matching attackers unless the blocker's controller pays `lifePerBlocker` life for each such unique blocking creature. `GlobalBlockLifeCostEffect`; charged in `CombatBlockService.declareBlockers` via `GameQueryService.getGlobalBlockLifeTax`. The block stays legal for targeting — only the life cost gates it |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantAttackOrBlockEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate affectedPredicate, String description)` | global static: while the source is on the battlefield, any creature matching `affectedPredicate` can't attack OR block, board-wide. `affectedPredicate` is evaluated relative to the source's controller (`sourceControllerId`/`sourceCardId` supplied), so `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` etc. resolve "you"/"your opponents". Kulrath Knight "Creatures your opponents control with counters on them can't attack or block" = `PermanentAllOfPredicate(PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate()), PermanentHasCountersPredicate(ANY))`; Light of Day "Black creatures can't attack or block" = `PermanentColorInPredicate(BLACK)`. Attack side in `CombatAttackService.isCantAttackDueToGlobalRestriction`; block side in `GameQueryService.canBlock`/`buildBlockerFacts` |
| `TargetCreatureBecomesSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` or `(List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` | target creature **becomes** the creature type(s) until end of turn, **replacing** all its other creature types (Boldwyr Intimidator; Dance of the Skywise). One floating overriding `GrantSubtypeEffect` per type at its timestamp; contrast additive/permanent `GrantSubtypeToTargetCreatureEffect`. Also `(type or List of types, Subjects.source())` is "this creature becomes a [type] until end of turn", untargeted (Paragon of the Amesha); "in addition to its other types" is `GrantSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect(type, Subjects.source())` (Adrestia). |
| `TargetCreatureBecomesChosenSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentSubject)` / `(PermanentSubject, Set<CardSubtype>)` / `(subject, excluded, boolean retainOtherTypes[, Duration duration])` | at resolution, choose a creature type (Wall excluded by default), then the target creature, the source, the enchanted creature or a set found as it resolves becomes that type, replacing its other creature types unless `retainOtherTypes`; until end of turn by default, `Duration.PERMANENT` for "it becomes the creature type of your choice" with no stated duration (Proteus Machine, CR 611.2a) |
| `CanBeBlockedOnlyByFilterEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, String allowedBlockersDescription)` | can only be blocked by matching creatures (static; also stored transiently on a `Permanent` for until-end-of-turn grants) |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesMatchingPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate)` or `(blockerPredicate, onlyIfDefenderControls)` | negative evasion: this creature can't be blocked by blockers matching the predicate (static, validated in `GameQueryService.getBlockingIllegalityReason`). Optional `onlyIfDefenderControls` gates the restriction (Arctic Foxes: power ?A2 only while defender controls a snow land). Taoist Mystic = `PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(HORSEMANSHIP)`. On an Aura (Black Scarab), put the effect directly in STATIC � `getAuraGrantedBlockingRestrictions` collects any Aura `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect` with `blockableOnlyBy` or `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesMatching` onto the enchanted attacker |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithLessPowerEffect` | `()` | STATIC: creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block it (Shrill Howler / Howling Chorus). Facet `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithLessPower()` on `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect`; compared against effective powers at declaration in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial` |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithPowerLessThanIslandCountEffect` | `()` | STATIC: creatures with power less than the number of Islands controlled by this creature's controller can't block it (Kraken of the Straits). Facet `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithPowerLessThanIslandCount()` on `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect`; compared against current effective powers and Island count at declaration in `BlockLegalityService` |
| `GrantCanBeBlockedOnlyByFilterToOwnCreaturesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate creatureFilter, PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, String allowedBlockersDescription)` | SPELL one-shot: each of the controller's creatures matching `creatureFilter` (null = all) can be blocked only by blockers matching `blockerPredicate` until end of turn (Dread Charge). Affected creatures snapshotted at resolution (CR 611); see the effect's handler |
| `CanBeBlockedByAtMostNCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxBlockers)` | can be blocked by at most N creatures (static). Read by `GameQueryService.getMaxBlockersAllowed`, which takes the smallest cap from the creature's own STATIC effects (Stalking Tiger) and from Auras attached to it, so putting it in an Aura's `addStaticEffect` restricts the enchanted creature (Alpha Authority) |
| `EachControlledCreatureCanBeBlockedByAtMostNCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxBlockers[, PermanentPredicate affectedCreatureFilter])` | team-wide version: each creature the controller controls, optionally matching the filter, can be blocked by at most N creatures (static, validated in CombatBlockService by scanning the active player's battlefield). Yuan Shao, the Indecisive uses maxBlockers=1; Challenger Troll filters with `PermanentPowerAtLeastPredicate(4)` |
| `EachControlledCreatureCanBeBlockedByAtMostNCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxBlockers)` | team-wide version: each creature the controller controls can be blocked by at most N creatures (static, validated in CombatBlockService by scanning the active player's battlefield). Yuan Shao, the Indecisive uses maxBlockers=1 |
| `MaximumCombatCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxAttackers, int maxBlockers)` | global static cap on the number of attackers and distinct blockers declared in each combat. Read through `CombatCreatureLimitEffect`; Dueling Grounds uses `(1, 1)`. The caps are restrictions the CR 508.1d / 509.1c requirement maximum respects: `CombatAttackService.searchAttackRequirements` and `CombatBlockService.validateBlockRequirements` search the declarations that disobey no restriction, so of two "attacks each combat if able" creatures under a one-attacker cap either one attacks |
| `CantBeBlockedByFewerThanNCreaturesEffect` | `(int minBlockers)` | generalized menace: can't be blocked except by N or more creatures � if blocked, must be blocked by at least N (static, validated in CombatBlockService alongside menace). Menace is the minBlockers=2 case; Guile uses 3 |
| `CanBlockAnyNumberOfCreaturesEffect` | `()` | this creature can block any number of creatures (static) |
| `CanBlockOnlyIfAttackerMatchesPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, String allowedAttackersDescription)` | this creature can only block attackers matching predicate (static). Read by `BlockLegalityService.buildBlockerFacts` from the blocker's own STATIC effects **and** from auras/equipment attached to it (`GameQueryService.collectAuraEffects`), so an Aura may impose it on the enchanted creature (Stratus Walk) |

## Tap / untap

`UntapPermanentsEffect(Subjects.triggering())` untaps the permanent whose event caused the
trigger ("untap that land", Tiller Engine; "untap it", Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss), and its global first-event use rechecks the creature's turn-wide tap history at resolution.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `TapTargetThenUntapAnotherTargetEffect` | `()` | "Tap target permanent, then untap another target permanent." (Ral Zarek +1). Two-position multi-target: `targetIds.get(0)` is tapped, `targetIds.get(1)` is untapped; declare two permanent filters with `minTargets = maxTargets = 2` (the multi-target path already rejects duplicate targets, which is exactly what "another" requires). Each target is looked up independently at resolution, so one having left the battlefield does not stop the other half |
| `TapAndLockOtherPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | stack-resolution effect that taps every permanent matching `filter` except the source, and puts a `DoesntUntapEffect` lock on each one for as long as the source remains tapped (`WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS_TAPPED`; Kill Switch). |
| `TapAndLockTargetPermanentWhileTappedEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetFilter)` | stack-resolution effect that taps the target permanent and prevents its activated abilities from being activated for as long as that target remains tapped; the lock is keyed to the target's tapped status (Braided Net) |
| `TapPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentSubject subject[, PermanentPredicate filter[, int chosenCount]])` | taps permanent(s) as an effect (fires "becomes tapped" triggers); the subject is resolved by `SubjectResolutionService`. `Subjects.target()` (tap target, with mixed multi-target-group handling; `filter` is the targeting restriction), `allTargets()` (every target of the entry), `source()` (tap this permanent, strictly the entry's source), `attached()` (the Aura's or Equipment's host), `triggering()` ("tap that creature"), or a set: `controlledBy(targetPlayer(), filter)` (declares the player target: "tap all lands target player controls"), `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), AllOf(creature, filter))` ("tap all creatures without flying", Deluge), `controlledBy(you(), filter)`; a set's filter gets the source, X, the defending player, the triggering player and permanent. With a set, a positive `chosenCount` lets the controller tap up to N of it (Yosei, the Morning Star). Replaces the former Tap{Target,Self,EnchantedCreature,PermanentsOfTargetPlayer,AllAttackingCreatures,Creatures} records |
| `UntapPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentSubject subject[, PermanentPredicate filter[, int chosenCount]])` | untaps permanent(s) as an effect (no triggers); the subject is resolved by `SubjectResolutionService`. `Subjects.target()` (`filter` is the targeting restriction, e.g. `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` for Voltaic Servant), `allTargets()` (every target of the entry across its target groups: "untap up to four target permanents"), `source()`, `attached()` (Thornbite Staff's `Triggers.creatureDies(ANY)` untap, Paralyze's pay-to-untap upkeep trigger), `triggering()`, or a set: `controlledBy(you(), filter)` ("untap all lands you control"), `controlledBy(you(), AllOf(creature, Not(IsSourcePermanent)))` (each other creature you control), `controlledBy(targetPlayerDeclaredElsewhere(), filter)` (the player target another effect declares), `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), AllOf(creature, PermanentAttackedThisTurnPredicate))` (creatures that attacked this turn), `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), filter)` (Llanowar Druid: "Untap all Forests"), or `withCreaturesSharingAColor(target())` (Radiance: the target creature and each creature sharing a color with it, untapped like a set; Rally the Righteous). With a set, a positive `chosenCount` switches to "untap **up to** N" of its tapped permanents, chosen at resolution via `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.UntapChosenPermanents`; picking none is legal (Rewind `(controlledBy(you(), land), null, 4)`, Treachery `(controlledBy(eachPlayer(), land), null, 5)`). Replaces the former Untap{Target,AllTarget,Self,AllControlled,EachOtherCreatureYouControl,AttackedCreatures,EquippedCreature,UpToControlledPermanents,TargetAndSharingCreatures} records |

## Control / steal

| `GainControlOfTargetSpellAndCopyWithRandomTargetsEffect` | `(StackEntryPredicate)` | gains control of a target spell, copies it under the resolving controller, then independently reselects every target occurrence on both spell objects at random from targets legal for the now-controlled spell, excluding that controller and their permanents (Chef's Kiss) |

- `GainControlOfAllPermanentsMatchingEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate)` / `(PermanentPredicate, Duration)` / `(PermanentPredicate, Duration, List<CardEffect>)` | non-targeted mass steal; optional synchronous rider effects resolve in order for exactly the permanents gained after all control changes, using each gained permanent as the rider target (Broadcast Takeover)

| `ExchangeControlOfAllMatchingPermanentsWithTargetPlayerEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter[, Duration])` | targeted mass control exchange: the resolving player and target player exchange all matching permanents for the requested duration. Both sides are collected before any control changes are applied, then each permanent receives a per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect` floating control effect. Targets a player; use the target player's current battlefield for subsequent target-player-scoped riders |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect(Duration.WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS_TAPPED)` | `()` | control lasts while the source remains tapped, regardless of who controls the source (Vedalken Shackles) |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect.whileSourceRemainsTappedAndTargetMatches(PermanentPredicate)` | `(PermanentPredicate)` | control lasts while the source remains tapped and the target continues to match the supplied predicate; the control service expires it when the predicate stops matching (Old Man of the Sea) |
| `GainControlOfTargetCreatureWhileMonarchEffect` | `()` | gains control of a target creature controlled by the player who became monarch, with a floating layer-2 control effect that expires when the captured player loses the monarch designation. Used by Garland, Royal Kidnapper (FIC 442) |
| `RiskyMoveEffect` | `()` | `Triggers.youGainControlOfThis()`: the new controller chooses a creature they control and an opponent, flips a coin, and on a loss gives that creature permanent control to the chosen opponent; all choices are non-targeting. Used by Risky Move. |
| `ChooseAnotherPlayerGainsControlOfTargetPermanentEffect` | — | **Gone**: `ChoosePlayerEffect(eachOpponent(), label) + TargetPlayerGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect(playersThisWay(CHOOSE), PERMANENT, target())` |
| `TargetPlayerGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` / `.triggeringPlayer()` / `.triggeringPlayer(CardEffect thenEffect)` | The player carried on the stack entry gains control of the source permanent. The constructor targets that player; `triggeringPlayer()` is non-targeting for a trigger whose player is already known (Drooling Ogre). The follow-up overload binds the damaged player and source for a combat-damage trigger, then inserts `thenEffect` only after the control change resolves (Kain, Traitorous Dragoon). Also `(PlayerSubject)` gives the source without targeting a player: `Subjects.you()` the activating player (Oft-Nabbed Goat), `Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.target())` "that permanent's controller" (Starke of Rath, Act of Authority); `(player, Duration, Subjects.attached())` gives the host of the source Aura or Equipment (Assault Suit), `.triggeringPlayer(Duration.UNTIL_END_OF_TURN)` is Slicer's temporary handoff. |
| `PlayerWithMostLifeGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` | the player with strictly the most life gains permanent control of this creature; no-op on a tie for most life. GhazbA?n Ogre, Wild Dogs (`Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` with the intervening "if" `APlayerHasMoreLifeThanEachOtherPlayer`) |
| `PlayerWithMostCreaturesGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentPredicate creatureFilter)` | the unique player with strictly the most matching creatures gains permanent control of this creature; no-op on a tie (intervening-if). No-arg form is Wild Mammoth; filtered form is Thoughtbound Primoc (`Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)`) |
| `PlayerWithMostCardsInHandGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` | the unique player with strictly the most cards in hand gains permanent control of this creature; no-op on a tie (intervening-if). Sokenzan Renegade (`Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)`) |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect` | `(Duration duration[, CardSubtype grantedSubtype][, boolean tapWhenControlLost])`; `.of(PermanentSubject subject, Duration)` (permanents that are no target: `thisWay(CHOOSE)`) / `.ofTriggeringPermanent(Duration)` | gain control of target permanent for the given duration. `Duration{PERMANENT, END_OF_TURN, WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD}`. PERMANENT optionally grants a subtype (Captivating Vampire "It becomes a Vampire") and supports multi-target (iterates `getTargetIds()` for "up to N target" abilities); END_OF_TURN (Threaten, Metallic Mastery � card's target filter handles type restriction) wears off in end-of-turn cleanup; WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD (Olivia Voldaren) ends when the source leaves the battlefield or its creator stops controlling it. Every resolution creates a floating `L2_CONTROL` continuous effect (CR 613.2/613.7) via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect`; the controller of a permanent is DERIVED from the newest active control effect (`GameData.deriveControllerOf`), so an expiring steal falls back to the next most recent still-active effect, not blindly to the owner. Haste/untap riders (Act of Treason) are composed as separate effects on the card. `tapWhenControlLost=true` (Magus of the Unseen "When you lose control of the artifact, tap it") creates the delayed triggered ability "when you lose control of it, tap it" about the target (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, `Triggers.youLoseControlOfThis()`, controlled by the effect's controller), which triggers when that controller loses control, including when the END_OF_TURN effect expires at cleanup|
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect.gainedBy(PlayerSubject)` | `(PlayerSubject gainer)` | another player gains control (permanently or until end of turn, no rider): "target player gains control of up to three target creatures until end of turn" (Domineering Will, `targetPlayer(group)`), "target opponent gains control of all other permanents you control" (Sky Swallower, `of(except(controlledBy(you()), source()), PERMANENT).gainedBy(targetPlayer())`). Every `GainControlOfTargetEffect` records a `StepKind.GAIN_CONTROL` step (the permanents whose controller changed): "draw a card for each one they gained control of this way" is `DrawCardEffect(new AmountThisWay(StepKind.GAIN_CONTROL))` (Coveted Falcon). Its `controlDuration()` is `null` for another gainer (not a steal for the AI) |
| `RegisterControlLossUnattachTriggerEffect` | `.whenControlLost()` / `.thisTurnIfAttachedToCreatureYouControl()` | targeted Equipment rider: creates the resolving controller's delayed ability "when you lose control of that Equipment[ this turn, if it's attached to a creature you control], unattach it" (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, `Triggers.youLoseControlOfThis()`) |
| `UnattachEquipmentIfAttachedToControlledCreatureEffect` | `(UUID equipmentId)` | non-targeting reflexive follow-up that conditionally unattaches a remembered Equipment from a creature its trigger controller still controls |
| `ChooseEquipmentToUnattachEffect` | `()` | non-targeting optional choice of an Equipment attached to a creature controlled by the ability controller; if chosen, unattaches it, taps that creature, and grants it indestructible until end of turn (Akiri, Fearless Voyager) |
| `AttachTargetToSourcePermanentEffect` | `()` | attach the targeted permanent to the source permanent (e.g. steal Equipment and equip it � combine with `GainControlOfTargetEffect(END_OF_TURN)`) |

The power restriction flag provides the analogous power comparison for Spawnbroker. Legerdemain (`anyOf(artifact, creature), false, false, false, true`): `SPELL`, two same-filter `target(...)` groups plus `setMultiTargetConstraint(MultiTargetConstraint.SHARE_ARTIFACT_OR_CREATURE_TYPE)`; the fifth flag `requireSharedArtifactOrCreatureType` re-checks `GameQueryService.sharesArtifactOrCreatureType` at resolution (a shared land type alone does not satisfy it). `requireFirstTargetControlledByController` defaults to `true` (2-arg constructor) for wordings that pin target `[0]` to the ability's controller; pass `false` for plain "two target creatures" (Switcheroo � `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), false, false` with two `target(TargetFilters.creature())` groups, either slot controlled by anyone, exchange only when the controllers differ per CR 701.12b). The two interdependent targets are chosen at trigger time by a bespoke two-step permanent choice (`StepTriggerService.processNextPucasMischiefTarget` � `PermanentChoiceContext.PucasMischiefOwnTarget`/`PucasMischiefOpponentTarget`, patterned on Capricious Efreet). Multi-target activated ability (`{5}` + `SacrificeSelfCost`). The interdependent "shares one of those types" restriction is enforced at announcement via `ActivatedAbility.withMultiTargetConstraint(MultiTargetConstraint.SHARE_ARTIFACT_CREATURE_OR_LAND_TYPE)` (checked in `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiTargetConstraint` using `GameQueryService.sharesArtifactCreatureOrLandType`); per-position filter [1] is just "artifact/creature/land an opponent controls". ## Prevention / protection / redirection

| `DestroyTargetCreatureInsteadOfNextDamageEffect` | `()` | activated ability: replaces the next damage event to target creature this turn with a destruction attempt; damage is not dealt. `RemovalEffect` (DESTROY); harmful CREATURE target. The effect itself is the one-shot shield, a floating effect on the creature until end of turn, ended as `DamagePreventionService` uses it for combat or noncombat damage; indestructible and regeneration are respected. Kill-Suit Cultist |
| `RemoveDamageFromTargetLandInsteadOfNextDestructionEffect` | `()` | activated ability: replaces the target land's next destruction this turn by removing all damage marked on it. Benign LAND target. The effect itself is the one-shot shield, a floating effect on the land until end of turn, ended as `GraveyardService` uses it. Pyramids |

`PreventDamageEffect.allToControlledCreatures()` — SPELL: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn to creatures you control" (Divine Light). Adds a turn-scoped flag for the caster and checks the current controller of each creature when damage is dealt.

`PreventDamageEffect.fromChosenColor()` — SPELL: "Prevent all damage that sources of the color of your choice would deal this turn" (Prismatic Strands). Prompts for a resolution-time color, then adds that color to the turn-scoped source-color prevention set used by combat and noncombat damage paths.

| `FlipCoinForEachBlockingCreatureEffect` | `()` | Fighting Chance. At resolution, collects the blocking creatures currently on the battlefield, flips independently for each, and adds each winning blocker to a floating prevention effect for the rest of the turn |

| `PreventNextDamageToTargetAndAddPlusOnePlusOneCountersEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | "Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature" (Temper). Benign CREATURE target; X is evaluated on resolution. Its shield is a floating `DamagePreventionShield` with `plusOneCounters` on the creature (`GameData.addPermanentDamagePreventionShield`), used by `DamagePreventionService.creatureDamageSteps`, which immediately adds one +1/+1 counter per prevented damage, for both combat and noncombat damage; cleared at turn cleanup |

| `PreventDamageEffect.allToTargetCreaturesAndAddPlusOnePlusOneCounters` | `(PermanentPredicate victimPredicate)` | "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature" (Brace for Impact). Benign CREATURE target narrowed by `victimPredicate`; stores an unlimited target-creature shield and adds one +1/+1 counter per prevented damage in `DamagePreventionService.creatureDamageSteps`; cleared at turn cleanup |
| `PreventDamageEffect.allToTargetCreaturesReplacedByPlusOnePlusOneCounters` | `(PermanentPredicate victimPredicate)` | "If damage would be dealt to that creature this turn, prevent that damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it" (Gatta and Luzzu). Like the Brace for Impact form (a floating `PreventDamageEffect` with this scope on the creature until end of turn), but the counters are put even when the damage can't be prevented |

| `PreventDamageToRecipientsEffect` | `(PermanentSubject permanents, PlayerSubject players, PermanentPredicate sources, PlayerSubject sourceControllers, DamageKind damage, SourceKind sourceKind, boolean sourceOfChosenColor, DynamicAmount amount)` | STATIC: "prevent all [combat / noncombat] damage that would be dealt to [recipients] [by sources]", or "if a source would deal damage to [recipients], prevent N of that damage". Recipients are a static `PermanentSubject` and/or a static `PlayerSubject` (`you()`, `eachPlayer()`); `sources` is judged on the damage source as it is, else last known, else a spell's card, with the effect's permanent as the filter's source (an emblem source never matches a filter, CR 114.3); `sourceControllers` is "sources you control"; `sourceKind` is "spells" / "instant and sorcery spells" (the spell deals the damage itself, not a creature it makes fight); `sourceOfChosenColor` reads the effect permanent's chosen color against the source's colors as a damage source (Ghostly Flame applied); `amount` (evaluated for the effect's permanent at damage time) prevents that much of each source's damage, one option per effect. Judged as each damage event would happen (CR 615.1) by `DamagePreventionService.staticPreventionsOfPermanentDamage` / `staticPreventionsOfPlayerDamage`, read by the `StaticRecipientPrevention` and `StaticRecipientPartialPrevention` rules of each CR 616.1 damage pool. Damage dealt by a source (`dealtBy(filter)`: `toEveryone().from(filter)`) is an option of the recipient's pool too, ordered by the recipient's controller or the player (CR 616.1); a filter judges the card an ability names as the source (Blazing Torch) rather than the permanent the ability is on. A face-up plane's effect is read with the planar controller as "you". Factories `to(permanents)`, `toYouAnd(permanents)`, `toEveryone()`, `dealtBy(filter)`, then `.from(filter)`, `.fromSourcesYouControl()`, `.fromSpells()`, `.fromInstantAndSorcerySpells()`, `.fromSourcesOfChosenColor()`, `.combatOnly()`, `.noncombatOnly()`, `.preventing(n | DynamicAmount)`. Applied in `DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage`, so damage from abilities or spells not targeting the permanent is unaffected |
| `PreventDamageToTargetCreatureFromTargetingSpellOrAbilityEffect` | `()` | SPELL: protects the target creature for the turn from damage caused by a spell or ability that targets it, including damage dealt by another source. Writes a target-creature ID set consumed by the damage pipeline |
| `ReturnEnchantedCreatureToOwnerHandOnDeathEffect` | `()` or `(String followUpManaCost, String followUpPrompt)` | `Triggers.creatureDies(ObjectRelation.ENCHANTED)`: returns that card (the stack entry's triggering card, in the graveyard stay recorded as the ability triggered, CR 400.7) to its owner's hand. The optional follow-up payment is offered only after the creature was actually returned and, if paid, returns the source Aura from its owner's graveyard to its hand (the entry's triggering card id is then the Aura's). Used by Demonic Vigor and Puppet Master. |
| `RedirectAllDamageToTargetCreatureToControllerEffect` | `()` | SPELL (benign creature target): all damage that would be dealt to the target creature this turn is dealt to the spell's controller instead (Sivvi's Valor). Cleared at turn cleanup |

| `RedirectAllDamageFromSourceCreatureToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` | triggered ability (harmful creature target): all damage that would be dealt to the source creature this turn is dealt to the target creature instead (Karona's Zealot). Stores an unlimited any-source `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` from the source permanent to the target creature, covering combat and noncombat damage. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `RedirectAllDamageFromTargetSorceryToControllerEffect` | `()` | SPELL (benign sorcery target): all damage that would be dealt this turn by the targeted sorcery is dealt to that sorcery's controller instead (Reverberation). Stores a turn-scoped `TargetSorceryDamageRedirectShield` keyed by the sorcery card ID; both player and permanent damage paths use it, and permanent damage is redirected as player damage. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `RedirectAllDamageToEnchantedCreatureControllerEffect` | `()` | STATIC Aura marker: all damage that would be dealt to the enchanted creature is dealt to its current controller instead (Treacherous Link). | `RedirectAllDamageFromTargetAttackingCreatureToSelfEffect` | `()` | activated ability (benign attacking-creature target): all damage that would be dealt to the ability's controller this turn by the target attacking creature is dealt to the ability's source creature instead (Shimian Night Stalker). Uses a source-specific turn redirect shield, so it covers combat and noncombat damage to the controller only |
| `RedirectAllCreatureDamageToControllerEffect` | `()` or pending damage choice payload | SPELL: this turn, its controller may redirect damage from any creature to themselves. Registers floating `RedirectAllCreatureDamageToControllerEffect` effects, cleared at turn cleanup. Used by Blood of the Martyr. |

| `WallOnlyTargetingRestrictionEffect` | `()` | static marker: the permanent cannot be targeted by a spell or ability whose legal targets are restricted to Walls. Enforced by the targeting services from announcement through resolution; modal spells use the union of their modes |

## Mana

Which permanents count and who taps them is the trigger: `Triggers.youTapLandForMana()` ("whenever you tap a land", Crypt Ghast with `.withFilter(new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP))`), `playerTapsLandForMana().withFilter(...)` ("whenever a Forest is tapped", Vernal Bloom), `youTapThisLandForMana()`, `youTapCreatureForMana()`.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `AddManaWhenTappedForManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color)` | a tap-for-mana triggered mana ability's "add an additional {C}" / "its controller adds an additional {C}": the player who tapped the permanent (the entry's triggering player, CR 602.2) adds one mana of `color`, resolved at once by the tap-for-mana default (CR 605.4a). Groundchuck & Dirtbag (`youTapLandForMana()`), Crypt Ghast, Nissa, Nirkana Revenant (`youTapLandForMana().withFilter(subtype)`), Leyline of Abundance, Badgermole Cub (`youTapCreatureForMana()`); `ofItsController(color)` is "its controller adds": the tapped permanent's controller adds it (Vernal Bloom, Gauntlet of Might on `playerTapsLandForMana().withFilter(subtype)`; a player tapping another's land through Piracy is not its controller) |
| `AwardManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color, DynamicAmount amount)`, `(ManaColor color, int amount)`, or `(ManaColor color)` (defaults amount to 1) | add mana of the specified color; the quantity is a `DynamicAmount` (see "Dynamic amounts"). Flat: `(color)`/`(color, N)`. "for each X you control": `PermanentCount(filter, CountScope.CONTROLLER)`. "for each charge counter on it": `CountersOnSource(CounterType.CHARGE)` (Shrine of Boundless Growth). "equal to its power": `SourcePower()` (Marwyn, the Nurturer; Molten-Core Maestro). Implements `ManaProducingEffect`. Resolves inline for mana abilities (from the source permanent) and on the stack via `AwardManaEffectHandler` for triggered/loyalty mana (needs the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId`); dynamic amounts produce no mana when they evaluate to ? 0 and track creature mana when the source is a creature |
| `AwardManaToChosenPlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount)` | "Choose a player. That player adds N mana of `color`." A mana ability (CR 605.1a) whose recipient may be any player � choosing a player is NOT targeting, so it resolves inline: `doResolveManaAbility` begins a `PermanentChoice` (validPlayerIds = all players) and `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService.handleManaAbilityAddToChosenPlayer` routes the mana into the chosen player's pool (tracking creature mana when the source is a creature; Mana Reflection multiplier applied). Used by Valleymaker (`GREEN, 3`) |
| `AwardManaToActivePlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount[, ManaRestriction restriction])` | "that player adds N mana of `color`" on a precombat-main trigger. The recipient is the stack entry's active player (recorded when the trigger was pushed, not a target), falling back to `targetId` and then the entry controller; an optional restriction routes the mana into its restricted bucket. NOT a `ManaProducingEffect` — a beginning-of-step trigger uses the stack (CR 605.1b), not a mana ability. Used by Eladamri's Vineyard (`GREEN, 2`) and Karolina Dean, Runaway. |
| `AwardManaToCastingPlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color[, int amount])` | adds mana of `color` to the player who cast the spell that caused the trigger. The casting player is carried by the triggered ability's `targetId` without being a chosen target. Used by Tangleroot (`GREEN, 1`) with `Triggers.playerCastsSpell()` |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount, ManaSpendRestriction restriction, CardSubtype subtype)` — sugar: `()`, `(int)`, `(DynamicAmount)`, `(int, ManaSpendRestriction)`, `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, CardSubtype)` | add N mana of any color (player chooses). Targeted stack abilities distinguish `targetsPlayer` (the effect needs a player target) from `manaRecipientIsTargetPlayer` (that target receives the mana), allowing Carpet of Flowers to count a targeted opponent while awarding mana to its controller and Radiant Lotus to award mana to its target. `restriction` is the CR 106.6 rider on that mana and also decides whether one pick colours the whole batch ("any one color") or the controller picks a colour per mana ("any combination of colors"): `NONE` = ordinary pool; `INSTANT_SORCERY_COPY` = ordinary pool, each unit tagged with `ManaCopyRider.INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_SPELL` (via `GameData.markPendingCopyRiderManaChoice` until the colour is chosen) so the instant/sorcery it pays for is copied once per unit (Primal Wellspring); `INSTANT_SORCERY_ONLY` → `ManaPool.instantSorceryOnlyColored` (Resonating Lute, granted to lands); `ARTIFACT_SPELLS_OR_ABILITIES` → per-color `ManaPool.artifactOnlyMana`, usable to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts (Vedalken Engineer); `FLASHBACK_ONLY` → `ManaPool.flashbackOnlyMana`, read by `ManaCost.canPayFlashback/payFlashback`, colour per mana (Altar of the Lost); `GRAVEYARD_SPELL_ONLY` → `ManaPool.graveyardOnlyMana`, temporarily promoted by `ManaCost.canPayFromGraveyard/payFromGraveyard` (Rootcoil Creeper); `CREATURE_SPELL_ONLY` → `ManaPool.creatureSpellOnlyMana`, read via the `creatureSpellOnlyContext` flag `SpellCastingService`/`GameActionAvailabilityService` set to `card.hasType(CREATURE)`; cannot pay ability costs (Ancient Ziggurat 1, Somberwald Sage 3); `CHOSEN_SUBTYPE_CREATURE` → `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` keyed by the source's `ChooseSubtypeOnEnterEffect` type, read via `Set<CardSubtype> subtypeCreatureContext`; adds nothing when no type was chosen (Pillar of Origins, Unclaimed Territory); `CHOSEN_SUBTYPE_CREATURE_UNCOUNTERABLE` = the same, also recorded in `ManaPool.uncounterableSubtypeCreatureMana` (a marker subset never counted in totals) so spending it produces a `GameData.spellsMadeUncounterable` entry (Cavern of Souls); `SUBTYPE_SPELL` → the same `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` bucket for the effect's own `subtype`, so it cannot pay abilities either; the type is printed on the card rather than chosen as the source entered (Sliver Hive `(1, SUBTYPE_SPELL, SLIVER)`); `SUBTYPE_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` → `ManaPool.subtypeSpellOrAbilityMana` for the effect's own `subtype`, read via `Set<CardSubtype> subtypeSpellOrAbilityContext` (spells **and** activated abilities), colour per mana (Smokebraider `(2, SUBTYPE_SPELL_OR_ABILITY, ELEMENTAL)`). `subtype` is set only for the two printed-subtype restrictions. Implements `ManaProducingEffect`; only the unrestricted Fixed-amount shape reports `estimatedCountsAllColors()`. Implements `ManaProducingEffect` so it works as a mana ability. `restriction.applyTo(pool, color, amount)` routes into the matching `ManaPool` bucket; the spend side (`ManaCost.canPay/pay` context flags) keys on the bucket, not the effect. `ManaRestriction` cases: `SpellTypes(Set<CardType>)` � instant/sorcery-only � `instantSorceryOnlyColorless`/`instantSorceryOnlyColored`, red creature+artifact-only (Geosurge) � `restrictedRed`, else plain mana; `ArtifactSpells()` � `artifactOnlyColorless` (Grand Architect � cast artifact spells or activate artifact abilities); `ArtifactAbilities()` � `artifactAbilityOnlyColorless` (Soldevi Machinist � activate artifact abilities only); `SubtypeCreatureSpells(CardSubtype)` routes to the per-subtype/per-color `subtypeCreatureMana` bucket, spendable only on creature spells of that subtype (Gnarlroot Trapper, `(GREEN, 1, SubtypeCreatureSpells(ELF))`; Giada / ANGEL); `LegendarySpells()` routes to `legendarySpellOnlyColorless` (Untaidake, the Cloud Keeper: cast legendary spells only, spell-only so it can't pay activation costs; the cast path sets the context flag from `CardSupertype.LEGENDARY`); `SubtypeSpells(CardSubtype)` routes to Myr-only colorless mana (Myr Reservoir); `KickedCosts()` � `kickedOnlyGreen` (Elfhame Druid); `XCosts()` � `xCostOnlyColorless` for colorless output or `xCostOnlyMana` for colored output (Rosheen Meanderer; Anina, Natural Parallelist); `ColoredSpellsWithoutX()` � `coloredSpellWithoutXOnlyColorless` (Titans' Nest); `CumulativeUpkeepCosts()` � `cumulativeUpkeepOnlyColorless` / `cumulativeUpkeepOnlyColored` (Adarkar Unicorn). `XCosts()` mana is usable only when the cost being paid contains an {X} symbol (`ManaCost.hasX()`), for any generic portion of that cost � spend logic gates on `hasX()` directly (no context flag), so it works for both X spells and X activated abilities. `ColoredSpellsWithoutX()` mana is usable only while casting a colored spell whose mana cost does not contain {X}; it is promoted into the ordinary colorless pool only for that cast. `CumulativeUpkeepCosts()` mana is usable only when paying a `PayManaCost` with `forCumulativeUpkeep=true` (from `CumulativeUpkeepEffect`) |

## Copy / clone

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect.fromAnyGraveyard(CardPredicate, String)` — optional copy replacement that chooses one matching card from any graveyard (Body Double); the chosen card stays in its graveyard.
- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect.fromAnyGraveyard(CardPredicate, String, boolean entersTapped, Set<CardSubtype>)` — graveyard copy that enters tapped and gains the given subtypes only when it copies (Echoing Deeps).

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect.withVanishingIfCopiedPermanentLacksIt(PermanentPredicate, String)` — copy exception that adds vanishing 3, its three time counters, and its upkeep sacrifice trigger only when the chosen battlefield permanent lacks vanishing (Flesh Duplicate).

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect(PermanentPredicate, String, CardSupertype, boolean)` — copy exception overload that removes the given supertype and adds a +1/+1 counter to copied creatures and a loyalty counter to copied planeswalkers (Spark Double).

| `MakeTargetCreaturesCopiesOfChosenCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | — | **Gone** (fold run 17): `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, controlledBy(eachPlayer(), filter), label)` + `BecomeCopyOfSubjectEffect.of(thisWay(CHOOSE)).by(Subjects.target()).untilEndOfTurn()` |

|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, DynamicAmount additionalPlusOnePlusOneCounters)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride, boolean copyPowerToughnessFromSource)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride, List<ActivatedAbility> additionalActivatedAbilities)` | enter as copy of permanent matching filter (Clone-style). Optional P/T overrides for "copy except it's X/Y" (e.g. Quicksilver Gargantuan). `copyPowerToughnessFromSource` uses the entering card's cast-mode P/T instead of the chosen permanent's P/T (Hulking Metamorph). Optional `additionalTypesOverride` for "copy except it's also an [type]" (e.g. Phyrexian Metamorph is always an artifact). Optional `additionalPlusOnePlusOneCounters` for "except it enters with X additional +1/+1 counters" (Altered Ego) � applied only when the controller chooses to copy; declining leaves a 0/0 with no counters from this effect. No-arg form for `addSpellEffect` (filter on Card's SpellTarget). Filter form for `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)` � carries the filter to restrict which spells can be targeted (e.g. Naru Meha uses `StackEntryAllOfPredicate(StackEntryTypeInPredicate(INSTANT, SORCERY), StackEntryControlledByPredicate())`). For "copy twice if cast from a graveyard" (Increasing Vengeance), add a base `CopySpellEffect()` plus `ConditionalEffect(new CastFromZone(Zone.GRAVEYARD), new CopySpellEffect())` rather than a count parameter. `tokenWithHaste=true` (for copying a **creature** spell): the copy becomes a token, gains `HASTE`, and the retarget prompt is suppressed; with `sacrificeAtEndStep=true` the resulting permanent is sacrificed by a delayed triggered ability for the next end step (Choreographed Sparks). `forTargetSpellController()` makes the copy controlled by the target spell's controller and is used by Meletis Charlatan. All copy handlers skip spells whose card has `cantBeCopied=true` `CopySpellEffect.times(n)` makes one copy event of n copies (Echo Mage "copy it twice"): global extra-copy replacements such as Twinning Staff add one copy to the event, not one per copy. |

Uses a mixed permanent/graveyard target and the shared temporary-copy expiry. Used by Taskmaster, Mercenary Mimic. |
| `EachControlledPermanentBecomesCopyOfTargetNonAuraPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | each permanent the controller controls matching `filter` becomes a permanent copy of target non-Aura permanent (Mirrorform). Snapshots the controller's battlefield before applying `PermanentCopierService.applyCloneCopy`; target is benign and narrowed to non-Aura, with no floating expiry |
| `ChangeTargetOfTargetSpellWithSingleTargetEffect` | `()` / `(boolean creatureTargetsOnly)` / `playersOnly()` / `sourceCreatureTargetsOnly()` | change target of target spell with a single target (Deflection, Shunt, Swerve). With `creatureTargetsOnly = true` the redirect only happens when that single target is a creature and the new target must be another creature (Meddle); `playersOnly()` restricts the new target to a player (Reflecting Mirror); `sourceCreatureTargetsOnly()` additionally requires every target of the original spell to be the source creature, repeats allowed (Silver Wyvern); `sourceCreatureSingleTarget()` requires exactly one target, which must be the source creature (Quicksilver Dragon) |
| `ChooseTargetsAtRandomEffect` | `()` | static marker: the single target of every spell and ability is replaced at random from its legal targets as it is put on the stack, without using the stack. Used by High Troller |
| `ReselectTargetAtRandomEffect` | `()` | global target-choice trigger body: reselects the triggering spell or ability's single target uniformly from all targets legal at resolution, including its current target. "If it has a single target" is the card's intervening "if" (`TriggeringSpellMatches(new StackEntryIsSingleTargetPredicate())`). Used by Grip of Chaos |
| `ChangeTargetOfTargetSpellUnlessControllerPaysEffect` | `(int payAmount)` | change target of a single-target spell unless its controller pays the fixed generic mana amount; if payment is declined or unavailable, the existing retargeting flow chooses a new legal target (Divert) |
| `ChangeTargetOfTargetSpellToEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `()` | non-targeting spell-cast trigger effect: changes the triggering single-target spell's target to the source Aura's captured enchanted creature when legal. Used by Captured by the Consulate |
| `ChangeAllTargetsOfTargetSpellToSourceEffect` | `()` | changes every target occurrence of a target spell to the source creature when all occurrences identify one creature, including repeated occurrences (Muck Drubb) |
| `ChangeTargetOfTargetSpellToSourceEffect` | `()` | change a target of target spell or ability to source permanent (e.g. Spellskite). Automatically redirects without player choice. If source is not a legal target or spell has no targets, does nothing. Use with StackEntryHasTargetPredicate to allow targeting spells and abilities on the stack. Also works on `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)` (Mizzium Meddler): the ETB spell-target pipeline chooses the spell/ability as the trigger goes on the stack and passes the entering permanent as `sourcePermanentId`; a `StackEntryHasTargetPredicate` in the card's filter makes abilities on the stack legal targets there too. |
| `ChooseNewTargetsForTargetSpellEffect` | `()` | you may choose new targets for target spell (e.g. Redirect). Targets any spell on the stack. On resolution, if target spell has targets, offers a may-ability prompt to choose new targets. No target filter needed � works on any spell. |
| `ChooseNewTargetsForAnyNumberOfOtherSpellsAndAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | face-up trigger effect that queues optional retarget choices for every other targeted spell or ability on the stack; each target occurrence is revalidated and may be changed independently. Boltbender |
| `ChooseNewTargetsForStackEntryEffect` | `(UUID stackEntryId, int targetIndex)` | pending may-choice marker used by `ChooseNewTargetsForAnyNumberOfOtherSpellsAndAbilitiesEffect`; retargets one target occurrence through the normal stack-entry target legality flow. |
| `PsychicBattleEffect` | `()` | Psychic Battle's global target-choice trigger body: reveals each player's top card, identifies a unique highest mana value, and offers that player a separate may choice for each legal target to change. Ties and empty comparisons leave targets unchanged. |
| `PsychicBattleRetargetEffect` | `(UUID spellCardId, int targetIndex)` | internal may-ability payload for Psychic Battle's per-target retarget choice; the permanent-choice continuation validates legal distinct replacements and does not retrigger Psychic Battle. |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `RunedTerrorEffect` | `()` | Static game-structure marker: while Runed Terror remains on the battlefield, players receive the current beginning, first main, combat, second main, and ending phases sequentially; the turn engine returns to ordinary progression when the last copy leaves |
| `PhaseOutTargetCreatureUntilSourceLeavesEffect` | `()` | Oubliette's targeted ETB phase-out: the target creature is held by a floating `PhasedOutHeldEffect` (`Duration.WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD`) so normal untap-step phasing does not return it; when the source permanent leaves, the creature and its phased-out attachments phase in and the creature is tapped. The effect declares a harmful creature target and does nothing if either source or target has left before resolution |
| `PhaseOutAllCreaturesUntilSourceLeavesEffect` | `()` | Out of Time's non-targeting ETB phase-out: every creature is held by a floating `PhasedOutHeldEffect` until the source leaves, and the source receives one time counter per successful phase-out. When the source leaves, the held creatures and their phased-out attachments phase in tapped |
| `PhaseOutTargetPermanentWhileSourceControlledEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` / `()` | The Phasing of Zhalfir's chapter phase-out: the target phases out and a floating `PhasedOutHeldEffect` with `WHILE_SOURCE_CONTROLLED` keeps it from phasing in; it ends as the Saga leaves, changes control or phases out (CR 702.26f), and the permanent then phases in at its controller's next untap step |
| `PhaseOutTargetPermanentWhileSourceTappedEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` / `()` | The Pandorica's targeted phase-out: the target phases out, a floating `PhasedOutHeldEffect` with `WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS_TAPPED` keeps it from phasing in, and `GameData.permanentsPhasedOutBySource` records it as "that permanent" for the source's `PhaseInLinkedPermanentEffect` ("when this becomes untapped or leaves the battlefield, that permanent phases in") |
| `PhaseOutTargetPermanentUntilPlaneswalkEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` / `()` | Phases out a target permanent and holds it with a floating `PhasedOutHeldEffect` (`Duration.UNTIL_PLANESWALK`) until a player planeswalks; the effect declares a harmful permanent target narrowed by `targetPredicate` when supplied |
| `PhaseInLinkedPermanentEffect` | `()` | Phases in the permanent linked to the trigger source by `GameData.permanentsPhasedOutBySource` (`PhasingService.phaseInLinkedPermanents`), used when The Pandorica becomes untapped (with the event condition `SourceKeepsPermanentPhasedOut()`, so the ability exists only once a permanent was phased out) or leaves the battlefield |
| `TimesifterEffect` | `()` | each upkeep, exiles the top card of every contender's library, repeats among tied greatest mana values, and grants the remaining player an extra turn |
| `ControllerExtraTurnEffect` | `(int count)` / `(int count, boolean skipUntapStep)` / `(int count, boolean skipUntapStep, boolean powerUpAbilitiesDisabled)` | controller takes N extra turns (no targeting); `skipUntapStep=true` skips each granted turn's untap step (permanents stay tapped, summoning sickness still clears) � Savor the Moment; `powerUpAbilitiesDisabled=true` prohibits Power-up abilities during each granted turn |
| `RegisterLoseGameAtEndStepEffect` | `()` | makes the delayed triggered ability "you lose the game" (`ControllerLosesGameEffect`, so it respects can't-lose, Platinum Angel). After an extra-turn spell (Last Chance, Final Fortune, Warrior's Oath, Chance for Glory, Alchemist's Gambit) it is "at the beginning of that turn's end step": `DelayedReferents.duringExtraTurn(sequence)` ties it to that extra turn's end step, and `GameData.endDelayedAbilitiesOfExtraTurn` ends it when that turn is skipped or ended without its end step. Otherwise it is "at the beginning of your next end step" (Glorious End): `Triggers.endStep(YOU)` waiting past the turn it was made in. SPELL, non-targeting |
| `ExtraTurnEffect` | `(int count)` | target player takes N extra turns |
| `ControllerExtraTurnEffect` | `(int count, boolean skipUntapStep, boolean damageCantBePrevented)` | controller takes N extra turns; the third argument makes damage unpreventable during each granted turn (Alchemist's Gambit) |
| `AdditionalCombatMainPhaseEffect` | `(int count[, CardEffect additionalCombatBeginningEffect])` | get N additional combat + main phases (Relentless Assault). Increments `additionalCombatMainPhasePairs`; consumed after the current main phase. The three-argument form adds `onlyDuringMainPhase` for Relentless Assault. `additionalCombatMainPhasePairsReturnStep` preserves the original combat when pairs are inserted after the precombat main phase. The optional effect is queued as a delayed trigger for each added combat's beginning (World at War) |
| `AdditionalCombatPhaseEffect` | `(int count[, CardEffect additionalCombatBeginningEffect])` | get N additional combat phases with NO additional main phase (Finest Hour). Increments `additionalCombatPhasesOnly`; consumed when leaving END_OF_COMBAT so the extra combat follows directly with no main phase between. The optional effect is queued as a delayed trigger for each added combat's beginning (Bumi, Unleashed) |
| `OnlyLandCreaturesCanAttackThisCombatEffect` | `()` | as an added combat's "during that combat" floating effect (`Duration.duringCombatPhase`, not a triggered ability): only land creatures can attack during the current additional combat phase (Bumi, Unleashed) |
| `IllusionistsGambitEffect` | `()` | removes and untaps the current attackers, then schedules an additional combat whose beginning payload remembers those permanent objects; those creatures attack if able and cannot attack the spell's controller or that player's planeswalkers during that combat | Illusionist's Gambit (C13 #47) |
| `OnlySourceCreatureCanAttackThisCombatEffect` | `()` | as an added combat's "during that combat" floating effect (`Duration.duringCombatPhase`, not a triggered ability): only the source permanent can attack during the current additional combat phase (Throat Wolf) |
| `FirstestStrikeEffect` | `()` | STATIC marker for a dedicated combat-damage step before first strike; the source can deal that damage only to creatures (Throat Wolf) |
| `AdditionalCombatPhasesAfterMainEffect` | `(int count[, boolean onlyTargetCreaturesCanAttack][, CardEffect additionalCombatBeginningEffect])` | insert N additional combat phases after the resolving main phase, with no main phase between them (Full Throttle). The turn engine resumes the normal next phase afterward |
| `RegisterDelayedAttackUntapEffect` | `()` | registers "when you next attack this turn" (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.nextThisTurn`, `Triggers.youAttack()`): untap each creature you control (All-Out Assault) |

| `UntapAttackedCreaturesEachCombatThisTurnEffect` | `()` | registers a `thisTurn` delayed triggered ability on every beginning of combat, untapping all creatures that attacked this turn (Full Throttle) |
| `EndTurnEffect` | `()` | end the turn |
| `EndCombatPhaseEffect` | `()` | exiles all spells and abilities remaining on the stack, clears combat state and combat-only delayed actions, expires until-end-of-combat effects, and skips directly to the postcombat main phase; the resolving spell is marked for exile by its handler | Mandate of Peace (C19 4) |
| `ControlTargetPlayerNextTurnEffect` | `()` / `(boolean grantExtraTurnAfter)` | control target player during their next turn (Mindslaver). `grantExtraTurnAfter=true` (Emrakul, the Promised End) also grants that player an extra turn after the controlled turn � carried by its `ControlPlayerEffect` floating effect and queued by `TurnProgressionService` only when control actually begins |
| `ControlTargetPlayersNextTurnsEffect` | `()` | two distinct target players control each other during their respective next turns (Cruel Entertainment) |
| `ControlTargetPlayerNextCombatOrTurnEffect` | `()` | control target player during their next combat phase, or during their next turn when the spell's optional waterbend cost was paid |
| `PermanentsEnterTappedThisTurnEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | the no-arg form makes all permanents enter tapped this turn; the filtered form makes matching permanents entering under the resolving controller's control enter tapped this turn.
