Uses a dedicated progress state across the two discard interactions. |
| `DrawBeforeConniveReplacementEffect` | `()` | Static replacement marker that adds one normal draw before each creature connive controlled by the marker's controller. Used by Leader, Super-Genius |
| `DrawDiscardAndConniveEffect` | `()` or `(boolean targetPermanent)` or `(DynamicAmount amount[, boolean targetPermanent])`; `ofTriggeringPermanent([DynamicAmount amount])` (Mask of the Schemer's "it connives X": `ofTriggeringPermanent(new EventValue())`) | Draw and discard the evaluated amount; put a +1/+1 counter on the source or targeted creature (with `ofTriggeringPermanent()`, the stack entry's triggering permanent: "it connives") for each nonland card discarded. The no-argument and boolean forms default to one card. Counters are applied via a pending hook after each interactive discard. Used by Doc Ock's Henchmen, Unstable Experiment, and Raffine, Scheming Seer |
| `CreateTokensForDistinctDiscardedCardTypesEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenTemplate)` | Creates one copy of the token template for each distinct card type (printed and additional) among the cards the most recent DISCARD step of the resolution discarded. Occult Epiphany |
| `ConniveEachTargetEffect` | `()` | Each creature in the bound multi-target group connives in order, preserving interactive discard completion and the normal nonland-discard counter rule. Used by Change of Plans |
| `PhaseOutChosenTargetCreaturesEffect` | `()` | The controller chooses any number of surviving creatures in the bound multi-target group to phase out. Reuses the shared up-to-N controlled-permanent choice with a runtime filter restricted to those targets. Used by Change of Plans |
| `ConniveConvokeCreaturesEffect` | `()` | Expands the resolving spell's captured convoke creature IDs into one non-targeting connive effect per creature, preserving interactive draw/discard and counter handling (Lethal Scheme) |
| `ConniveConvokeCreaturesEffect` | `()` | Each captured convoke creature connives in order. Uses the resolving spell entry's convoke ids, the normal connive discard interaction and pending counter hook, and re-enters the same effect between creatures (Lethal Scheme) |
| `DiscardAnyNumberEffect` | `()` or `(boolean random)` | controller chooses zero through their hand size to discard; the chosen count is stored as the stack entry event value for a following effect that refers to cards discarded this way (Sacred Rites). With `random=true`, the controller chooses only the number and those cards are discarded at random (Rites of Initiation) |
| `AddCardTypeToTargetPermanentEffect` | `(CardType cardType)` or `(CardType cardType, boolean persistent)` | target permanent becomes the given card type in addition to its other types. When persistent=false (default, 1-arg constructor), a floating `GrantCardTypeEffect` until end of turn (e.g. Liquimetal Coating). When persistent=true, the floating grant is `PERMANENT` and survives turn cleanup (e.g. Phyrexian Scriptures chapter I making a creature an artifact permanently) |
| `GrantCardTypeToOwnPermanentsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardType cardType[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | on resolution, additively grants the card type until end of turn to matching permanents the controller controls; the affected set is fixed at resolution (e.g. Start Your Engines) |
| `RemoveCardTypeFromTargetPermanentEffect` | `(CardType cardType[, PermanentSubject subject])` | target permanent (default) or source (`Subjects.source()`) loses the given card type until end of turn. The handler installs a timestamped layer-4 floating effect, allowing later type-changing effects to interact with it in timestamp order. |
| `RemoveCardTypeFromAttachedPermanentEffect` | `(CardType cardType[, PermanentSubject subject])` | STATIC layer-4 effect that removes the given card type from the permanent attached to the source; defaults to `Subjects.attachedCreature()`. | Optional duration defaults PERMANENT; `SELF, WHILE_ATTACHED` removes only the stated type from an attached source, preserving its other types (Cloudsteel Kirin).
| `GrantBasicLandTypeToTargetEffect` | `(Duration duration)`, `(Duration duration, CardSubtype fixedSubtype)`, or `(Duration duration, CardSubtype fixedSubtype, boolean replacing)` | changes a target land's basic land type. When `replacing == false` (default): adds the type "in addition to its other types" + grants that type's mana ability; each is a floating `GrantSubtypeEffect` on the land with the stated duration (`STATIC` becomes `PERMANENT`), at its timestamp (CR 613.7): additive when adding (UNTIL_END_OF_TURN also grants the type's mana ability as a temporary ability; STATIC keeps a granted subtype + permanent ability), overriding when `replacing == true` (the land **becomes** the type, losing its other land types and mana abilities, CR 305.7). With `fixedSubtype == null`, prompts controller to choose (AddBasicLandTypeChoice, carrying the `replacing` flag); with a fixed subtype, applies directly. permanent-targeting spec. Used by Navigator's Compass (prompt, add, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN), Aquitect's Will (fixed ISLAND, add, STATIC), Tideshaper Mystic (prompt, replacing, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN) |
| `GrantBasicLandTypeToTargetEffect` | `(Duration duration)`, `(Duration duration, CardSubtype fixedSubtype)`, or `(Duration duration, CardSubtype fixedSubtype, boolean replacing)` | changes a target land's basic land type. When `replacing == false` (default): adds the type "in addition to its other types" + grants that type's mana ability; each is a floating `GrantSubtypeEffect` on the land with the stated duration (`STATIC` becomes `PERMANENT`), at its timestamp (CR 613.7): additive when adding (UNTIL_END_OF_TURN also grants the type's mana ability as a temporary ability; STATIC keeps a granted subtype + permanent ability), overriding when `replacing == true` (the land **becomes** the type, losing its other land types and mana abilities, CR 305.7). With `fixedSubtype == null`, prompts controller to choose (AddBasicLandTypeChoice, carrying the `replacing` flag); with a fixed subtype, applies directly. canTargetPermanent=true. Used by Navigator's Compass (prompt, add, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN), Aquitect's Will (fixed ISLAND, add, STATIC), Tideshaper Mystic (prompt, replacing, UNTIL_END_OF_TURN), Orcish Farmer (fixed SWAMP, replacing, UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UNTAP_STEP) |
| `TargetLandBecomesBasicLandTypeUntilSourceLeavesEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype[, Duration duration])` | resolution-time target land change: adds a floating layer-4 type override with its own timestamp (CR 613.7); the land becomes the fixed basic land type and reverts when the source leaves the battlefield. `duration` defaults to `UNTIL_SOURCE_LEAVES` ("until this creature leaves the battlefield", which phasing out doesn't end, CR 702.26d: Gaea's Liege, Graceful Antelope); pass `WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS` for "for as long as this creature remains on the battlefield" (Tide Shaper; ends as the source phases out, CR 702.26f). Benign LAND target |
| `TextChangeEffect` | `(String fromWord, String toWord)` | payload only, never on a card: a layer-3 text change on a permanent (CR 612.1, 613.1c) that `ChangeColorTextEffect` and a spell's carried text change make, with their duration; read through `GameData.textReplacements(permanentId)` |
| `GrantEquipByManaValueEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | grants matching artifacts equip {X} and an `AttachedBoostEffect` for +X/+0 using the granted Equipment ability's mana value. The boost is an ability of the Equipment and disappears when that granted ability is removed |

## Enchantment-specific

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfEffect` | `()` | put an aura from hand onto this creature (ETB). Also `(Subjects.triggering())` attaches to the creature the trigger was about (Holy Avenger). |
| `AuraSwapEffect` | `()` | offers to exchange the source Aura with an eligible Aura card in its controller's hand; the chosen Aura enters attached to the source Aura's enchanted permanent and the source Aura returns to its owner's hand |
| `EquipmentSwapEffect` | `()` | offers to exchange the source Equipment with an eligible Equipment card in its controller's hand; the chosen Equipment enters attached to the source Equipment's equipped creature, or unattached when the source is unattached, and the source Equipment returns to its owner's hand |
| `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfWithinXManaValueOrExileEffect` | `()` | Evershrike: "You may put an Aura card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield attached to this creature. If you don't, exile this creature." The mana-value cap is the ability's paid X (`entry.getXValue()`); only Aura cards with `getManaValue() <= X` are offered. Declining, or having no eligible Aura, exiles the source (via the `exileSourceIfDeclinedId` field on `PendingInteraction.TargetedHandCardChoice`). Pair after a self-return-to-battlefield `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` in a graveyard activated ability |
| `ChangeColorTextEffect` | `(boolean colorWordsAllowed, boolean landTypesAllowed, boolean canTargetSpell[, boolean untilEndOfTurn])` | change color words (when `colorWordsAllowed`) and/or basic land type words (when `landTypesAllowed`) in target permanent's text (Mind Bend = `(true, true, false)` / Sleight of Mind-style; Magical Hack = `(false, true, true)`, land types only). When `canTargetSpell` the target may instead be a spell on the stack (Glamerdye = `(true, false, true)`, color words only): the change is recorded in `gameData.spellTextReplacements` keyed by the spell's card id and carried onto the permanent it resolves into by `BattlefieldEntryService` (CR 613.7); on an instant/sorcery it is an inert no-op. Resolution puts a floating `TextChangeEffect(fromWord, toWord)` on the permanent (`GameData.textReplacements` reads them in timestamp order) — a CR 613 layer-3 text change: `TextChangeTransformer` rewrites the words of every effect instance the permanent contributes before layers 4–7 apply them, and its own printed protection/basic land types are seeded rewritten. With no stated duration it lasts as long as the permanent stays on the battlefield (CR 611.2a, 400.7), NOT copiable (CR 707.2). Pass `untilEndOfTurn = true` (Whim of Volrath = `(true, true, false, true)`) to make it an `UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` effect instead. A "spell or permanent" single target is routed by zone inference in `SpellCastingService` (hand + retrace paths) via `TargetLegalityService.isSpellOnStack`. See the layer 3 text changes in `agent-docs/LAYER_SYSTEM.md` for the covered effect types |

Bonehoard/Runechanter's Pike (`CardsInGraveyard`), Blackblade Reforged (`PermanentCount(PermanentIsLandPredicate, CONTROLLER)`), Lashwrithe (`PermanentCount(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP), CONTROLLER)`), Strata Scythe (`LandsMatchingImprintedName()`) |

"Sacrifice that permanent" is `SacrificeSelfEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()`, "destroy that permanent" `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(Subjects.triggering())`; the permanent stays until the ability resolves |

Legality per kind is `EquipSupport.canAttach` / `canAttachToPlayer` (enchant ability, CR 303.4d; CR 301.5c; CR 301.6; protection, CR 702.16c-d); one that can't be attached, or is already attached to the host, doesn't move (CR 701.3b); a moved one gets a new timestamp (CR 613.7e), and control is reconciled when it carries a control effect. Records `StepKind.ATTACH` (the attachments that moved: "if you do" is `HappenedThisWay(ATTACH)`). When configured, queues `thenEffect` as a reflexive ability only after the attachment succeeds. Used by equipment with "When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control" (Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)), including Novel Nunchaku's attach-then-fight rider, or "Whenever equipped creature dies, attach this Equipment to target creature you control" (Triggers.creatureDies(EQUIPPED)). |

`SpellsAndLandsWithSpecifiedNamesCantBePlayedEffect(Set<String> cardNames)` is a symmetric STATIC restriction for a fixed roster: spells and lands with listed names can't be cast/played, including basic lands (City in a Bottle). It uses the shared `CardNameRestrictionEffect` permission path.

## Static restrictions / taxes

`GrantNoMaximumHandSizeEffect(duration)` is the one-shot hand-size grant for the resolving
controller, `PERMANENT` or `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`. It is distinct from `NoMaximumHandSizeEffect`,
which is a static permanent effect lasting only while its permanent is on the battlefield.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CantCastSpellsWithSameNameAsExiledCardEffect` | `()` or `(boolean opponentsOnly)` | prevents casting spells with the same name as a card exiled with or imprinted on the source permanent. When `opponentsOnly=false` (default), restricts all players (Exclusion Ritual); when `opponentsOnly=true`, only opponents of the source's controller are restricted (Ixalan's Binding, Godsend) |
| `SpellsWithChosenNameCantBeCastEffect` | `()` or `(boolean opponentsOnly)` | spells with the chosen name on the source permanent can't be cast (static). Default (`opponentsOnly=false`) restricts every player, incl. the controller (Nevermore); `true` restricts only the controller's opponents (Gideon's Intervention). Enforced in `CastingPermissionService.getForbiddenCardNames` |
| `SpellsAndLandsWithChosenNamesCantBePlayedEffect` | `()` | static, symmetric: spells with either name chosen on the source permanent (`chosenName` / `secondChosenName`) can't be cast **and** lands with those names can't be played, by any player incl. the controller (Null Chamber). The cast half rides `CastingPermissionService.getForbiddenCardNames`; the land half needs its own hook (`CastingPermissionService.isLandPlayForbiddenByChosenName`, called from `GameActionAvailabilityService` on both the hand and graveyard land paths) because land plays deliberately bypass the spell filters. Pair with `YouAndOpponentChooseCardNamesOnEnterEffect()` |
| `SpellsAndNonbasicLandsWithNontokenPermanentNamesCantBePlayedEffect` | `()` | static, symmetric: spells and nonbasic lands can't be cast/played when their name matches any nontoken permanent on the battlefield (Cornered Market). Names are recomputed from the battlefield; token names and spells on the stack do not contribute. The cast side uses `CastingPermissionService.getForbiddenCardNames`; the land side uses `CastingPermissionService.isLandPlayForbiddenByChosenName` because land plays bypass spell filters |
| `ReduceCastCostForChosenNameSpellsEffect` | `(int amount)` | STATIC; spells cast by the source's controller whose name equals the permanent's chosen name cost `amount` generic mana less (Council of the Absolute, 2). Pair with `ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect`. Handled by `ReduceCastCostForChosenNameSpellsEffectHandler` in `service/cast/costmod/` |
| `ReduceDashCostEffect` | `(int amount)` | reduce the generic mana component of dash alternate costs by `amount` while the source permanent is on the battlefield; applies only to dash costs paid by that source's controller and leaves normal casts, colored mana, and opponents' dash costs unchanged (Warbringer, DTK) |
| `IncreaseCastCostForChosenNameSpellsEffect` | `(int amount)` | STATIC; spells cast by the player enchanted by the source Aura whose name equals the permanent's chosen name cost `amount` generic mana more (Curse of Silence, 2). Pair with `ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect`; handled by `IncreaseCastCostForChosenNameSpellsEffectHandler` in `service/cast/costmod/` |
| `IncreaseSpellCostEffect` + `CardHasSourceChosenNamePredicate` | `(2, CostModificationScope.OPPONENT)` | STATIC; opponents' spells whose name equals the source permanent's chosen name cost two generic mana more (Anointed Peacekeeper) |
| `PlayerHasProtectionFromChosenNameEffect` | `()` | the source permanent's controller has protection from the chosen card name on the source permanent (static, Runed Halo). The player can't be targeted, dealt damage (combat or noncombat), or enchanted by anything with that name. Pair with `ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect()`. Scanned by `GameQueryService.playerHasProtectionFromChosenName` from targeting/damage services |
| `PlayerHasProtectionFromOpponentsEffect` | `()` | static: the source permanent's controller has protection from sources controlled by each opponent (Absolute Virtue). Player targeting, player damage, and Aura attachment checks compare the source controller dynamically; the source permanent itself is not protected. Scanned by `GameQueryService.playerHasProtectionFromOpponents` |
| `ProtectionFromChosenPlayerEffect` | `()` | static: the source permanent has protection from the player chosen as it entered (True-Name Nemesis). The selected player ID is the permanent's `chosenPlayerIds`; the shared protection query covers targeting, damage, combat, and Aura attachment. Pair with `ChoosePlayerOnEnterEffect()` |

Read directly in `AbilityActivationService.activateHandAbility` (cycling identified by its reminder-text `"Cycling"` description prefix) via the `FreeCyclingEffect` capability interface; the hand-size check counts the card being cycled (checked before it's discarded). No handler bean. |

The intrinsic discard cost is still paid. No handler bean. |

## Choose / name
| `ReduceActivationCostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | `CostEffect` for an activated ability; reduces its generic mana cost by the amount evaluated at activation time. Use `CardsInGraveyard`, `CountersOnSource`, or another amount for "This ability costs {N} less to activate for each …" |
| `IncreaseActivationCostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | `CostEffect` for an activated ability; increases its generic mana cost by the amount evaluated at activation time. Use for an ability whose printed `{X}` is defined by a current game-state amount, such as Bargaining Table's opponent-hand-size cost |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect` | `(CardType requiredType)` or `()` or `(List<CardType> excludedTypes)` or `(List<CardType> excludedTypes, HandAccess handAccess)` or `(..., boolean nonbasicLandOnly)` | choose a card name as the permanent enters (implements the `ChooseCardNameEffect` replacement marker, so it is never queued as an ETB trigger). The required-type constructor restricts offered names to that card type (Petrified Hamlet uses LAND); land plays wait for the choice before entry and retain their source zone. No-arg allows any name (Pithing Needle); with excludedTypes filters the name list (e.g. `List.of(LAND)` for Phyrexian Revoker); `nonbasicLandOnly=true` restricts the offered names to nonbasic land cards (Alpine Moon). `HandAccess.LOOK_AT_OPPONENT_HAND` shows the opponent's hand but still allows any name (Sorcerous Spyglass); `HandAccess.REVEAL_OPPONENT_HAND` reveals each opponent's hand to everyone and restricts the choice to the names revealed this way (Alhammarret, High Arbiter) — if no revealed card passes `excludedTypes`, the permanent just enters with no chosen name |
| `ChooseCardTypeOnEnterEffect` | `(List<CardType> excludedTypes, boolean lookAtOpponentHand[, boolean sharedWithCraftMaterials])` | as-enters card-type choice; optionally looks at an opponent's hand first, optionally restricts choices to types shared by the craft materials, then stores the selected type on `Permanent.chosenCardType` |
| `YouAndOpponentChooseCardNamesOnEnterEffect` | `()` | "as this enters, you and an opponent each choose a card name other than a basic land card name" (Null Chamber). The controller names first, then the opponent; the two names land on the permanent as `chosenName` and `secondChosenName`, and only then does it enter (CR 614.1c). Handled inline in `StackResolutionService`'s enchantment branch � `PlayerInputService.beginDualCardNameChoice` � `ChoiceHandlerService.handleDualCardNameChosen` (`ChoiceContext.DualCardNameChoice`), not by a normal effect handler. Basic land names are filtered out of the offered list |
| `ActivatedAbilitiesOfChosenNameCantBeActivatedEffect` | `()` or `(boolean blocksManaAbilities)` | activated abilities of chosen name can't be activated (static). No-arg (false) excludes mana abilities (Pithing Needle); `true` also blocks mana abilities (Phyrexian Revoker) |
| `ActivatedAbilitiesOfMatchingPermanentsCantBeActivatedEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate)` or `(PermanentPredicate predicate, boolean blocksManaAbilities)` | activated abilities of permanents matching the predicate can't be activated (static); the one-argument form blocks mana abilities too, while `false` preserves mana abilities (Damping Matrix uses `anyOf(artifact, creature)`). Used by Stony Silence with `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` |
| `ChooseColorOnEnterEffect` | `()`, `(int choicesRequired)` or `(CardColor... allowedColors)` | choose one or more colors as ETB (implements `ChooseColorEffect` marker). The no-arg form offers all five colors; pass a narrower varargs list for cards that restrict the pick (`new ChooseColorOnEnterEffect(CardColor.BLACK, CardColor.RED)` � Mangara's Equity's "choose black or red"), or an `int` for cards that collect several **distinct** colors (`new ChooseColorOnEnterEffect(2)` � Tablet of the Guilds; each prompt excludes the earlier picks, and the results land in `Permanent.chosenColors`). | `ChooseSubtypeForSourceEffect` | `()` / `(List<CardSubtype> allowedSubtypes)` / `(List<CardSubtype>, String prompt)` | during resolution, secretly choose a creature type and store it on the source permanent |
| `CopyAbilitiesOfChosenPlaneswalkerTypeThisTurnEffect` | `()` | "choose a planeswalker type. | `ChooseBasicLandTypeOnEnterEffect` | `()` / `(int choicesRequired)` / `(List<CardSubtype> allowedTypes)` / `(int choicesRequired, List<CardSubtype> allowedTypes)` | choose one (default) or two basic land types as ETB. First result � `Permanent.chosenSubtype`; when `choicesRequired=2`, second pick chains into `secondChosenSubtype`. `allowedTypes` narrows the offered options (empty = all five) for cards that restrict the choice � "choose Island or Swamp" (Roots of Life); the list rides on `ChoiceContext.BasicLandTypeChoice` so a chained second pick offers the same set. | `ExileUpToXCreatureCardsFromGraveyardOnEnterWithCountersEffect` | `(int countersPerCard)` | as-enters choice over up to paid X creature cards in the controller's graveyard; exiles the picks tracked with the entering permanent, then adds `countersPerCard` +1/+1 counters per card. Resumed by `GraveyardChoiceHandlerService.handleMultipleCardsChosen` |

| `SacrificeAllPermanentsAsEntersEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | As the permanent enters, sacrifice every permanent the controller controls matching `filter` before the entering permanent is placed on the battlefield. Overlaid Terrain uses a land filter With `PermanentHasSameNameAsSourcePredicate` it is Sheltered Valley's "instead sacrifice each other permanent named [this] you control" (the filter is judged with the entering permanent as the source; permanents entering with it are not sacrificed; nothing is sacrificed by a land that loses its abilities as it enters). |

When `affectsAllZones=true`, also applies to creature spells on the stack and creature cards you own in hand/graveyard/library/exile (e.g. Arcane Adaptation). `toSelf()` = `Subjects.source()`, only the source itself becomes the chosen type � "this creature is the chosen type in addition to its other types" (Adaptive Automaton). | `AllColorWordsBecomeChosenColorEffect` | `()` | global text-changing static (CR 612.1, applied in layer 3 per CR 613.1c): every color word in the text of every spell and permanent becomes the source's chosen color word. Unlike the targeted one-shot `ChangeColorTextEffect` it records NO `TextReplacement` on any object — the substitution is derived from the battlefield on every text-change query, so it starts and stops applying as this permanent enters and leaves. Consumed directly by `TextChangeTransformer`; it therefore has no static handler. Swirl the Mists |

## Put onto battlefield

`ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.returnToHandAtEndStep` schedules a permanent returned to the battlefield for return to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step (Cauldron Dance).
`ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.returnToHandAtYourNextEndStep` does the same at the beginning of the effect controller's next end step only (Greasefang, Okiba Boss).

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `PutCardToBattlefieldOrElseEffect` | — | **Gone**: `SequenceEffect(ChooseCardEffect.upTo(cardsInYourHand(filter), 1, label), PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE)), ConditionalEffect(not returned(), elseEffect))`. |
| `PutCardFromHandToBattlefieldWithArtifactCountersEffect` | — | **Gone**: `SequenceEffect(ChooseCardEffect.upTo(cardsInYourHand(filter), 1, label), PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE)), ConditionalEffect(toA(RETURN, artifact), PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect(returnedThisResolution(), ...)))`. |
| `PutCardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(CardPredicate predicate, String label)` or `(�, boolean enterTapped)` or `(�, boolean enterTapped, boolean maxManaValueBoundedByX)` or `(�, boolean enterTapped, boolean maxManaValueBoundedByX, boolean grantHaste, boolean sacrificeAtEndStep)` | you may put a card matching predicate from hand onto battlefield (wrap in MayEffect for one-shot). `label` is used in prompt text. `grantHaste`/`sacrificeAtEndStep` for Soulstoke. Call `returningToHandAtEndStep()` for the next-end-step owner-hand return rider (Surprise Deployment). Call `returningExiledSourceIfSacrificed()` for Shifty Doppelganger's source-return rider. `untapSourceIfEnteredCardHasAnySubtype(subtypes)` untaps the source when a matching card enters. `withEnterTappedAndAttackingIf(CardPredicate)` makes a selected matching card enter tapped and attacking while other selected cards enter normally (Summoner's Grimoire). `tappedAndAttacking(predicate, label)` = Preeminent Captain. `tappedDrawAndRepeat(predicate, label)` = Cultivator Colossus (put tapped, draw, re-offer until decline; do **not** wrap in MayEffect � the HandCardChoice is the "you may"). `tappedAnyNumber(predicate, label)` = Wrenn and Seven (put tapped, re-offer until decline, no draw). `anyNumber(predicate, label)` = Myojin of Life's Web (same, but entering untapped). E.g. `new PutCardToBattlefieldEffect(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.CREATURE), "creature")`, `new PutCardToBattlefieldEffect(new CardAllOfPredicate(List.of(new CardIsHistoricPredicate(), new CardIsPermanentPredicate())), "historic permanent")` |

Call `returningToHandAtEndStep()` for the next-end-step owner-hand return rider (Surprise Deployment). ## Provider map (where to add normal effect handlers)

`LandManaProducesOneChosenColorUntilEndOfTurnEffect` is resolved by its normal effect handler and keeps the controller's per-tap replacement permission as a floating effect on the player that lasts until end of turn.

`LandManaProducesFixedColorUntilEndOfTurnEffect` is resolved by its normal effect handler and keeps the controller's fixed-color replacement as a floating effect on the player that lasts until end of turn.

All stack-resolution ("normal") effects use one `@Component` handler class per effect in `service/effect/normalfx/`, implementing `NormalEffectHandlerBean`. Shared logic lives in domain `*Support` classes in the same package (e.g. `DamageSupport`, `LibraryRevealSupport`). New handlers need only the `@Component` annotation � `GameEngineConfig` registers them at startup.

| Category | Handler location | Shared helpers |
|----------|------------------|----------------|
| Damage | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `DamageSupport` |
| Destruction/sacrifice | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `DestructionSupport` |
| Bounce | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `BounceSupport` |
| Counter | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `CounterSupport` |
| Library reveal/search/mill/shuffle | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `LibraryRevealSupport`, `LibrarySearchSupport`, `LibraryShuffleSupport` |
| Graveyard return/exile | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `GraveyardReturnSupport` |
| Player interaction (draw/discard/choices) | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `PlayerInteractionSupport` |
| Life | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `LifeSupport` |
| Boost/pump | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | (handler-local or `GameQueryService`) |
| Tap/untap | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `TapUntapSupport` |
| Keyword grant | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | � |
| Animation/transform | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `AnimationSupport` |
| Permanent control/tokens/regeneration | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `PermanentControlSupport` |
| Permanent counters | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `PermanentCounterSupport` |
| Static continuous effects | `staticfx/*Handler` (see **STATIC_EFFECT_HANDLERS.md**) | `StaticEffectSupport` |
| Cast-cost modifiers (reductions/taxes) | `cast/costmod/*Handler` (see **COST_MODIFICATION_HANDLERS.md**) | `CostModificationSupport` |
| Prevention | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `PreventionSupport` |
| Turn effects | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `TurnSupport` |
| Copy/retarget | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `CopySupport`, `TargetRedirectionSupport` |
| Exile permanent | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `ExileSupport` |
| Return from exile / egg counters | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `ExileSupport` |
| Combat restrictions | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | � |
| Equip | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | � |
| Card-specific one-offs | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | `CardSpecificSupport` |
| Win conditions | `normalfx/*EffectHandler` | � |
| Land-tap triggers | `TapTriggers` (`TapEvent.LandTappedForMana`) | � |

Orchestration (conditionals, `MayEffect`, stack dispatch) remains in `EffectResolutionService`.

## Target validator map � the `@ValidatesTarget` ESCAPE HATCH (where to add one, rarely)

Structural targeting (declared target + predicate) is handled entirely by the declarative `TargetSpec`
interpreter in `TargetValidationService` � you do NOT write a validator for it. A hand-written
`@ValidatesTarget` method is now an ESCAPE HATCH, used ONLY when legal targeting turns on a rule the
spec cannot express: opponent-relation, controller/owner compare ("from your graveyard"),
chosen-source inspection, or null-target tolerance (divided-damage / ETB-assignment paths). Such an
effect must STILL declare its structural `targetSpec()` (redundant with the validator's structural
checks � harmless, and the `TargetSpecRatchetTest` guard requires it). Validator classes live in
`service/validate/`, auto-registered via the annotation.

`TargetValidationService.checkEffectTargets` interprets the declared `targetSpec()` **before** it
calls the registered validator, so a validator must never re-check which permanent kinds are legal —
the spec has already answered that, layer-aware (CR 613.1d). Restating it in the validator is how the
two drift: `DamageTargetValidators.validateDealDividedDamage` used to re-run "creature or planeswalker"
against the *printed* type line, which the spec interpreter no longer reads anywhere.

| Category | Validator class | Dependencies |
|----------|----------------|--------------|
| Damage (opponent-or-planeswalker, divided-damage null tolerance, per-recipient player guard) | `DamageTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService` |
| Creature mods (only the equip/attach boost validators � target outside the single-target pipeline) | `CreatureModTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService` |
| Destruction (per-recipient player guard, combat-state "creature blocking this") | `DestructionTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService`, `GameQueryService` |
| Graveyard (own/opponent graveyard controller-compare, card-zone/type checks) | `GraveyardTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService`, `GameQueryService` |
| Exile (return from exile � zone + card filter) | `ExileTargetValidators` | `GameQueryService` |
| Library (no-op-PLAYER `requireTargetPlayer` guards) | `LibraryTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService` |
| Permanent control (aura attachment-state, no-op-PLAYER guard) | `PermanentControlTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService`, `GameQueryService` |
| Life (no-op-PLAYER `requireTargetPlayer` guards) | `LifeTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService` |
| Prevention (divided-prevention null tolerance) | `PreventionTargetValidators` | `TargetValidationService` |

(There is no `BounceTargetValidators` � bounce targeting is fully declarative.)

**Two method signatures supported:**
- **Pattern A:** `void method(TargetValidationContext ctx)` � effect not needed
- **Pattern B:** `void method(TargetValidationContext ctx, ConcreteEffectType effect)` � effect auto-cast

Helper methods on `TargetValidationService`: `requireTarget()`, `requireBattlefieldTarget()`, `requireCreature()`, `checkProtection()`, `requireTargetPlayer()`, `findSourcePermanentIndex()`, `findSourcePermanentController()`.

| `DamageToControllerCounterReplacementEffect` | `(CounterType)` | static replacement marker: damage to the controller is replaced by that many counters of the configured type on the source permanent. `DamageSupport` applies it to combat and noncombat player damage and still replaces damage when counters cannot be placed (Delaying Shield, Force Bubble) |
| `DelayingShieldUpkeepEffect` | `()` | `Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)`; removes all delay counters from the source, then expands into one `ForcedCostOrElseEffect(PayManaCost("{1}{W}"), LoseLifeEffect(1))` decision for each counter removed. |

## Canonical card examples

- `ChooseTwoCreaturesByPowerDifferenceEffect()` — resolution-time choice of exactly two creatures you control; draws the absolute difference between their powers and gives the chosen creatures +X/+X and trample until end of turn. One creature is auto-chosen with X equal to 0.
- `ChooseAnotherAttackingCreatureWithLesserPowerEffect` — **Gone**: `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, controlledBy(you(), attacking creature, not PermanentIsTargetCardPredicate, PermanentPowerLessThanTargetPredicate), label) + GrantKeywordEffect(DOUBLE_STRIKE, thisWay(CHOOSE))`
- Burn spell: `cards/s/Shock.java`
- Multi-effect targeted spell: `cards/c/Condemn.java`
- Effect composition in activated ability: `cards/o/OrcishArtillery.java`
- Spell-copy targeting stack: `cards/t/Twincast.java`
- Aura static lock: `cards/p/Pacifism.java`

Samite Blessing uses `PreventDamageFromChosenSourceEffect.nextDamageToTargetCreature()` for a target-specific one-shot source prevention shield; the source is chosen on resolution and only damage to the targeted creature consumes it.

| `SharedColorDiscardAlternativeCostEffect` | `()` | battlefield static permission to cast a colored spell by discarding a different card from hand that shares a color with it instead of paying its mana cost. Symmetric across players; the selected card goes to the graveyard and discard triggers fire. Used by Dream Halls |
| `RemoveAllCountersThenDestroyReferencedPermanentAndDamageControllerEffect` | `(PermanentSubject subject, CounterType counterType, int damage)` | non-targeting composite effect: remove all counters of the named type from the referenced permanent, destroy it with normal regeneration handling, then use that permanent as the damage source for fixed damage to its controller |
| `StateTrigger.referencing` | `Triggers.state(predicate).referencing(PermanentPredicate)` | state-trigger form that snapshots the first matching non-targeting permanent onto the triggered stack entry for later resolution; the predicate uses the layer-aware evaluator |
| `GainLifeForEachChosenColorSpellCastEffect` | — | **Gone**: Tablet of the Guilds writes `Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(new CardHasSourceChosenColorPredicate())` + `GainLifeEffect(new TriggeringSpellChosenColorCount())`; Prism Ring and Diamond Mare `Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(new CardHasSourceChosenColorPredicate())` + `GainLifeEffect(1)` |
| `EnergyCountersEffect` | `(int amount | DynamicAmount amount)` | changes the controller's energy-counter total; positive amounts add energy and negative amounts pay energy. A dynamic amount can read the combat-damage event with `EventValue` (Empyreal Voyager). |
| `ExperienceCountersEffect` | `(int amount | DynamicAmount amount)` | changes the resolving controller's experience-counter total; use `ExperienceCountersEffect(1)` for “you get an experience counter.” |
| `AwardPersistentManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color, DynamicAmount amount[, Recipient recipient])` | triggered: adds `amount` of `color` to the controller's pool by default and marks that mana to survive step/phase transitions until end of turn. `Recipient.TARGET_PLAYER` routes it to the stack entry's recorded player, as used by Shizuko, Caller of Autumn; `Recipient.ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER` routes it to the attached permanent's controller, as used by Mark of Sakiko. `EventValue` reads the combat damage that caused the trigger. |
| `AwardPersistentAnyColorManaEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` or `(int amount)`; `(DynamicAmount, ManaSpendRestriction, boolean anyColorCombination)` | triggered: prompts for one color, then adds the whole amount to the controller's pool as mana that survives step/phase transitions until end of turn. With `SPELL_ONLY`, each mana is tagged for spells only; with `anyColorCombination=true`, the color is chosen separately for each mana. |
| `PreventNextDamageByTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` / `(boolean gainLife)` | Defaults to life gain for Awe Strike; pass `false` for prevention without life gain (Dazzling Reflection). Benign `CREATURE` target; the target is the source creature. Resolution installs a source-wide one-shot `SourceNextDamageToAnyTargetShield` with the resolving controller as `lifeGainPlayerId`, so the next combat or noncombat damage event from that creature to any recipient is prevented and the controller gains the prevented amount. |
| `SearchLibraryForNonlandCardAndRevealEffect` | `(int lifeLoss)` | reveal-only nonland library search; the selected card returns to the library before shuffling, and its name is carried through `LibrarySearchFollowUp` to the following opponent check (Grim Reminder) |
| `LoseLifeToOpponentsWhoCastNamedSpellThisTurnEffect` | `(String cardName, int amount)` | each opponent who cast a spell with `cardName` this turn loses `amount` life once; resolves through `LifeSupport` so normal life-loss triggers and restrictions apply (Grim Reminder) |
| `RedirectTargetCreatureNextDamageFromChosenSourceToSelfEffect` | `()` | activated-ability redirect: the next single damage event a chosen source would deal to the target creature this turn is dealt to the ability's source permanent instead (Shaman en-Kor). permanent-targeting spec — the ability targets the protected creature; the source is chosen on resolution (prompts a battlefield permanent choice). Stores a next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` (protected creature + chosen source + `NEXT_EVENT` amount + `redirectTargetId` = ability source permanent) which `applyCreatureRedirectShields` redirects in full then consumes, over both combat and noncombat creature-damage paths. Like Jade Monolith's controller variant, but the destination is the ability's source permanent. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `ReturnEnchantedCreatureAndSelfToHandAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | Aura attack trigger: when the enchanted creature attacks, schedules the source Aura and its enchanted creature for return to their owners' hands at end of combat. Queues the Aura first so it is not orphaned before the creature is returned. Use Triggers.attacks() on the Aura. See Contempt |
| `RedirectTargetCreatureDamageFromChosenSourceToTargetEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentSubject protectedCreature, PermanentSubject redirectTo)` | SPELL with two creature targets: all damage a chosen source would deal to the first target creature this turn is dealt to the distinct second target creature instead (Kor Chant). The source is chosen on resolution; the handler stores an unlimited `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` and reuses the existing combat/noncombat redirect paths. Also `.toSource()` is the one-target "dealt to this creature instead" (Oracle's Attendants). |
| `RedirectNextDamageFromTargetToAnotherTargetEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | SPELL with two distinct any-target groups: the next X damage dealt to the first target creature, planeswalker, or player this turn is dealt to the second target instead (Captain's Maneuver). Installs an amount-limited any-source shield in the existing creature/player redirect lists; the shared noncombat and combat paths handle all three recipient kinds. |
| `EachCreatureControllerSacrificesPermanentUnlessPaysEffect` | `(String manaCost)` | SPELL — "For each creature, its controller sacrifices a permanent of their choice unless they pay `manaCost`." Handler `EachCreatureControllerSacrificesPermanentUnlessPaysEffectHandler`; completion in `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService`. Fade Away |
| `EnchantedCreatureDealsDamageToTargetCreatureEffect` | `(DynamicAmount damage, PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)`; convenience `(int, PermanentPredicate)` | the creature attached to the source Aura deals damage to the target creature, using the enchanted creature as the damage source for protection, prevention, and damage triggers. `targetPredicate` narrows the legal target. Used by Dizzying Gaze |
| `ReduceBuybackCostEffect` | `(int amount)` | reduce the generic mana component of every mana buyback cost by `amount` while the source permanent is on the battlefield; applies to every player's buyback costs and leaves normal spell costs and non-mana buyback costs unchanged (Memory Crystal) |

| Effect | Constructor shape | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `AllowCastCardsExiledWithSourceUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, boolean withoutPayingManaCost[, boolean ownOnly])` | Grants one source-linked cast permission until end of turn; the free-cast grant is consumed when used. `ownOnly` restricts the grant to cards owned by the permission's controller. |

On a planeswalker it applies to that source; when carried by an emblem, it applies to every planeswalker controlled by the emblem's controller while retaining the normal activation limit. |

Implements `ControlledPermanentsLegendRuleExemptionEffect`; `LegendRuleService` applies the exemption only while that controller has a source carrying it. Mirror Box |

Used by Long-Term Plans (`SCG`) |

Reads `GameData.cardsExiledThisTurn`, populated by the unified `GameData.addToExile` choke point and cleared at turn cleanup. Used by Ennis, Debate Moderator to gate its controller-end-step counter trigger |

Uses the shared multi-card library choice with type-based routing. Zimone's Experiment |

Choices use APNAP ordering and the shared coin-flip replacement/trigger path. Used by Goblin Assassin. |
| `TransmuteArtifactSearchEffect` + `TransmuteArtifactSelectedCardEffect` + `TransmuteArtifactCardDispositionEffect` | `()` / `(UUID cardId, boolean toBattlefield)` | Transmute Artifact's dynamic artifact search. The sacrificed artifact's mana value is snapshotted on the resolving entry; the selected artifact enters the battlefield at no extra cost when its value is no greater, otherwise the controller may pay exactly the difference, with a declined or unpayable payment sending that selected card to its owner's graveyard. |

| `DealDamageToTargetCreatureWithExcessToControllerEffect` | `(DynamicAmount damage, boolean transformSourceIfExcess)` | Deals damage to a target creature, redirects excess beyond lethal to that creature's controller, and optionally transforms the source when excess is redirected. Used by Megatron, Destructive Force with `SacrificedPermanentManaValue()`. |

## Planechase effects

| Effect | Constructor | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CreateTokenEffect.withSimultaneousTokens` | `(List<CreateTokenEffect>)` | One creation instruction with different token blueprints; replacement choices see the combined count, and all profiles enter as one batch. Used by Bestial Menace. |
| `PreventDamageToControllerPerClericEffect` | `()` static, or pending damage choice payload | Each active source's controller may prevent damage to any player. Separate choices preserve the actual damage source and resume combat only after all simultaneous replacement choices finish. Used by Battletide Alchemist. |

| `ExileTargetCreatureAndReturnAtNextEndStepEffect` | `()` | Exiles target creature and queues a delayed end-step trigger returning it to the battlefield under its owner's control. Used by Bad Wolf Bay (`WHO` 569). |
| `PlaneswalkEffect` | `()` | Turns face-up planar cards face down and reveals the next shared-deck card. |
| `ChaosEnsuesEffect` | `()` | Causes chaos for face-up planar cards without rolling. |
| `RollPlanarDieEffect` | `()` | Rolls the planar die without increasing the special-action cost. |
| `BlankPlanarDieRollsCauseChaosEffect` | `()` | Encounter effect that makes blank planar-die rolls trigger chaos while the source phenomenon remains face up. |
| `PlanarDiePlaneswalkToChaosEffect` | `()` | no handler: the replacement "if a player would planeswalk as a result of rolling the planar die, chaos ensues instead", floated by `GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect.untilYourNextTurn(...)` and read for whoever's roll it is; the normal phenomenon lifecycle still planeswalks away from the phenomenon. Fixed Point in Time (`WHO` 582). |
| `ReverseTurnOrderEffect` | `()` | Reverses `GameData.orderedPlayerIds`, changing the direction of future turns. Used by Time Distortion. |
| `BombardmentEffect` | `()` | SPELL effect that replaces each card owned by the resolving controller outside the battlefield with a red `{R}` Missile sorcery until end of turn: a floating effect on the controller whose payload keeps each changed card's original; a card changing zones leaves it, and the duration clock restores the rest at cleanup. Used by Bombardment (MB1 #53). |

See [PLANECHASE.md](PLANECHASE.md) for planar triggers and command-zone source handling.


- `SourceIsBlocked()` is an activation condition for an attacking creature blocked either by creatures or by an effect without blockers (Cinder Crawler).
- `ChooseOpponentOnEnterEffect()` is an as-enters replacement handled by `OpponentChoiceOnEnterSupport`. The two-player engine remembers the sole opponent in `Permanent.rememberedTargetPlayerId`. `CountScope.CHOSEN_PLAYER` counts that fixed player even after control changes (Skyshroud War Beast).
- `PermanentControlledBySourceChosenPlayerPredicate()` matches permanents controlled by the player remembered by the source permanent's choose-a-player effect, including through last-known source information during target validation (Stalking Leonin).
- `ChoosePlayerOnEnterEffect()` is an as-enters replacement handled by `AsEntersInteractionService`, which prompts the controller for any player and stores the selected player in the entering permanent's `chosenPlayerIds` for `ProtectionFromChosenPlayerEffect` (True-Name Nemesis).
- `ChoosePlayerOnEnterEffect(2)` uses the multi-player as-enters choice path and stores both selected players on the entering permanent (`Permanent.rememberedTargetPlayerIds`), which `PlayerChosenBySourcePredicate` and `Subjects.except(Subjects.chosenPlayers(), Subjects.triggeringPlayer())` read (Sower of Discord).
- `PermanentControlledByPlayerPredicate(UUID)` restricts a permanent to a fixed player's current battlefield. Damage-trigger effects bind the damaged player's identity before collecting targets; control is rechecked on resolution.
- "That player controls" of a damage-to-a-player trigger is `PermanentControlledByTriggeringPlayerPredicate` in the effect's target restriction: the stack door chooses the target as the trigger goes on the stack against the player dealt damage (the choice's triggering player), and the stack entry's triggering player rechecks it as it resolves.
- `MustBlockSourceEffect(UUID, PermanentPredicate, boolean untilEndOfCombat)` defaults to turn-long duration; the boolean selects combat-only duration. Each is a floating effect on the blocker (`UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` or `UNTIL_END_OF_COMBAT`); `GameData.requiredBlockSourceIds` reads both.
- `PendingInteraction.LibraryRevealChoice.withRevealSelected(false)` keeps a looked-at selection private in public logs. Use the default public selection for effects that explicitly reveal the chosen cards.

Spell-cast triggers that refer to the spell that triggered them carry its identity as context and mark the stack entry non-targeting. Other effects in the ability still resolve if that spell leaves the stack (Speedball, New Warrior).

`DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect.recordingDamageDealt()` stores actual damage dealt by its source in the stack entry's `eventValue`, after prevention and redirection. Follow it with `GainLifeEffect(new EventValue())` for Corrupt-style life gain.

`EachPlayerReturnsCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` gathers every player's graveyard choice before placing the returned cards in one battlefield-entry batch. `underOwnersControl=true` uses card ownership instead of the graveyard owner (Planar Birth).

`ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` with `returnAll=true` and `chooseAuraAttachment=true` uses `BattlefieldEntryBatchSupport` to choose Aura attachments before the entire batch enters (Replenish). The same helper handles simultaneous hand entries (Show and Tell). Auras with no legal existing attachment remain in their original zone; creatures entering in the same batch are not attachment choices.

`RegisterDelayedStepTriggerEffect.aboutCreated(Triggers.cleanup(), new ExileTargetPermanentEffect(Subjects.createdThisResolution()))` makes one delayed triggered ability (CR 514.3a) about every permanent the resolution created, giving players priority before those permanents are exiled (Waylay).


`Subjects.controllerOf(triggering())` resolves to the entering creature's current controller, falling back to its last known controller if it has left. The trigger does not target that player (Tainted Aether).

| `PutCommanderFromCommandZoneIntoHandEffect` | — | **Gone**: `ChooseCardEffect.oneOf(cardsInYourCommandZone(CardIsCommanderPredicate()), label) + PutCardsIntoHandEffect(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE))`. |

`CreateTokenCopyOfTargetedSpellPermanentEffect()` / `(CreateTokenCopyOfTargetPermanentEffect copyEffect)` — "create a token that's a copy of one of those permanents / of that artifact or creature" of a cast trigger, the permanents the stack entry's triggering spell targets; which spells trigger it is the trigger's filter (`Triggers.youCastSpell().withFilter(...).withStackEntryFilter(...)`). The no-argument form is Orvar, the All-Form's "if it targets one or more other permanents you control" (the intervening "if" a `StackEntryTargetsPermanentPredicate` filter of another permanent you control; the effect reads the spell's targets as it resolves, the live spell or as it left the stack, and copies only one other than the source still under your control); `(copyEffect)` is Vesuvan Duplimancy's "a copy of that artifact or creature, except …" (the spell's targets as the ability triggered, a target that left the battlefield copied as it last existed there). The `withSpellSnapshot` form is **Gone**.

- `ResolveDelayedPermanentActionEffect(DelayedPermanentAction)` resolves an already collected zone-change action on the stack, preserving the scheduled permanent identity, warp permission, and sacrifice payer. Cleanup token exile remains immediate. A trigger's run of consecutive delayed sacrifices (or destroys) departs as one batch in the run's first step, so their CR 616.1 questions are asked before any of them leaves; the later steps of the run do nothing.
- `ResolvePendingExileReturnEffect(PendingExileReturn)` resolves an already collected exile return on the stack, preserving the original return options and attacking choice.
- `TransformToBackFaceEffect(true)` flips the source instead of transforming it, bypassing transform restrictions and transform-event triggers (Akki Lavarunner).
- `EachPlayerMayPutCountersOnCreatureAndRestrictAttacksEffect(CounterType, int, CardEffect)` accepts `GoadTargetCreatureUntilNextTurnEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()` to goad each creature that receives counters (Agitator Ant); the default form retains the player attack restriction.
- `MiracleRevealEffect`, `MiracleMayCastEffect`, and `MayCastForMiracleCostEffect` preserve an optional `xReduction` when a granted miracle discount exceeds the fixed generic mana component. It reduces the announced X component without reducing additional casting costs.
- `SourceClassLevelAtLeast(int level)` checks a Class permanent's separate level state rather than level counters, for Class ability conditions (a triggered one's event condition, CR 716.2a) and advancement.
- `CastExiledCardWithoutPayingManaCostEffect(UUID, true)` grants haste until end of turn to the resulting creature. `(UUID, false, true)` grants native suspend haste for as long as the same player controls the resulting permanent. Alaundo's granted casting ability and native suspend create separate last-counter triggers.
- `ToxicEffect(int value)` is a STATIC marker for a toxic ability's value. Combat damage applies the summed values from damaging creatures as poison counters through the existing player-counter path, without a stack trigger.

`CantBecomeNightEffect` is a static restriction checked through active static abilities before a day/night designation change; sources that lose their abilities do not prevent night. Used by Angel of Eternal Dawn (YMID 1).

An attached Aura's or Equipment's "blocks or becomes blocked by a [filter] creature" is the trigger's filter on the creature on the other side of the block (`Triggers.becomesBlocked().withFilter(p)`, CR 509.3f), which `CombatTriggerService` judges as the ability triggers: once for each matching blocker with `TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER` (Wooden Stake), once if one or more blockers match without it (Hedron Blade).

`AllowCastMatchingCardsFromDamagedPlayerGraveyardThisTurnEffect(CardPredicate, boolean)` grants one normal-cost cast from the graveyard of the player dealt combat damage. The card is chosen when cast, the permission lasts through the turn, and the boolean enables any-color mana for that cast.


`TrackCastSpellCardTypesEffect(Set<CardType> trackedTypes)` (Bucket List) marks the tracked types of the stack entry's triggering spell, as it was when the ability triggered, on a tracker list associated with the source, independently of permanent counters (the source live, else its snapshot as the ability triggered). It draws once for each spell adding a new type, then sacrifices the source and draws once more if the list completes. "A spell of a type showing" is the trigger's `withStackEntryFilter(new StackEntryHasTypeShowingOnSourceTrackerPredicate(trackedTypes))`. A condition of the trigger event is `TriggerOptions.withEventCondition(condition)`, checked as the ability triggers and not again on resolution (CR 603.2).

"When you cast this spell, copy it" is `CopyTriggeringSpellEffect` in the `Triggers.youCastThisSpell()` ability, the spell the entry's triggering spell: "copy it if …" a `ConditionalEffect` around it, "while …" the event condition, "if …" right after the trigger the intervening "if", "copy this spell twice" `.withCopies(2)` (Bygone Marvels).

`PerpetuallyBoostCreatureCardInHandEffect` supports an explicit toughness boost; existing constructors retain power-only changes. Delayed lose-life-and-return actions preserve the original graveyard entry version so leaving and returning cannot revive an old delayed return.

Delayed self-returns preserve the death controller for upkeep timing and trigger control, and the original graveyard entry version; the return itself remains under the owner. Target-death delayed effects bind the original permanent ID, so a later battlefield entry of the same card cannot satisfy them.

`BronzeTabletAnteExchangeEffect` applies the stated ownership changes to both exiled objects after payment is declined or unavailable, preserving identities with frozen runtime copies.

Chosen counter distribution during an alternative cast reuses CounterDistribution and CounterDistributionAssignment with an optional HandCastSpellTarget context. Target counts and division are announced before stacking the spell; completion preserves spell type, source zone, madness, and cast triggers. Miracle checks legal targets before removing the card from hand or paying mana.

When spell damage to a player has both global multiplication and ReduceSpellDamageEffect replacements, DamageSupport lets the affected player apply each source's modifier once in the chosen order. Remaining modifiers are retained in SpellDamageModifierOrder; completion resumes the original damage event and its trailing spell effects. ColorChoice copying isolates the retained stack entry for simulations.

ColorManaPairsSpentToCast reads the mana of each color the permanent recorded as its spell resolved (`Permanent.manaSpentByColorToCast`, from `StackEntry.manaSpentByColorToCast`), so each of its independent enters abilities reads the same payment as it resolves, after another has resolved; its effects go on the stack as written. Before the permanent exists (an "enters with" replacement) it reads the spell's payment.

PutCounterOnTargetPermanentEffect orders noncommuting replacements through CounterReplacementOrder before placing any counters. GameQueryService.counterReplacementsFor shares the ordinary applicability rules; the affected permanent's controller chooses each source once. Subsequent targets and the original stack entry are retained through the choice, and completion places the chosen count through PermanentCounterSupport without applying the same replacements again.

Counters a permanent enters with use the same choice. GameQueryService's entering counter overloads (`replaceCounters(gameData, permanent, controllerId, ...)` and `doublePlusOnePlusOneCounters(gameData, permanent, controllerId, count)`) apply the battlefield order and, when `enteringCounterReplacementsFor` lists noncommuting replacements, note an `EntryCounterPlacement` on the entering permanent. After its counters are placed and before it joins the battlefield, BattlefieldPlacementService.place asks its controller through `ChoiceContext.EntryCounterReplacementOrder`, corrects each placement by the difference, and finishes the entry through `completePlacement`. A permanent entering simultaneously with others keeps the battlefield order. Counters for an entering permanent go through those overloads, never the UUID-only `replaceCounters` overloads, so the choice is offered.

`BoostAllOwnCreaturesEffect.forDeclaredAttackers()` limits an attack trigger to the captured attacker permanent IDs, including attackers removed from combat before resolution.

| `ForageOrPayManaCost` | `(String manaCost)`; `forageOnly()` | Spell additional cost or battlefield activated ability forage cost. For activated abilities, `forageOnly()` chooses between sacrificing an effectively Food permanent and exiling exactly three own graveyard cards. Payment finishes before the ability is stacked and forage/sacrifice triggers stack above it. |

`BeholdCost.orPayMana` adds an alternative mana payment when the caster declines to behold; behold choices are validated and cards selected in hand are publicly revealed during payment.

`CascadeEffect(boolean instantOrSorceryOnly, CardPredicate qualifyingCardFilter, boolean deferCastUntilEndOfTurn)` can defer the free cast until end of turn. The qualifying card remains exiled with normal casting timing; only the other revealed cards go to the library bottom (Codie).

`DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect.separateEvenInstructions(CounterType, int)` models separate one-counter instructions. When both instructions choose the same creature, counter replacement effects apply to each instruction separately (Common Bond).

`AttachMatchingEquipmentToCreatedPermanentEffect(filter, true)` lets the controller choose a legal host among the permanents created by the same resolution, including extra tokens from replacements. Source-relative filters preserve the original permanent identity.

- `PutTargetCardExiledWithSourceIntoOwnersGraveyardAndCreateTokenEffect` — **Gone**: `ChooseCardEffect.oneOf(exiledWithSource(), label) + PutExiledCardsIntoOwnersGraveyardEffect(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE)) + ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.toACard(CHOOSE, filter), token)`.

`TriggerLimit.FIRST_TIME_EACH_TURN` ("for the first time each turn") includes events earlier in the turn before the source entered the battlefield (Crawling Sensation's land cards, Akim's token creation). Use it for a first-event trigger rather than `TriggerLimit.ONCE_EACH_TURN`, which counts only the source's own triggers.

`MayChoicePlayer.LAST_MANA_PAYMENT_PLAYER` keeps a follow-up optional choice with the player offered the preceding mana payment, including when the previously targeted permanent has left the battlefield (Chain Lightning, Chain Stasis). `ChannelHarmEffect(Integer preventedDamage)` retains its default shield-installation constructor; the damage form carries an optional prevention-event choice handled directly by `ChannelHarmDamageChoiceHandler`.

Shared combat prevention such as Cover of Winter uses `ChoiceContext.CombatSharedDamagePreventionChoice` after combat-damage assignment to divide its amount among the protected recipients of a single source. `GameData.combatSharedDamagePreventionAllocations` retains the division until that damage step completes. Damage replacement choices can include `SpellDamageModifier.replacesWithExile` for Crumbling Sanctuary; selecting it replaces the current damage with library exile and ends the damage event.

`SourceCardPower.ofExiledCostCard()` evaluates the power of the card exiled for a spell's additional cost at resolution, using its saved card reference when it has left exile (Corpse Lunge).

`FlickerEffect.flickerTargetUnderYourControl(filter)` retains a target restriction at resolution. `TargetCardsManaValueSum(true)` sums only target cards still in a graveyard (Command the Dreadhorde).

`ReplaceLandManaWithColorEffect(color, fixedAmount)` optionally replaces the produced amount as well as the color (Contamination); the one-argument constructor preserves the amount.

A departing permanent's Auras and Equipment are recorded on every stack entry that targets it or names it as its non-targeting "that creature" (`StackEntry.lastKnownPermanentAttachments`) and on every delayed step ability about it (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.referents().withPermanentAttachments`), whatever their effects are.

`ExileCardsWithSameNameEffect.all` requires all graveyard matches while allowing the controller to fail to find matching cards in hidden zones.

`ActivatedAbility.withDiscardSourceAsSpecialAction()` marks a printed hand discard instruction that does not use the stack. It requires priority, discards immediately, and ignores activated-ability restrictions and taxes (Circling Vultures). Runtime ability copies preserve this flag.

`ActivatedAbility.withSpecialAction()` marks an ability that is an action rather than an activated ability: planar abilities with it (Talon Gates) resolve their effects immediately without using the stack and are not stopped by "can't activate abilities" effects. Runtime ability copies preserve this flag.

| `PutHeldSpellbookCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect` | `()` | puts every held drafted spellbook card onto the battlefield together under the ability controller | The Hourglass Coven (HBG #45) |
